detail.title: Sticky Expectations, Active Fiscal Transfers, and the Post-Pandemic Inflation
detail.abstract: During the inflationary surge of 2021-2023, inflation expectations were slow to rise-but when they did, expected real interest rates fell as nominal rate expectations remained roughly constant. I estimate a medium-scale sticky-expectations heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) model and study the effect of fiscal transfers under a policy configuration that matches this expectations pattern. In particular, I simulate the deficit-financed transfers disbursed by the CARES Act of 2020 and the Consolidated Appropriations Act (CAA) and the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) of 2021 in a scenario wherein the central bank does not systematically respond to inflation with higher interest rates and the government does not commit to retire past deficits with future taxation. The simulated payments boost real annual GDP relative to trend by an average of 0.6% per quarter over 2020Q1-2023Q4 with an overall transfer multiplier of 2.0 and reduces unemployment by an average of 1.5 percentage points in each quarter. However, they also induce a 4.2% surge in the price level over the same period, with a peak annual inflation rate in 2022 of 2.8% above trend (slightly less than half of the post-pandemic peak observed in the data). This contrasts with the highly muted response of unemployment and inflation to similar fiscal shocks in an environment wherein all agents believe the central bank will raise interest rates in response to inflation. Unlike the first setting, this latter environment yields an expectations pattern that differs strongly from the post-2020 expectations data.

AI.tldr: 本文估计了一个中等规模的粘性预期异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型，模拟2020-2021年美国财政转移支付在央行不系统加息、政府不承诺未来增税偿债的政策配置下的经济影响。结果显示，这些转移支付使实际GDP年均增长0.6%（乘数为2.0），失业率平均降低1.5个百分点，但导致价格水平上涨4.2%，峰值通胀率达2.8%。相比之下，若公众相信央行会加息应对通胀，则失业和通胀反应极为微弱，且与2020年后的预期数据不符。
AI.research_question: 在2021-2023年通胀飙升期间，通胀预期缓慢上升而实际利率预期下降的情况下，财政转移支付对宏观经济（产出、失业和通胀）产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 2021-2023年美国经历高通胀但通胀预期反应滞后、实际利率预期下降，这一独特模式与传统新凯恩斯模型预期不符。作者旨在通过构建更符合现实预期特征的模型，评估疫情期间大规模财政转移支付的真实宏观效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粘性预期异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型；包含异质性家庭（有限参与金融市场）、粘性预期（部分代理人不及时更新信息）、以及不同的货币政策/财政政策制度假设。
AI.method: 估计中等规模的HANK模型；反事实模拟：对比两种政策制度假设（央行不系统加息+政府不承诺未来增税偿债 vs. 公众相信央行会加息应对通胀）；利用2020-2023年美国实际数据校准模型。
AI.findings: 1) 在"不系统加息+不承诺增税"情景下，CARES/CAA/ARPA转移支付使实际GDP增长0.6%/季度（乘数2.0），失业率降1.5个百分点，价格水平涨4.2%（峰值通胀2.8%）。2) 该情景的通胀预期与实际利率预期模式与2020年后数据吻合。3) 在"公众相信央行会加息"情景下，相同财政冲击对失业和通胀的影响极为微弱，且预期模式与数据严重不符。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将粘性预期引入HANK模型，解释了通胀预期滞后上升和实际利率预期下降的现象。2) 揭示了货币政策制度信念（公众是否相信央行会加息）对财政乘数的关键调节作用。3) 为理解2021-2023年"财政驱动型通胀"提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为评估疫情期间美国大规模财政刺激（CARES/CAA/ARPA）的宏观效果提供了量化证据。2) 提示政策制定者：财政转移支付的通胀效应高度依赖于央行货币政策的可信度及预期管理。3) 对后疫情时代财政-货币政策协调具有重要启示。

title: When Oil Falters, Gas and Coal Rise: A Volatility-Spillover Tale for Energy Stocks
affiliations: , Eastern Mediterranean University - Department of Banking and Finance and Eastern Mediterranean University

detail.title: When Oil Falters, Gas and Coal Rise: A Volatility-Spillover Tale for Energy Stocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: This study investigates volatility spillovers, network connectedness, and hedging strategies among major fossil fuels and energy stock indices in the five highest fossil fuels-consuming countries from 2008 to 2024. Using TVP-VAR and DCC-GARCH models, we examine how geopolitical and economic shocks influence market interactions. Results show that volatility connectedness increases during turbulent periods, peaking during the COVID-19 pandemic. Brent crude oil incurs the highest hedging cost and delivers the strongest hedging effectiveness in the full sample. However, its effectiveness deteriorates during oil-specific supply shocks. Natural gas and coal display low correlations with energy stock indices, making them the most cost-effective hedges. Regime-based hedging effectiveness analysis reveals that natural gas is countercyclical, strengthening precisely when oil-based hedges weaken. Coal hedging is highly regime-dependent, with its viability contingent on a country's energy structure and the source of market stress. The findings highlight the need for adaptive, regime-sensitive hedging strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2008-2024年间五大化石燃料消费国的化石燃料与能源股票指数间的波动溢出和网络连通性，发现布伦特原油对冲成本最高但效果最好，天然气和煤炭是最具成本效益的对冲工具，且对冲效果具有明显的体制依赖性。
AI.research_question: 五大化石燃料消费国中，主要化石燃料与能源股票指数之间的波动溢出、网络连通性及对冲策略如何？不同经济与地缘政治冲击下这些关系如何变化？
AI.motivation: 化石燃料市场与能源股票市场之间的关联性对投资组合多元化、风险管理和政策制定至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对多市场、多体制下波动溢出动态变化的全面分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动溢出理论、网络连通性理论、对冲有效性理论、体制依赖性假设
AI.method: TVP-VAR（时变参数向量自回归模型）和DCC-GARCH（动态条件相关广义自回归条件异方差模型）
AI.findings: （1）波动连通性在动荡时期显著上升，COVID-19疫情期间达到峰值；（2）布伦特原油对冲成本最高且全样本中对冲效果最强，但在石油特定供给冲击下效果恶化；（3）天然气和煤炭与能源股指相关性低，是最具成本效益的对冲工具；（4）天然气对冲呈逆周期性，在石油对冲失效时反而增强；（5）煤炭对冲高度依赖体制，其可行性取决于国家能源结构和市场压力来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同能源商品对冲效果的体制依赖性特征，特别是天然气对冲的逆周期性机制，丰富了波动溢出与跨市场对冲理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源投资者和政策制定者提供了基于体制变化的动态对冲策略建议，强调需要采用适应性、体制敏感的对冲方法。

title: The Community Navigator programme for people with treatment resistant depression in community mental health teams in England: randomised controlled trial
affiliations: University College London, University College London, University College London, University College London, University of York, , Independent, University of Birmingham - Institute for Mental Health, , University College London - Division of Psychiatry, University College London, University College London, , University of York, , University College London, University of Birmingham, University College London, , , North London NHS Foundation Trust, North London NHS Foundation Trust, NHS Foundation Trust - Central and North West London (CNWL), University College London, University College London, Tees, Esk and Wear Valleys NHS Foundation Trust, NHS Foundation Trust - Central and North West London (CNWL), North East London NHS Foundation Trust, University College London, University College London, University College London and University College London - Division of Psychiatry

detail.title: The Community Navigator programme for people with treatment resistant depression in community mental health teams in England: randomised controlled trial

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was granted by the Oxford South Central B NHS Research Ethics Committee on 30th March 2022 (REC reference 22/SC/0064). Participants provided consent.
declarations.funderStatement: The study was funded by the English National Institute for Health and Care Research, Health Technology Assessment Programme (NIHR HTA).
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: The trial was prospectively registered on 8th July 2022: ISRCTN13205972.

detail.abstract:
Background:  Outcomes are poor for many people with treatment resistant depression (TRD). Loneliness is independently associated with poorer recovery from depression and constitutes a novel TRD treatment target. A previous feasibility trial of a social intervention to target depression and loneliness in this group, the Community Navigator programme, showed the intervention was feasible and acceptable.

Methods: We completed an individual randomised controlled trial of the co-developed Community Navigator programme plus usual Community Mental Health Team (CMHT) care, compared to usual CMHT care plus an information booklet about local social groups. The primary outcome was change in depression symptoms (PHQ-9 scale) at 8-months (end-of-treatment).The Community Navigator programme offered up to 10 individual meetings with a Community Navigator and up to four group sessions. Community Navigators who had expertise in supporting social participation delivered the manualised programme. They mapped participants’ social worlds and supported them to set and achieve desired social connections goals.

Findings: We recruited 313 participants and completed follow-ups with 271 for the primary outcome. Of 158 intervention group participants, 76% were treated per protocol. At the end-of-treatment (8-months), PHQ-9 depression score in the intervention group was 0.91 units lower than in the usual care group but this was not significant (95% CI: -0.53 to 2.36, P=0.204). A significant result was only found for one of nine secondary outcomes at end-of-treatment (depression substantial improvement), and for no outcomes at 14-month follow-up. The programme was not cost-effective.

Interpretation: The Community Navigator programme as delivered cannot be recommended for use in practice for people with TRD. Further research is needed to develop effective treatments for TRD and programmes to alleviate loneliness in mental health populations generally.

AI.tldr: 该随机对照试验评估了"社区导航员计划"对难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者的疗效。结果显示，虽然干预组抑郁评分降低0.91个单位，但未达到统计学显著性（P=0.204），仅在九个次要结局之一（抑郁显著改善）中发现显著效果，且该计划不具备成本效益。因此，该计划不能推荐用于TRD患者的临床实践。
AI.research_question: 针对难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者，"社区导航员计划"（一项旨在缓解孤独感的社交干预项目）加常规社区心理健康团队（CMHT）治疗，与常规CMHT治疗加信息手册相比，是否能更有效地改善抑郁症状？
AI.motivation: 难治性抑郁症患者预后不佳，而孤独感与抑郁恢复较差独立相关，构成一个新颖的治疗靶点。先前可行性试验已显示该社会干预方案可行且可接受，因此有必要进行更大规模的随机对照试验验证其有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 孤独感与抑郁恢复的独立关联理论；社会参与和社会连接对心理健康的促进作用；以患者为中心的社会映射与目标设定方法。
AI.method: 个体随机对照试验。干预组接受"社区导航员计划"（最多10次一对一会议+最多4次小组会议，由具有社会参与支持专长的导航员按手册实施，包括绘制参与者社交世界、设定和实现社交连接目标）加常规CMHT治疗；对照组接受常规CMHT治疗加当地社交团体信息手册。主要结局指标为8个月（治疗结束时）抑郁症状变化（PHQ-9量表）。共招募313名参与者，271人完成主要结局随访。
AI.findings: 158名干预组参与者中，76%按方案接受治疗。在8个月治疗结束时，干预组PHQ-9抑郁评分比常规治疗组低0.91个单位，但未达到统计学显著性（95% CI: -0.53至2.36, P=0.204）。九个次要结局中仅有一个（抑郁显著改善）在治疗结束时显著，14个月随访时所有结局均不显著。该计划不具备成本效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了针对TRD患者孤独感的社会干预理论在实践中效果有限，提示孤独感与抑郁之间的关系可能比预期的更为复杂，简单的社交连接干预可能不足以改变TRD患者的临床轨迹。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确表明"社区导航员计划"不能推荐用于TRD患者的临床实践；指出需要进一步研究开发有效的TRD治疗方法以及缓解精神健康人群孤独感的项目。

title: Women's Age at Marriage and Clean Cooking Fuel Adoption in India
affiliations: , Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad and Zayed University

detail.title: Women's Age at Marriage and Clean Cooking Fuel Adoption in India
detail.abstract: A substantial share of households in developing countries continues to rely on traditional biomass fuels for cooking despite the associated adverse consequences for public health, environmental quality, and household welfare. Using nationally representative data from India, we examine the causal impact of women's age at marriage on uptake of clean cooking fuel. To address endogeneity in marriage timing, we employ an instrumental-variable strategy that uses women's age at menarche as an instrument for age at marriage. Our results indicate that a one-year delay in women's age at marriage increases the probability of clean cooking fuel adoption by approximately 2.1 percentage points. Given India's scale, the implied aggregate effects are economically meaningful and suggest that improvements in women's life-course outcomes can contribute to broader energy transitions. Further, we find that delaying marriages improves women's educational attainment, literacy, and intrahousehold decision-making power, which in turn increase the likelihood of clean fuel use. Our findings underscore the need for policies that seek to delay women's age at marriage along with interventions that provide financial support to families for girls' education. The results highlight the complementarity between gender empowerment policies and clean energy transitions in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 利用印度全国代表性数据，研究发现女性结婚年龄每推迟一年，清洁烹饪燃料采用概率提高约2.1个百分点，其机制是通过提升女性教育水平、识字率和家庭内部决策权来实现。
AI.research_question: 女性结婚年龄对清洁烹饪燃料采用有何因果影响？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家大量家庭仍依赖传统生物质燃料烹饪，带来健康、环境和福利的负面后果，理解清洁燃料采用的深层社会决定因素具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性赋权理论、人力资本理论、家庭能源转型决策理论
AI.method: 使用印度全国代表性数据，以女性初潮年龄作为结婚年龄的工具变量，采用工具变量法（IV）解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 女性结婚年龄每推迟一年，清洁烹饪燃料采用概率提高约2.1个百分点；机制是通过提升女性教育程度、识字率和家庭内部决策权来实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将女性生命历程（结婚年龄）与家庭能源转型联系起来，揭示了性别赋权与能源转型之间的互补关系，扩展了清洁能源采用的社会决定因素研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了双重干预路径：推迟女性结婚年龄与为女孩教育提供经济支持，两者结合可同时促进性别赋权和清洁能源转型。

title: Trust Experience Glitches: AI Agents, Delegated Autonomy, and the Breakdown of Legal Assumptions
affiliations: New York University Shanghai

detail.title: Trust Experience Glitches: AI Agents, Delegated Autonomy, and the Breakdown of Legal Assumptions
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is shifting from a technology of output generation to a technology of delegated action. Beyond answering queries in a chat window, contemporary AI agents can call APIs, manage credentials, write and deploy code, move money, negotiate with other agents, and act across digital environments autonomously with limited human supervision. This shift unsettles legal frameworks that assume clear delegation, identifiable actors, traceable causation, revocable authority, and enforceable defendants. This paper introduces the concept of the trust experience glitch: a discrete rupture in a stakeholder's reasonable trust expectations at the moment an autonomous AI system acts. A trust experience glitch is not merely a bug, hallucination, or AI incident, but rather a relational failure that exposes a mismatch between the trust signals emitted by a system or platform and the behavior stakeholders actually experience. Drawing on documented agentic AI failures, this paper develops a six-part taxonomy of trust experience glitches: (1) agency assertion, (2) epistemic camouflage, (3) delegation ambiguity, (4) opacity at scale, (5) cascading autonomy, and (6) revocation failure. It then maps these failure modes onto legal assumptions under strain: authority, veracity, causation, consent, and enforceability. This paper argues that agentic AI does not simply create new liability risks, but reveals a deeper mismatch between ex-post legal remedies and systems whose harmful actions may be distributed, opaque, emergent, or difficult to stop. The appropriate governance response must therefore move upstream, from after-the-fact attribution to protocol-level constraints. It concludes by pointing to a set of protocol primitives as the "traffic lights" of the agentic web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信任体验故障"概念，系统分析了AI从输出生成向行动委托转型过程中，自主AI系统行为与用户合理信任预期之间的六类断裂模式，并指出法律框架亟需从事后追责转向协议级约束。
AI.research_question: 当AI从内容生成工具转变为可自主委托行动的智能体时，现有法律框架面临怎样的系统性挑战？"信任体验故障"如何分类并映射到法律假设的失效点上？
AI.motivation: AI智能体已能自主执行API调用、代码部署、资金转移等真实世界行动，但法律体系仍基于明确委托、可识别行为者、可追溯因果、可撤销授权和可执行被告等传统假设，二者之间存在根本性错配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任体验故障理论：系统或平台发出的信任信号与利益相关者实际体验到的行为之间的断裂；六大分类包括：代理主张、认知伪装、委托模糊、规模性不透明、级联自主性、撤销失败。
AI.method: 基于已记录的智能体AI失败案例，进行定性分类分析，构建六类信任体验故障分类法，并将其映射到权威性、真实性、因果关系、同意和可执行性等法律假设上。
AI.findings: 智能体AI不仅创造新的责任风险，更暴露出事后法律补救措施与分布式、不透明、涌现性、难以停止的有害行为之间的深层错配。治理应对必须从归因转向协议级约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"信任体验故障"概念及六部分类法，为理解AI智能体引发的新型法律与治理挑战提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出治理应从事后追责转向协议级约束（即"智能体网络的交通灯"），为政策制定者和平台设计者提供了前瞻性治理方向。

title: Strong Wills, Strong Outcomes? Bank Resolvability and Credit Supply
affiliations: and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Strong Wills, Strong Outcomes? Bank Resolvability and Credit Supply
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of resolvability as a new regulatory constraint for restricting bank behaviour. Using a regression-discontinuity design, we exploit the 2019 regulatory shock that made banks with assets below the $250 billion asset threshold exempt to “living will” requirements. We find that affected banks experience an increase in their profitability and their shareholder value. They also lend more and at more favourable terms. Credit granting is boosted especially in less resolvable loans with no covenant restrictions and in countries with poor creditor rights. Our findings suggest that by enforcing crisis plans, “living wills” may contract credit supply.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2019年监管冲击（资产低于2500亿美元的银行免于“生前遗嘱”要求），采用回归断点设计，发现受影响的银行盈利能力、股东价值提升，贷款更多且条件更优，尤其是在可解决性较低、无契约限制的贷款及债权人保护较弱的国家。研究表明强制执行“生前遗嘱”可能收缩信贷供给。
AI.research_question: 可解决性（resolvability）作为新的监管约束如何影响银行行为？
AI.motivation: 2019年监管政策变化使资产低于2500亿美元的银行免除“生前遗嘱”要求，为检验可解决性对银行行为的影响提供了准自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管约束理论、银行行为理论、断点回归设计
AI.method: 回归断点设计（Regression-Discontinuity Design），利用2019年资产2500亿美元阈值附近的监管冲击
AI.findings: 受免除影响的银行盈利能力提升、股东价值增加、贷款规模扩大且条件更优惠；信贷增长尤其集中在可解决性较低、无契约限制的贷款以及债权人保护较弱的国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可解决性作为监管约束对银行行为的因果影响，丰富了银行监管与信贷供给关系的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估“生前遗嘱”等危机解决机制的经济后果提供了实证依据，提示强制执行此类要求可能带来信贷收缩的权衡代价。

title: Beyond Bounties: Implicit Financial Motives in Non-Monetary Whistleblowing
affiliations: Xiamen National Accounting Institute, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU)

detail.title: Beyond Bounties: Implicit Financial Motives in Non-Monetary Whistleblowing
detail.abstract: Why do employees blow the whistle and risk employer retaliation in the absence of explicit monetary rewards? We hypothesize that whistleblowing provides implicit financial benefits: by reducing workplace accident risk, reporting safety hazards protects employees' income stability and future earnings. To test this hypothesis, we exploit variation in household wealth arising from local housing price fluctuations among employees working at different facilities of the same parent firm, which captures differences in employees' demand for income stability. We find that a onestandard-deviation decline in local housing prices increases whistleblowing complaints by 6% and the probability of detecting a violation by 5%. In addition, the probability of a workplace injury decreases by 5%. These effects are stronger in areas with high blue-collar homeownership, when unemployment insurance reduces the economic cost of job loss (from employer retaliation), and at facilities with a prior record of safety violations, where safety risks and enforcement are more salient. In contrast, the effects are weaker when employees have greater non-housing wealth. Our findings indicate that workplace safety considerations act as implicit financial incentives that encourage whistleblowing. More broadly, we extend the literature on compensating wage differentials by showing that workers engage in non-wage, self-protective actions when formal compensation for job risk is incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文发现员工举报安全隐患并非出于利他动机，而是为了保护自身收入稳定：当地房价下跌（财富缩水）时，员工更倾向于举报安全问题以降低工伤风险，从而保障未来收入。这一效应在蓝领自有住房者多、失业保障完善、已有违规记录的工厂中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 在缺乏明确货币奖励的情况下，员工为何会举报安全隐患并冒着被雇主报复的风险？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为举报是利他行为，但缺乏显性金钱激励的悖论尚未被充分解释。本文提出举报具有隐性财务收益——通过降低工伤风险来保护收入稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补偿性工资差异理论；隐性财务激励理论；收入稳定性需求理论
AI.method: 利用同一母公司不同工厂员工的住房价格波动作为外生冲击（衡量收入稳定性需求差异），结合OSHA举报数据与工伤数据进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）当地房价每下降一个标准差，举报数量增加6%，违规检出概率提高5%；（2）工伤概率下降5%；（3）蓝领自有住房率高、失业保障完善、工厂有违规记录时效应更强；（4）员工非住房财富高时效应更弱。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将举报动机从利他/显性激励拓展至隐性财务激励；（2）扩展补偿性工资差异理论，揭示员工通过非工资的自我保护行动来应对工作风险补偿不足的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为理解员工举报行为提供新的政策视角：增强收入保障机制可促进安全举报；（2）对企业安全管理具有启示，提示关注员工经济脆弱性对安全行为的影响。

title: Fairness Trade-offs in Expert Evaluation: Information, Judgment, and Procedural Design
affiliations: University of Southern Denmark and University of Vermont - Department of Economics

detail.title: Fairness Trade-offs in Expert Evaluation: Information, Judgment, and Procedural Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Evaluation systems often seek to reduce bias, prevent manipulation, preserve relevant information, maintain comparability, and treat candidates equally, but these fairness goals can conflict. This paper develops a framework for understanding such trade-offs in expert evaluation---including peer review, grant panels, academic hiring, and artistic competitions---where quality is multidimensional and legitimate disagreement among evaluators is possible. We treat the choice among evaluation procedures as a problem of constitutional design: rules must be selected before the specific candidates, evaluators, and circumstances that will test them are known. Classical music competitions are our primary analytical setting because their rules, scores, and controversies make these trade-offs unusually visible, but the framework applies to other settings in which expert judgments are aggregated under incomplete information. The framework highlights two core tensions: information control and outlier rules. First, when information is both quality-relevant and identity-revealing, procedures that suppress bias-relevant cues may also remove information with genuine evaluative content. Second, because sincere minority judgment and strategic manipulation can generate similar observed score patterns, score-based exclusion rules may reduce manipulation while limiting legitimate dissent. Two further trade-offs concerning transparency and standardization are developed as illustrations. The analysis shows that no procedure can eliminate all vulnerabilities at once, and well-intentioned reforms may weaken the very values they aim to protect.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个专家评估中的公平性权衡框架，指出减少偏见、防止操纵、保留信息、维持可比性和平等对待候选人等公平目标可能相互冲突。以古典音乐比赛为主要分析场景，提出信息控制与离群值规则是两大核心张力，证明没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性，善意改革可能适得其反。
AI.research_question: 在专家评估（同行评审、经费评审、学术招聘、艺术竞赛等）中，不同的公平目标之间存在怎样的权衡关系？如何系统性地理解和设计评估程序来应对这些冲突？
AI.motivation: 现有评估体系往往追求多项公平目标（减少偏见、防止操纵、保留信息、维持可比性、平等对待），但这些目标之间存在内在冲突，缺乏系统性的理论框架来分析这些权衡。古典音乐比赛的规则、评分和争议使这些权衡异常可见，为研究提供了理想的分析场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法设计视角（constitutional design）：评估程序的选择类似于宪法制定，规则必须在了解具体候选人、评审者和情境之前确定。信息控制理论（信息既是质量相关的又是身份揭示的）；离群值规则理论（真诚的少数派判断与策略性操纵可能产生相似的评分模式）。
AI.method: 理论分析框架的构建，以古典音乐竞赛为主要经验分析场景，结合不完全信息下的专家判断聚合问题，通过两个核心张力（信息控制与离群值规则）和两个进一步权衡（透明度与标准化）进行系统分析。
AI.findings: (1) 信息控制陷阱：抑制偏见相关线索的程序也可能移除具有真正评估价值的信息；(2) 离群值规则困境：基于分数的排除规则可以减少操纵，但同时也会限制合法的异议表达；(3) 没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性；(4) 善意改革可能削弱其本欲保护的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将评估程序选择问题系统化地视为宪法设计问题，揭示了公平目标之间的结构性冲突，为理解专家评估中的信息控制与离群值规则提供了统一的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为同行评审、经费评审、学术招聘、艺术竞赛等领域的评估制度设计提供了权衡分析工具，帮助决策者认识到不同公平目标之间的取舍关系，避免"善意改革反而损害核心价值"的陷阱。

title: Climate Change and Sustainability:a Multicriteria Perspective
affiliations: University of Milan, Institute for Environmental Studies (IVM)) and University of Pisa

detail.title: Climate Change and Sustainability:a Multicriteria Perspective
detail.abstract: We introduce sustainability considerations in an integrated assessment model of climate change byanalyzing the implications of the social welfare function. The traditional social welfare function based ondiscounted utilitarianism cannot account for intertemporal equity thus different alternatives have beenproposed, such as the green golden rule and the Chinchilnisky criterion. The latter consists of a weightedaverage between discounted utilitarianism and the green golden rule, giving rise to a multicriteria formulationof the climate mitigation problem in which the scalarization factor is represented by the relativeweight between the two criteria measured by the degree of sustainability concern. We assess how theoptimal mitigation policy changes in alternative scenarios under different values of this parameter, characterizingthe extent to which sustainability considerations affect the intensity of environmental policiesalong with their implications on the efficient frontier. We show that climate mitigation is highly sensitiveto the degree of sustainability concern, and the more we care for long run sustainability the stricter thepolicy measures and the earlier the optimal timing of carbon neutrality.

AI.tldr: 本文在综合评估模型中引入可持续性考量，通过分析社会福利函数的选取，研究了不同可持续性关注程度对最优气候减缓政策的影响，发现可持续性关注度越高，气候减缓政策越严格，碳中和实现时间越早。
AI.research_question: 社会福利函数中可持续性考量的程度如何影响最优气候减缓政策？
AI.motivation: 传统的基于贴现功利主义的社会福利函数无法体现代际公平，需要引入替代性社会福利函数（如绿色黄金法则和Chinchilnisky准则）来评估可持续性对气候政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贴现功利主义、绿色黄金法则、Chinchilnisky准则（贴现功利主义与绿色黄金法则的加权平均）、多准则决策分析、综合评估模型。
AI.method: 在综合评估模型中引入Chinchilnisky准则，通过标量化因子（可持续性关注程度）作为参数，分析不同情景下最优减缓政策的变化及其对效率前沿的影响。
AI.findings: 气候减缓政策对可持续性关注程度高度敏感：可持续性关注度越高，政策力度越严格，实现碳中和的最优时间越早。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Chinchilnisky准则系统性地应用于气候减缓政策的优化分析，揭示了社会福利函数中可持续性权重对政策变量的敏感性，丰富了可持续性与代际公平的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了不同可持续性关注程度下最优减缓政策的定量依据，强调了尽早采取严格气候行动的必要性，有助于指导碳中和时间表的设定。

title: Between Toolkit and Theory: A Critical Review of Social Metabolism
affiliations: Universidad Pablo de Olavide, University of Granada - Department of Economic Theory and Economic History and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Between Toolkit and Theory: A Critical Review of Social Metabolism
detail.abstract: Social Metabolism (SM) has generated a growing body of literature. From its inception, SM carried a dual ambition: to develop biophysical accounting tools rather than solely in monetary units, and to build a theory of socio-ecological change. Yet methodological ambition has largely overshadowed the theoretical one, and the research communities that have developed around SM remain fragmented. No systematic theoretical characterization of these schools of thought currently exists. This paper proposes such a characterization. Building on a comprehensive bibliometric corpus of over 4,700 publications, we conduct a critical qualitative review that identifies four main schools of SM: the Vienna School (VS/MEFA), the MuSIASEM school, the Metabolic Rift school (MR), and the Social Agrarian Metabolism school (SAM). We compare them across six analytical dimensions: terminology and definitions, epistemological scope, operational tools, stock/flow vs. fund/flow approaches, main applications, and the integration of social variables. We examine not only how each school measures biophysical flows, but how it conceptualizes the relationship between society and nature and how far it has developed SM as a genuine socio-ecological theory. We conclude by identifying key challenges, including the need to recover the original theoretical ambition of SM as a comprehensive framework for understanding socio-ecological change

AI.tldr: 本文对4,700多篇社会代谢（SM）文献进行系统梳理，识别出四大主要学派（维也纳学派、MuSIASEM学派、代谢断裂学派、社会农业代谢学派），并从六个分析维度比较其理论和方法论差异，指出SM领域方法论主导而理论发展不足的问题，呼吁恢复其作为社会-生态变化综合框架的原始理论抱负。
AI.research_question: 社会代谢领域存在哪些不同的思想学派？这些学派在理论和方法论上如何区分？
AI.motivation: 社会代谢领域虽然文献数量快速增长，但方法论野心掩盖了理论抱负，研究社区碎片化，缺乏对各个思想学派的系统性理论特征描述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会代谢理论，包含生物物理核算工具与社会-生态变化理论的双重抱负，以及存量-流量（stock/flow）与基金-流量（fund/flow）两种分析框架。
AI.method: 基于4,700多篇出版物的综合文献计量语料库，进行批判性定性综述，从术语定义、认识论范围、操作工具、存量/流量与基金/流量方法、主要应用、社会变量整合六个维度比较四大流派。
AI.findings: 识别出SM领域的四大主要学派：维也纳学派（VS/MEFA）、MuSIASEM学派、代谢断裂学派（MR）和社会农业代谢学派（SAM）。各学派在六个分析维度上存在显著差异，且整体上方法论发展远超过理论构建。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对社会代谢领域进行系统的理论特征描述，识别和界定了四大主要学派的边界和特征，揭示了各学派在概念化社会与自然关系上的不同方式，指出SM作为社会-生态理论的发展程度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SM研究社区提供了一个清晰的学派分类框架，有助于跨学派交流和整合；指出了恢复SM原始理论抱负的必要性，为未来研究指明方向。

title: Patent Litigation Finance and the Venture Capital Myth

detail.title: Patent Litigation Finance and the Venture Capital Myth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Managing Director—IP Investments & General Counsel at Parabellum Capital, a commercial litigation finance firm. The article addresses claims about the patent litigation finance industry, in which Parabellum Capital is a market participant. The views expressed are the author's own and do not necessarily reflect those of Parabellum Capital.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This Article is a doctrinal and empirical analysis of public market data and published legal scholarship. It does not involve human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding.

detail.abstract:
A recent Sedona Conference Journal article contends that patent litigation funders employ a "venture capital model," financing high volumes of low-merit cases on the theory that occasional outsized winners will offset losses of 50 to 70 percent. The authors use that descriptive claim about how the asset class operates to motivate disclosure and fee-shifting reforms.

This Article shows that the VC model is not a strategy any rational patent litigation funder would pursue, and the available evidence indicates that none in fact does. The analysis proceeds along three lines.

The evidentiary basis for the VC model claim is one enforcement campaign and two individual cases. None produced the collectible outlier recovery the theory requires. The strategy also fails as a matter of fund mathematics. A portfolio carrying 50 to 70 percent losses requires winners large enough to cover the lost capital and clear the return hurdles that allow a manager to raise a successor fund. Patent damages are bounded by statute and doctrine, compressed on appeal, and realized over decade-long timelines. Recent empirical work shows damages awards above $500 million have a 0 percent survival rate on appeal. The patent system does not produce the collectible tail outcomes the VC model requires.

The publicly reported returns of Burford Capital and Omni Bridgeway, the two largest publicly traded funders, show loss rates of 15 and 22 percent of deployed capital and moderate, distributed winners rather than rare lottery payoffs. That is the opposite of a VC-style return profile.

Patent litigation finance is viable because competent practitioners do the opposite of what the VC model describes. The asset class rewards selectivity, not variance. Reform proposals grounded in an inaccurate description of the market produce unsound policy.

AI.tldr: 本文驳斥了"专利诉讼融资采用风险投资模式（VC模式）"的观点，指出该模式在数学上不成立、实证证据不支持，并基于Burford Capital和Omni Bridgeway的实际回报数据证明，成功的专利诉讼融资依赖选择而非分散押注。
AI.research_question: 专利诉讼融资是否真的采用风险投资（VC）模式——即通过大量投资低价值案件、依靠少数巨额胜诉来弥补高达50%-70%的损失？
AI.motivation: 此前有文献（如Sedona Conference Journal文章）声称专利诉讼融资采用VC模式，并以此主张信息披露和费用转移改革。作者认为这一描述不准确，会导致错误政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基金数学（portfolio mathematics）、专利损害赔偿的法律约束（法定上限、上诉压缩、十年周期）、尾部风险分析。
AI.method: 三重论证：（1）对VC模式主张所依赖的证据（一项执法行动+两个个案）进行检视；（2）从基金数学角度论证该模式不可行；（3）分析两家最大上市诉讼融资公司（Burford Capital、Omni Bridgeway）的公开回报数据。
AI.findings: （1）VC模式引用的证据无法产生所需的大额可执行胜诉回报；（2）专利损害赔偿受法律限制，超过5亿美元的赔偿上诉存活率为0%，无法产生VC所需的尾部收益；（3）两家最大融资公司的实际损失率为15%和22%，回报呈温和分布式，而非彩票式暴利。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了"专利诉讼融资是VC模式"这一被广泛引用但错误的学术描述，揭示了该资产类别的真实运作逻辑——选择性押注而非分散高风险投资。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者：基于错误市场描述（VC模式）提出的信息披露和费用转移改革将导致不当政策；真实的诉讼融资市场依赖审慎选择，具有可持续性。

title: Managing the Institutional Tradeoffs Between Water Market Efficiency and Reservoir Sustainability
affiliations: Regis University, Siena College and New Mexico State University

detail.title: Managing the Institutional Tradeoffs Between Water Market Efficiency and Reservoir Sustainability
detail.abstract: Climate change and prolonged drought are intensifying pressure on water allocation institutions in arid river basins worldwide. In the Lower Colorado River Basin, declining inflows and falling reservoir storage have renewed debate over how alternative allocation systems affect both economic performance and long-term hydrologic sustainability. While previous studies have examined water markets and economic efficiency, there remains a critical gap in understanding how institutional flexibility influences the tradeoff between consumptive water use and reservoir storage under climate drought. To address this gap, we use a dynamic, hydro-economic optimization model, calibrated to observed hydrologic and economic data between 2000 and 2021, to provide the first evidence of how water allocation institutions influence economic efficiency, water use, shadow prices, and reservoir storage. Three allocation institutions are evaluated: interstate markets, intrastate markets, and proportional sharing within state economic sectors. Results show that institutional flexibility increases economic efficiency but also increases pressure on reservoir storage. Interstate trading, the most flexible institution, generates the highest economic benefits and lowest marginal scarcity values, indicating more efficient reallocation of water to higher-valued uses. However, these gains are accompanied by lower average Lake Mead storage due to higher basin-wide consumptive use. In contrast, proportional sectoral sharing yields the lowest economic returns but conserves higher storage. Differences among institutions become more pronounced as drought severity increases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动态水文经济优化模型，评估了三种水分配制度（州际市场、州内市场、按比例行业共享）在科罗拉多河下游流域干旱条件下的经济效率与水库蓄水量的权衡关系，发现制度灵活性越高，经济效率越高，但水库蓄水压力也越大。
AI.research_question: 不同的水分配制度如何影响干旱流域的经济效率与水文可持续性（水库蓄水量）之间的权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注水市场和经济效率，但缺乏对制度灵活性如何影响消费性用水与水库蓄水之间权衡的理解，尤其是在气候干旱加剧的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水分配制度理论、水文经济学、制度灵活性理论、水资源稀缺性与影子价格理论。
AI.method: 动态水文经济优化模型，基于2000-2021年历史水文经济数据校准，对比评估三种水分配制度。
AI.findings: （1）制度灵活性提高经济效率，但增加水库蓄水压力；（2）州际市场最灵活，经济收益最高、边际稀缺值最低，但米德湖平均蓄水量最低；（3）按比例行业共享经济回报最低，但蓄水最多；（4）制度差异随干旱加剧而扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了制度灵活性在水资源分配中引发的经济效率与水库蓄水之间的结构性权衡关系，填补了制度设计与水文可持续性交叉研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为干旱流域的水资源管理政策制定者提供了不同制度选项下的经济与水文绩效比较，有助于平衡短期经济效益与长期蓄水安全。

title: Carving spaces for alternatives in a capitalist world? Political economy in pluriversal transformations
affiliations: University of Helsinki

detail.title: Carving spaces for alternatives in a capitalist world? Political economy in pluriversal transformations
detail.abstract: Strategies for post-growth transformations are increasingly turning toward "pluriversal" transformations: reducing social metabolism through locally embedded, small-scale initiatives grounded in alternative ontologies and epistemologies. This turn has reopened generative questions about what counts as transformation and whose knowledge legitimately organizes it. Yet recent critiques argue that pluriversal scholarship leaves the political-economic conditions in which such transformations are embedded largely unexamined. This paper asks how does the political-economic conditions shape the possibilities for pluriversal transformations? Drawing on 34 semi-structured interviews with government officials, municipal representatives, academics, NGOs, and indigenous community members in Ecuador - a country whose 2008 Constitution enshrined Buen Vivir, Rights of Nature, and a social and solidarity economy - the paper identifies how the different actors across grassroots and state saw transformations being shaped, enabled, and foreclosed. The findings reveal three interlocking tensions: an ontological conflict over what counts as economic value, structural fiscal and debt dependencies that locked the state into extractivism, and global political-economic pressures that wore down community alternatives even as they sustained non-monetary provisioning, food sovereignty, and resistance to mining. The paper argues that political economy is constitutive, not incidental, to pluriversal transformations, and that carving durable space for pluriversal alternatives requires a different political economy of the state - one capable of recognizing non-monetary value and shielding territorial alternatives from capital's expansionary logic. Whether this is possible within a global capitalist economy remains an open question, but one the field can no longer defer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过厄瓜多尔的案例研究，探讨政治经济条件如何塑造了"多元宇宙"转型的可能性，发现本体论冲突、财政债务依赖和全球政治经济压力三重张力限制了替代性发展路径的空间。
AI.research_question: 政治经济条件如何塑造多元宇宙转型的可能性？
AI.motivation: 多元宇宙转型文献转向关注本地化、小规模替代方案，但对其嵌入的政治经济条件缺乏考察，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元宇宙转型理论、政治经济学批判、本体论冲突理论
AI.method: 在厄瓜多尔开展34次半结构化访谈，受访者包括政府官员、市政代表、学者、NGO及原住民社区成员。
AI.findings: 揭示了三重交织的张力：1）关于何为经济价值的本体论冲突；2）结构性财政与债务依赖将国家锁定在采掘主义中；3）全球政治经济压力侵蚀社区替代方案，尽管这些方案仍在维持非货币化供给、粮食主权和反采矿抵抗。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证政治经济学是多元宇宙转型的构成性因素而非附带现象，拓展了多元宇宙转型研究的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出为多元宇宙替代方案开辟持久空间需要一种不同的国家政治经济学——能够承认非货币化价值并保护地方替代方案免受资本扩张逻辑侵蚀。

title: Designing results-based collective PES in Ecuadorian mangroves: an expert- and stakeholder-based analysis
affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Ecuador, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Designing results-based collective PES in Ecuadorian mangroves: an expert- and stakeholder-based analysis
detail.abstract: Mangrove ecosystems are vital common-pool resources which are under threat. Collective payments for ecosystem services (cPES) are suitable schemes for ensuring their conservation. However, there is an important knowledge gap on how the type of payment—compensatory or incentivizing, practice- or results-based—determines resource users’ willingness to accept (WTA) for participation in these voluntary schemes, especially in the context of mangroves. Drawing on a case study of Ecuadorian mangroves where an unsuccessful cPES scheme has been implemented, the present study relies on a best-worst discrete choice experiment (BWDCE) and an indirect valuation approach using experts’ and resource users’ choice information. Results reveal a significant discrepancy between expert predictions and user preferences: while experts favor stringent results-based targets and compensatory collective payments, resource users strongly prefer incentives, especially collective ones. Furthermore, resource users accept moderate ecological targets but reject highly stringent requirements and increases in the minimum eligible area. Transitioning toward more enabling cPES designs—characterized by moderate conditionality and collective incentives—can bridge the gap between technical conservation goals and local management logic, ultimately strengthening mangrove governance and coastal resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过厄瓜多尔红树林案例研究，发现专家偏好严格的结果导向补偿支付，而资源使用者更偏好集体激励支付。支付类型（补偿性vs激励性、实践导向vs结果导向）显著影响用户参与集体生态系统服务支付计划的意愿。转向适度条件性和集体激励的设计能弥合技术保护目标与地方管理逻辑之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 支付类型（补偿性vs激励性、实践导向vs结果导向）如何决定资源使用者参与集体生态系统服务支付计划的接受意愿（WTA）？
AI.motivation: 红树林生态系统作为重要的公共池资源正面临威胁，集体PES是有效的保护方案，但现有研究对支付类型如何影响资源使用者参与意愿存在重要知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体行动理论、公共池资源理论、生态系统服务付费（PES）设计理论（支付类型：补偿性vs激励性、实践导向vs结果导向）
AI.method: 采用最佳-最差离散选择实验（BWDCE）和间接估值方法，结合专家与资源使用者的选择信息进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1）专家偏好严格的结果导向目标和补偿性集体支付；2）资源使用者强烈偏好激励性支付，尤其是集体激励；3）资源使用者接受适度生态目标，但拒绝高严格性要求和最低合格面积增加；4）专家与使用者偏好存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了支付类型（补偿性vs激励性、实践导向vs结果导向）对集体PES参与意愿的差异化影响机制，弥合了技术保护目标与地方管理逻辑之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为红树林集体PES方案设计提供实证依据：应采用适度条件性和集体激励的赋能型设计，以增强红树林治理和海岸韧性。

title: Thematic Evolution and Collaboration Networks in Character Education: A Bibliometric Perspective
affiliations: Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute, Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute and Ahmad Dahlan Probolinggo Institute

detail.title: Thematic Evolution and Collaboration Networks in Character Education: A Bibliometric Perspective
detail.abstract: This study seeks to map the dynamics of publication, thematic evolution, and international collaboration in character education research, while also identifying dominant knowledge structures and future research directions aligned with digital ethics and Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education). As education systems confront complex challenges including cyberbullying, disinformation, academic dishonesty, and AI-mediated ethical dilemmas character education has gained strategic relevance. However, its intellectual landscape and global interconnectivity remain underexplored. Using a bibliometric approach based on the Scopus database (2020–2026; article type; English language), an initial pool of 15,295 records was screened according to eligibility criteria, yielding a final dataset of 723 articles. Data were analysed using Biblioshiny (Bibliometrix-R) to examine publication trends, disciplinary distribution, influential sources and authors, keyword co-occurrence, thematic development, and international co-authorship networks. Findings indicate a steady increase in scholarly interest, with publications rising from approximately 135 documents in 2020 to over 150 in 2024, before declining slightly in 2025–2026. The field is dominated by Social Sciences (29.9%), followed by Computer Science (13.6%) and Arts & Humanities (9.7%), reflecting its multidisciplinary growth. Indonesia (~200 documents), China (~170), and the United States (>110) are the most prolific contributors. Thematic analysis highlights emerging clusters in digital ethics, socio-emotional literacy, and the integration of local cultural values. Strong linkages between “collaboration networks”, “bibliometric analysis”, and “character education” were also identified as motor themes. In sum, this longitudinal bibliometric analysis offers empirical insights to inform curriculum innovation, policy development, and future research. Strengthening international collaboration and embedding ethical, technology-informed pedagogies are critical to addressing contemporary moral challenges and advancing SDG 4.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Scopus数据库（2020–2026年）对723篇品格教育文献进行文献计量分析，发现该领域出版量稳步增长，由社会科学（29.9%）、计算机科学（13.6%）和人文艺术（9.7%）主导，印尼、中国和美国是主要贡献国。研究揭示了数字伦理、社会情感素养等新兴主题，强调加强国际合作与嵌入技术导向的道德教育对于实现SDG 4（优质教育）至关重要。
AI.research_question: 品格教育研究的出版动态、主题演变与国际合作格局如何？其主导知识结构和未来研究方向（与数字伦理和SDG 4相关）是什么？
AI.motivation: 教育系统面临网络欺凌、虚假信息、学术不端和AI伦理困境等复杂挑战，品格教育战略意义上升，但其知识图景和全球互联性尚缺乏系统探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学与科学知识图谱理论；品格教育理论；数字伦理框架；SDG 4（优质教育）目标框架。
AI.method: 文献计量分析法。数据来自Scopus数据库（2020–2026年，文章类型，英文），初始15,295条记录经筛选后最终获得723篇文章。使用Biblioshiny（Bibliometrix-R）分析出版趋势、学科分布、影响力来源/作者、关键词共现、主题演化及国际合作网络。
AI.findings: （1）出版量稳步增长，2020年约135篇增至2024年超150篇，2025–2026年略有下降；（2）社会科学（29.9%）、计算机科学（13.6%）和人文艺术（9.7%）主导，呈现多学科特征；（3）印尼（~200篇）、中国（~170篇）和美国（>110篇）产出最高；（4）新兴主题：数字伦理、社会情感素养、本土文化价值观整合；（5）“合作网络”“文献计量分析”与“品格教育”构成核心驱动主题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统绘制了品格教育研究的纵向知识图谱，揭示了该领域从传统道德教育向数字伦理与技术融合方向的演变趋势，丰富了数字时代品格教育的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为课程创新、政策制定及未来研究提供实证依据；强调加强国际合作、嵌入技术导向的道德教育以应对当代道德挑战并推进SDG 4的实现。

title: Social Identity and Human-AI Task Allocation
affiliations: Lingnan University - Department of Economics,  and Jinan University - Institute for Economic and Social Research

detail.title: Social Identity and Human-AI Task Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by Lingnan University Institutional Review Board. Each participant provided informed consent to participate in the experiment at the beginning of the study.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge the financial support from the Research Grants Council (Project Code: 23601924) and the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 72503230).

detail.abstract: We extend social identity theory to study human-AI trade-offs in hiring contexts. In a baseline experiment, representative U.S. participants allocate tasks between a human worker and either another human, ChatGPT, or the foreign model DeepSeek, with explicitly varied productivity. On average, people incur costs to under-allocate tasks to AI, particularly DeepSeek. Two additional experiments, inducing identities on workers via minimal-group and political affiliations, reveal a hierarchy: in-group humans receive the most, followed comparably by out-group humans and in-group AI, and out-group AI receives the fewest. Individual perceived social distance to AI and groupy tendency jointly shape the task allocation decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文拓展社会认同理论，研究招聘情境中人类与AI的权衡。实验发现，人们会倾向于少分配给AI（尤其是DeepSeek）任务。通过最小群体和政治 affiliation 诱导身份认同后，发现任务分配存在层级：内群体人类最多，外群体人类与内群体AI次之，外群体AI最少。个体感知的社会距离和群体倾向共同影响决策。
AI.research_question: 在招聘情境中，社会认同如何影响人们对人类与AI（特别是不同国籍的AI模型）之间的任务分配决策？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在招聘等商业场景中的广泛应用，人们如何权衡人类与AI的工作分配尚不明确。现有研究较少从社会认同理论视角探讨AI国籍身份对分配偏好的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同理论（Social Identity Theory）
AI.method: 三项实验研究：基线实验（美国被试在人类、ChatGPT、DeepSeek之间分配任务）；两个额外实验（分别通过最小群体范式和政治 affiliation 诱导身份认同）。
AI.findings: 1）人们倾向于少分配给AI（尤其是DeepSeek）任务；2）任务分配存在层级：内群体人类 > 外群体人类≈内群体AI > 外群体AI；3）个体感知的社会距离和群体倾向共同影响分配决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会认同理论从人际情境拓展至人机交互情境，揭示了AI的"国籍身份"会触发社会认同过程，影响人们的经济决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业引入AI（尤其是外国AI模型）提供决策参考，提醒管理者注意员工可能因社会认同偏见而低效分配任务给AI，需设计干预措施缓解这一偏差。

title: Path to Viksit Bharat: A Seven-Phase Analysis of India's Economic Transformation, 1947-2025
affiliations: Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics

detail.title: Path to Viksit Bharat: A Seven-Phase Analysis of India's Economic Transformation, 1947-2025
detail.abstract: The paper analyses India's economic development from 1947 to 2025 through a seven-phase framework capturing major shifts in policy orientation, institutional evolution, and structural transformation. The study has used a qualitative historical-analytical design supported by secondary data from national statistical sources and international databases, the study traces India's transition from a state-led, agrarian economy to a service-led emerging market. The analysis shows that while the Green Revolution, the 1991 liberalisation reforms, and the post-2000 IT expansion generated significant productivity gains and enabled global integration, India's structural transformation has remained incomplete. Manufacturing has stagnated, labour absorption has been limited, and regional and gender disparities have persisted despite recent improvements in digital governance, financial inclusion, and public service delivery. The paper contributes to the development studies literature by integrating long-term historical evidence with contemporary policy outcomes to highlight the interaction between institutional reforms, sectoral dynamics, and distributional challenges. The findings suggest that realising the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 requires a strategic shift toward employment-intensive industrialisation, human capital strengthening, expansion of female labour force participation, agricultural modernisation, and greater investment in innovation and climate resilience. The study provides a synthesised framework for understanding India's development trajectory and outlines policy priorities for achieving inclusive and sustainable high-income growth.

AI.tldr: 本文通过七阶段框架分析了印度1947-2025年的经济发展，指出其从国家主导的农业经济转型为服务业主导的新兴市场，但结构性转型不完整，制造业停滞、劳动吸收有限、区域与性别差距持续存在。实现"Viksit Bharat 2047"愿景需转向就业密集型工业化、人力资本强化和女性劳动力参与提升。
AI.research_question: 印度1947年至2025年的经济发展经历了怎样的阶段演变？其结构性转型为何不完整？实现高收入增长需要怎样的政策路径？
AI.motivation: 印度经济发展虽取得显著成就（绿色革命、1991年自由化、IT扩张），但制造业停滞、劳动吸收不足、区域与性别不平等依然突出。现有研究缺乏对长期历史证据与当代政策结果的系统整合，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展经济学中的结构性转型理论、制度变迁理论，以及关于国家主导发展、自由化改革、服务业主导增长与工业化关系的文献。
AI.method: 定性历史分析设计，辅以来自国家统计机构与国际数据库的二手数据。
AI.findings: 1. 印度经历了七个阶段的政策与制度演变；2. 绿色革命、1991年自由化改革、2000年后IT扩张带来显著生产力提升和全球整合；3. 结构性转型不完整：制造业停滞、劳动吸收有限、区域与性别差距持续存在；4. 数字治理、金融包容性和公共服务有所改善但仍不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将长期历史证据与当代政策结果相结合，揭示了制度变革、部门动态与分配挑战之间的互动关系，为发展研究文献提供了综合性的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实现"Viksit Bharat 2047"愿景提出了具体政策优先方向：就业密集型工业化、人力资本强化、扩大女性劳动参与、农业现代化、增加创新与气候韧性投资。

title: Risk Factor Disclosure Summaries
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Risk Factor Disclosure Summaries
detail.abstract: Since 2005, the SEC has mandated that firms include Risk Factor Disclosures (RFDs) in annual 10-K filings. In 2020, this mandate was “modernized” and now requires the inclusion of a two-page summary section for RFDs longer than 15 pages. On the one hand, the SEC contends that this summary requirement should benefit investors, especially those who have less time to review and analyze registrants’ disclosure. On the other hand, firms may not include all material risks in a summary, and, if some investors fixate on summaries, gaps in understanding risks may widen among investors. We use summaries generated by a large language model (LLM) as a benchmark to examine the information content of firm-disclosed summaries. Our evidence suggests that, relative to the LLM-generated summaries, firm-disclosed summaries are more positively toned, less specific, easier to read, and more likely to omit firm-idiosyncratic risks such as strategic, legal, and human-capital risks. Our results also suggest that summaries that deviate more from the LLM benchmark are associated with higher information asymmetry, uncertainty, and disagreement around the 10-K filing date. These effects do not appear to be explained by changes in risks disclosed in the full RFD surrounding the Modernization or lookahead bias in our benchmark summary generation. Overall, our results suggest that the summary requirement in the SEC’s 2020 Modernization may have led to unintended negative consequences, at least over the initial years that are covered by our sample.

AI.tldr: 本文利用LLM生成的摘要作为基准，检验SEC强制要求的风险因素披露摘要的信息含量，发现公司披露的摘要更积极、更易读但更缺乏特异性，且偏离LLM基准越大的摘要与更高的信息不对称、不确定性和分歧相关，表明SEC 2020年现代化规则可能产生了意想不到的负面后果。
AI.research_question: SEC 2020年要求公司在10-K文件中包含风险因素披露摘要的现代化规定，对公司披露摘要的信息含量有何影响？这些摘要是否导致了投资者之间的信息差距？
AI.motivation: SEC声称摘要要求应有利于投资者（尤其是时间有限的投资者），但公司可能不会在摘要中包含所有重大风险，如果部分投资者仅关注摘要，可能会加剧投资者之间的风险理解差距。作者希望检验这一监管规定的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、信息不对称理论、投资者注意力有限理论
AI.method: 以LLM（大语言模型）生成的摘要作为基准，比较公司自行披露的摘要与LLM摘要之间的差异，并分析这些差异与10-K申报日前后信息不对称、不确定性和投资者分歧的关联。
AI.findings: 相比LLM生成的摘要，公司披露的摘要语气更积极、更易读、特异性更低，且更可能省略战略、法律和人力资本等公司特定风险；偏离LLM基准越大的摘要，在10-K申报日附近的信息不对称、不确定性和分歧越高；这些效应不能用风险变化或前瞻性偏差解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管规定在信息披露实践中可能产生的 unintended consequences（意外后果），丰富了关于风险因素披露摘要信息含量的理论理解，展示了LLM在会计和金融研究中的新应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SEC评估和修订风险因素披露现代化规则提供了经验证据；提醒投资者注意公司披露摘要可能存在的系统性偏见；展示了LLM作为信息披露质量基准工具的实用价值。

title: Locally Conservative, Globally Not: Diagnosing the Lagrangian Structure of Pretrained Transformers

detail.title: Locally Conservative, Globally Not: Diagnosing the Lagrangian Structure of Pretrained Transformers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently, outside the scope of any employment, with no external funding, no financial relationships with any organization relevant to the subject of this work, and no personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involves no human participants, patient data, clinical studies, or personal data of any kind. All experiments were conducted on publicly available pretrained language models (GPT-2, Pythia) and synthetic text corpora.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. This research was self-funded and conducted independently.

detail.abstract: We give an exact mechanical interpretation of the cosine Semantic Tube Prediction (STP) loss of Huang et al. (2026) and use it to construct a static architectural diagnostic for the global Lagrangian structure of pretrained transformers. The mathematical core is the closed-form identity  L_STP = 1 − √(1 − |a⊥|² / |d₂|²) , which relates the cosine STP loss between three consecutive hidden states to the magnitude of the component of acceleration normal to the trajectory; we prove the identity algebraically and verify it to machine precision across 1,314 consecutive triplets on GPT-2. Two structural consequences follow immediately: STP loss is blind to the tangential component of acceleration, which we measure to be approximately twice the normal component on GPT-2, and deceleration along the trajectory is the direct mechanical signature of a learned restoring force, with 97.9% of triplets decelerating and a permutation null at z <-11 establishing that sequential token order produces significantly smoother trajectories than random orderings. Both findings replicate on Pythia-160M. These descriptive results establish local hallmarks of damped Lagrangian flow on a bounded attractive potential as a property of trained attention transformers. The natural follow-up-whether the per-layer hidden-state updates globally derive from a single shared scalar potential-is empirically testable. We fit the joint regression Δh_ℓ ≈ α_ℓ · v_ℓ − β_ℓ · ∇V_ψ(h_ℓ) across all layers with a single learned V ψ on frozen checkpoints, and obtain a three-way architectural separator on Tiny Shakespeare: a weight-tied scalar-potential autoregressive flow (used here as a positive control) attains median per-layer test R 2 = 0.957 with a uniform layer profile; a scale-and data-matched 8M-parameter GPT-2-style decoder reaches R 2 = 0.54 with monotonic decay; pretrained GPT-2 small reaches R 2 = 0.46 with a bathtub profile (middle-band mean 0.09). Three independent controls rule out alternative explanations: an oracle fit using the positive control's own potential attains R 2 = 0.931 on the LayerNorm variant (and 1.0000 on the base architecture); a V ψ capacity sweep over a 16× parameter band rules out expressivity limitation; and the separation reproduces under orthogonal token-direction coordinates. All three architectures pass a velocity-aware Jacobian-symmetry test at PCA-16, making local per-step conservativity universal while global shared-potential structure remains architectural. We therefore characterise the Lagrangian content of trained attention transformers as locally conservative but globally not derivable from a shared scalar potential. We provide both a sharper reading of what STP-style training objectives do and do not measure, and a reproducible architectural diagnostic that other globally-Lagrangian designs can be evaluated against.

AI.tldr: 本文从力学角度解释余弦STP损失，证明其仅对加速度法向分量敏感而忽略切向分量，并发现预训练Transformer的隐藏态更新具有局部保守性但全局不可由单一标量势导出，提出了一个可复现的全局拉格朗日结构诊断方法。
AI.research_question: 预训练Transformer的隐藏态序列是否具有全局拉格朗日结构（即是否可由单一共享标量势函数导出）？
AI.motivation: 已有STP损失在语义表征学习中广泛应用，但其物理含义不清晰；同时，理解Transformer隐藏态的动态结构对于解释其工作机制和指导架构设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉格朗日力学（加速度分解为法向与切向分量）、余弦STP损失的封闭形式恒等式、标量势回归模型、雅可比对称性检验。
AI.method: 1. 从代数上证明STP损失与加速度法向分量的恒等关系，并在GPT-2上数值验证；2. 在GPT-2和Pythia-160M上测量法向/切向加速度及减速比例；3. 构建联合回归模型 Δhℓ ≈ αℓ·vℓ − βℓ·∇Vψ(hℓ)，在Tiny Shakespeare上比较权重共享标量流、GPT-2风格解码器和预训练GPT-2 small三种架构；4. 通过势函数容量扫描、正交坐标变换、雅可比对称性检验等排除替代解释。
AI.findings: 1. STP损失 = 1 − √(1 − |a⊥|²/|d₂|²)，仅对法向加速度敏感；2. GPT-2上切向加速度约为法向的2倍，97.9%三元组减速；3. 三种架构在全局共享势回归上分离：权重共享流R²=0.957（均匀分布），GPT-2风格解码器R²=0.54（单调衰减），GPT-2 small R²=0.46（浴盆形状，中间层均值仅0.09）；4. 所有架构通过局部雅可比对称性检验，说明局部保守性普遍存在，但全局共享势结构因架构而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 给出了余弦STP损失的精确力学解释，澄清了该损失的测量边界；2. 提出了"局部保守但全局非共享势"的Transformer动态特征刻画；3. 建立了从力学角度分析自注意力模型隐藏态序列的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个可复现的架构诊断方法，用于评估模型是否具有全局拉格朗日结构；2. 揭示了STP训练目标的测量盲区，为改进表征学习目标函数提供方向；3. 为设计具有理想动力学性质的Transformer架构提供了评估基准。

title: Born Too Early: Perceived Recency Discontinuity and Scientific Recognition
affiliations: and Dalian University of Technology

detail.title: Born Too Early: Perceived Recency Discontinuity and Scientific Recognition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Temporal labels, such as years, months, and quarters, are common ways of representing time, yet they are often treated as neutral background information. We find evidence of a temporal-labeling mechanism in which coarse-grained labels divide continuous time into discrete stages, making adjacent objects appear more or less recent than they objectively are and thereby shaping judgment and choice. We define this label-induced discontinuity in recognition as the Perceived Recency Discontinuity (PRD) effect. We formalize how temporal labels transform objective age into subjective age and generate perceived recency differences that can affect behavior. Scientific citation provides an especially suitable setting for observing the PRD effect. Using 71,257 FT50 journal papers and more than 13.61 million citation events, we construct a regression discontinuity design around year boundaries. Papers published just before a year boundary receive about 14 fewer citations within five years than those published just after it, corresponding to a 19.6% citation advantage for papers on the right side of the boundary. A behavioral experiment on reference selection provides micro-level evidence consistent with the interpretation that year labels shift perceived recency. The findings show that formal temporal labels are institutionalized signals that shape judgment, opportunity allocation, and downstream outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现时间标签（如年份）会引发"感知新近度不连续"（PRD）效应：粗粒度标签将连续时间划分为离散阶段，使相邻物体看起来比实际更新或更旧。基于71,257篇FT50期刊论文和超过1,361万次引用数据的断点回归设计表明，在年份边界前后发表的文章，五年内引用量相差约14次（右侧优势达19.6%）。行为实验进一步验证了年份标签通过影响感知新近度来塑造判断和选择。
AI.research_question: 时间标签（如年份、月份）如何通过划分连续时间影响人们对物体"新近度"的感知，进而影响判断与决策？
AI.motivation: 时间标签常被视为中立的背景信息，但研究者推测粗粒度标签可能人为制造时间上的不连续性，使客观上相近的时间点被感知为"上一阶段"与"下一阶段"，从而产生系统性偏差。现有文献对标签如何塑造时间感知及行为后果的实证证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知新近度不连续（PRD）效应：粗粒度标签将连续时间切割为离散阶段，导致位于标签两侧的相邻对象在主观感知上出现新近度差异，即使客观时间间隔极小。
AI.method: 1）回归断点设计（RDD）：利用71,257篇FT50期刊论文及超过1,361万次引用事件，在年份边界处分析引用差异。2）行为实验：通过参考选择任务提供微观层面的机制证据。
AI.findings: 年份边界处存在显著的不连续性：刚过年份边界发表的论文比刚好在边界前发表的论文五年内多获得约14次引用（约19.6%的优势）。行为实验证实，年份标签确实改变了人们对新近度的主观感知，而非完全由客观质量差异驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"感知新近度不连续（PRD）效应"，将时间标签从"中性背景"重新概念化为"制度化信号"，揭示了标签如何通过影响主观时间感知来塑造行为，拓展了时间认知与社会判断交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒学术评价、出版策略、成果评估等实践中注意时间标签带来的系统性偏差；研究者可优化投稿时机（如选择在年份边界后发表）以获得认知优势；政策制定者在设计评估体系时应考虑标签效应，减少人为时间划分带来的不公平。

title: Key Patents and Economic Performance: Patent Quality, Technological Innovation, and Growth in Knowledge-Based Economies
affiliations: and

detail.title: Key Patents and Economic Performance: Patent Quality, Technological Innovation, and Growth in Knowledge-Based Economies
detail.abstract:
In knowledge-based economies, technological innovation capability, intangible assets, and intellectual property are becoming increasingly important for long-term economic performance. Patent data are widely used as indicators of innovation; however, simple patent counts do not adequately capture the quality, technological relevance, or international market coverage of individual patents. This paper therefore examines the extent to which key patents can serve as a quality-oriented indicator of technological innovation capability for analysing economic performance. Key patents are understood as particularly high-quality patents in relevant key technologies, whose patent strength derives from technological relevance and international market coverage.

The paper combines a conceptual analysis of the key patent approach with literature from growth and innovation economics, as well as with an exploratory empirical plausibility assessment based on a global patent dataset on world-class patents in future technologies (Breitinger et al., 2020). Economic performance is operationalised empirically through per capita income. The empirical evidence is assessed from two complementary perspectives: an international cross-section of high-income economies and a dynamic analysis of the United States, which held a particularly prominent position in high-quality patenting across key future technologies during the period under observation. In both perspectives, the findings point to a positive association between key patents and per capita income. They should not, however, be interpreted as evidence of causality, but as empirically grounded support for the plausibility of this relationship.

The contribution of this paper lies in positioning key patents as a differentiated innovation indicator that takes patent quality, technological relevance, and international reach more fully into account than mere patent volumes. The key patent approach thus offers a scientifically grounded perspective on innovation capability and economic performance in knowledge-based economies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨关键专利作为技术创新能力质量导向指标的有效性，发现关键专利与人均收入之间存在正向关联，但非因果关系。
AI.research_question: 关键专利能否作为衡量技术创新能力的质量导向指标，用以分析经济绩效？
AI.motivation: 简单的专利数量无法充分反映专利的质量、技术相关性和国际市场覆盖度，需要更精细的指标来衡量知识经济中的创新能力与经济表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于增长经济学与创新经济学理论，结合关键专利方法（Key Patent Approach）进行概念分析。
AI.method: 概念分析结合探索性实证合理性评估：使用全球专利数据集（未来技术中的世界级专利），从高收入经济体的国际横截面和美国动态分析两个视角进行检验。
AI.findings: 关键专利与人均收入之间存在正向关联，但该关联不应被解释为因果关系，而是为关系的合理性提供经验支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 将关键专利定位为一种差异化的创新指标，比单纯专利数量更充分地考虑专利质量、技术相关性和国际覆盖度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识经济中创新能力和经济绩效的分析提供了基于科学的视角，有助于政策制定者和研究者更准确地评估技术创新对经济的影响。

reference: Patricia Mindus, Martijn Stronks and Rebecca Thornburn Stern (eds.), Time and Temporalities in Migration Law, Hart
title: Migration, Identity, and Time: The Experiences of Queer Iranians in Exile
affiliations: University of Sussex

detail.title: Migration, Identity, and Time: The Experiences of Queer Iranians in Exile

declarations.ethicsApproval: This project received ethical approval from the University of Sussex Social Sciences and Arts Research Ethics Committee, Reference No. ER/NF213/2.
declarations.funderStatement: ‘Negotiating Queer Identities Following Forced Migration: A Comparative Study of Iranian Queer Refugees Living in Turkey, the UK and Canada’ (NQIfFM), https://iranqueerefugee.net/. The support of the Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC) is gratefully acknowledged (Grant Ref: ES/V017497/1).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Patricia Mindus, Martijn Stronks and Rebecca Thornburn Stern (eds.), Time and Temporalities in Migration Law, Hart

detail.abstract: In this contribution, I discuss the perceptions, experiences and impact of time in the lives and journeys of people who have left Iran to escape persecution or discrimination on SOGIESC grounds. By analysing semi-structured interviews and poetry workshops carried out with migrants and other stakeholders in the project ‘Negotiating Queer Identities Following Forced Migration’ (https://iranqueerefugee.net/), I explore the role of time in the journeys of queer Iranians in exile in three country case studies generally seen as being of transition (Turkey), destination (UK) or resettlement (Canada). Against the background of literature on the role of time in migration law and policy, I examine how time is a constant concern in the experiences of queer Iranians in exile, but how it simultaneously manifests in positive ways. This piece thereby makes an empirically and theoretically-based original contribution to the literature on time and migration by highlighting the productively contradictory experiences of time.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了因SOGIESC原因逃离伊朗的酷儿移民在土耳其、英国和加拿大三个国家中对时间的不同体验，揭示了时间既是压迫性力量也能产生积极体验的矛盾特征。
AI.research_question: 时间如何影响因SOGIESC原因被迫流亡的伊朗酷儿移民的生活经历和旅程？
AI.motivation: 现有移民法律与政策中的时间维度研究多关注其压迫性，但忽略了时间在酷儿流亡者生活中可能产生的积极面向，因此需要更全面地理解时间的矛盾性体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民法律与政策中的时间理论；酷儿流亡研究；时间的社会建构理论。
AI.method: 半结构化访谈和诗歌工作坊；项目"Negotiating Queer Identities Following Forced Migration"；三个国家案例：土耳其（过渡国）、英国（目的地国）、加拿大（重新安置国）。
AI.findings: 时间在酷儿伊朗流亡者的生活中是持续性的关注点，但同时以积极的方式显现；时间体验具有生产性的矛盾特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于时间与移民文献的经验和理论贡献，突出了时间体验的生产性矛盾性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定者和支持酷儿流亡者的实践工作者提供了对时间维度更细致的理解。

title:
When Systems Reject their Leaders: A Cybernetic Analysis of Project Cybersyn and the Limits of Public Sector Leadership
Development

detail.title:
When Systems Reject their Leaders: A Cybernetic Analysis of Project Cybersyn and the Limits of Public Sector Leadership
Development
detail.abstract:
This paper addresses a persistent contradiction in public leadership development: substantial investment in competency-based leadership programs has not consistently translated into system-level transformation. Recent scholarship increasingly argues that leadership development remains theoretically fragmented and conceptually underdeveloped (Marcy, 2023). Existing approaches largely assume that stronger leaders produce stronger institutions. Yet highly capable leaders and sophisticated interventions frequently fail to generate sustainable change in complex public systems.

Using Project Cybersyn as a theory-driven case, this study examines why leadership-driven innovation may fail despite exceptional expertise and advanced system design. The paper proposes meta-capacity as a system-level construct and integrates it with the Systemic Hierarchy of Value and Scale (SHVS) framework. It argues that leadership effectiveness depends not only on leadership capability itself, but on the alignment between intervention complexity and the capacity of hierarchical systems to absorb, coordinate, and sustain change.

The study reframes leadership failure as a problem of systemic misalignment rather than individual deficit, offering a new explanation for why highly capable leaders and advanced reforms may fail to produce sustainable transformation in complex public systems.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"强领导者产生强制度"的传统假设，提出领导力效能取决于干预复杂性与系统层级吸收能力之间的匹配，而非领导者个人能力本身。
AI.research_question: 为什么在公共领导力开发领域，大量投入的能力导向项目未能持续转化为系统层面的转型？为什么高度专业的领导者与先进干预在复杂公共系统中经常失败？
AI.motivation: 领导力开发领域存在一个持续矛盾：巨额投资未能带来系统级转型；现有理论碎片化且概念发展不足；"强领导者→强制度"的线性假设在实践中屡遭失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元能力（Meta-capacity）概念；系统层次的价值观与规模层级框架（SHVS）。
AI.method: 以"协同计划"（Project Cybersyn）为理论驱动案例的质性研究。
AI.findings: 领导力效能不仅取决于领导能力本身，更取决于干预复杂度与层级系统吸收、协调和维持变革能力之间的匹配度；领导力失败应重新定义为系统错配问题而非个人缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"元能力"这一系统层面的新构念；整合了SHVS框架来解释领导力失败的系统性原因；挑战了主流的个体主义领导力范式，将失败重新理论化为系统错配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共领导力开发项目提供设计启示：干预的复杂度需与系统吸收能力相匹配；避免过度投资于个体能力而忽视系统层面的变革承载力。

title: The Gender Gap on the Socio-cultural Cleavage
affiliations: , University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Political Science Department, Centre for Socio-Political Data and University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

detail.title: The Gender Gap on the Socio-cultural Cleavage

declarations.ethicsApproval: Obtained ethical approval for the subject study (survey and interviews) conducted in The Netherlands.

detail.abstract: This paper explains the contemporary gender gap in voting as a life-course outcome of gendered sorting in education and work. Drawing on social role theory, we argue that the gender gap is linked to the division of labor in which women and men disproportionately enter different fields of study and occupational environments. We test the effect of socialization in education and work using cross-national surveys and longitudinal panels. Sequential mediation analysis shows that differences in educational and occupational field account for a substantial share of the gender gap in voting on the socio-cultural cleavage. Within-person panel estimates indicate that entering higher education, especially into fields with high cultural-communicative content, is followed by shifts toward socio-liberal or GAL/Green support. Gendered pathways through education and employment help to translate contrasting roles in the division of labor into the contemporary gender gap.

AI.tldr: 本文基于社会角色理论，利用跨国调查和纵向面板数据，通过中介分析和个体内面板估计，证明教育和职业领域的性别分化（女性更多进入文化传播领域）是解释当代投票性别差距的关键机制。进入高等教育（尤其是文化传播类领域）会推动个体向社会自由派或绿色政党转向。
AI.research_question: 当代投票行为中的性别差距（gender gap）是如何形成的？教育和职业领域中的性别分化（gendered sorting）在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 以往研究关注性别差距本身，但对性别差距如何通过生命历程（life-course）中的教育和职业社会化过程而产出的机制解释不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会角色理论（Social Role Theory）：性别分工导致女性和男性进入不同的学习领域和职业环境，这种社会化过程塑造了政治态度和投票偏好。
AI.method: 1）跨国调查数据（cross-national surveys）与纵向面板数据（longitudinal panels）相结合；2）序贯中介分析（Sequential mediation analysis）检验教育和职业领域的中介效应；3）个体内面板估计（Within-person panel estimates）考察进入高等教育及不同学科领域对投票偏好的因果影响。
AI.findings: 1）教育和职业领域的性别差异解释了社会文化议题上投票性别差距的很大一部分；2）进入高等教育，尤其是高文化传播性（cultural-communicative content）的领域，会推动个体向社会自由派或绿色政党（GAL/Green）方向转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会角色理论拓展到政治行为领域，阐明了性别分工如何通过教育和职业的社会化路径转化为当代投票性别差距的生命历程机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了教育和职业分化是政治性别差距的深层根源，提示政策制定者关注教育选择和职业环境中的性别平等对政治代表性及公民政治参与的长期影响。

title: Towards Visualising the Scottish Housing System: An Exploratory Heuristic Model to Support Policy and Practice

detail.title: Towards Visualising the Scottish Housing System: An Exploratory Heuristic Model to Support Policy and Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: The term 'housing system' is increasingly used in housing debates but remains comparatively underdefined, underexplored and under-visualised. Moreover, policy and practice tend to favour a siloed tenure-based approach, contributing to system-level incoherence and unequal and unintended housing outcomes. This is problematic in the context of the Scottish housing emergency. A key challenge in addressing these limitations is that the housing system is complex and difficult to conceptualise and comprehend. Adopting a systems perspective, this paper responds to the challenge through the development of a heuristic model of the Scottish housing system, which can help policymakers and practitioners to visualise and better understand the system as a whole, ultimately allowing for more coherent interventions and practice. The model brings together sources of demand and supply, system levers and support mechanisms, system barriers, and detrimental housing outcomes within a single visual framework. The model is intended as an exploratory heuristic framework designed to support housing system visualisation and policy discussion, while presenting opportunities for future development and comparative application.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"住房系统"概念定义不足、可视化缺乏的问题，通过系统视角开发了一个苏格兰住房系统的启发式模型，将需求与供给来源、系统杠杆与支持机制、系统障碍以及不良住房结果整合在一个视觉框架中，旨在帮助政策制定者和实践者更好地理解和可视化整个住房系统，从而制定更连贯的干预措施。
AI.research_question: 如何通过启发式模型帮助政策制定者和实践者可视化并更好地理解苏格兰住房系统，以实现更连贯的政策干预？
AI.motivation: "住房系统"概念在住房讨论中使用日益增多，但缺乏明确定义、深入探索和可视化呈现；政策实践倾向于采用孤立的 tenure-based（基于产权/租住权类型）方法，导致系统层面的不连贯以及不平等和非预期的住房结果；这在苏格兰住房紧急状态的背景下尤为严峻。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统视角（Systems Perspective）；启发式模型（Heuristic Model）——旨在作为探索性框架支持住房系统可视化和政策讨论，而非精确的预测性工具。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性方法——基于系统视角开发启发式模型，整合需求与供给、系统杠杆与支持机制、系统障碍及不良住房结果等要素。
AI.findings: 提出了一个整合性视觉框架，该模型将住房系统的四个核心维度（需求与供给来源、系统杠杆与支持机制、系统障碍、不良住房结果）纳入统一框架，有助于政策制定者和实践者理解系统整体而非碎片化视角，为更连贯的政策干预提供基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"住房系统"概念提供了更具操作性的定义和可视化框架；将系统视角引入住房研究领域；提出启发式模型作为探索性工具，为未来理论发展和比较应用奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和实践者突破孤立的 tenure-based 思维，从系统整体角度理解住房问题；支持更连贯的政策干预，减少非预期和不平等的住房结果；为应对苏格兰住房紧急状态提供分析工具；模型具备未来拓展和跨地区比较应用的潜力。

title: Dialogic Eating: Designing Food Experience as a Protocol for Sensory Articulation and Urban Sensibility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dialogic Eating: Designing Food Experience as a Protocol for Sensory Articulation and Urban Sensibility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the practitioner-designer and facilitator of the programs described in this paper and is affiliated with Loftwork Inc. / FabCafe Osaka. This dual role as both practitioner and researcher is acknowledged as a limitation of the practice-based research. The author declares no additional financial conflict of interest related to this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This practice-based paper did not receive formal ethics committee or IRB approval. The manuscript is based on reflective practitioner observations and program documentation from public and professional practice contexts. It does not report clinical research, medical intervention, or individually identifiable participant data. Participant responses are discussed only in an anonymized and illustrative manner.
declarations.funderStatement: No external research funding was received for this manuscript. The practice programs described in the paper were developed and conducted as part of the author’s professional practice at FabCafe Osaka / Loftwork Inc.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Dialogic Eating (Taiwagata Inshoku)—a practice‑based methodology developed at FabCafe Osaka that uses food and drink experience as a protocol for opening, sharing, and translating pre‑verbal sensory knowledge. Departing from the established framework of Visual Thinking Strategies (VTS) and dialogic art appreciation, Dialogic Eating addresses a structural access problem: while art‑based dialogue methods are cognitively effective, they presuppose aesthetic literacy that creates participation barriers, particularly in Japan, where a national survey found that 35.4% of cultural nonparticipants cited “no interest” as the primary reason, with a further 22.8% giving no specific reason—together representing 58.2% with no orientation toward cultural engagement (Agency for Cultural Affairs, 2019). Eating and drinking, by contrast, are universal embodied experiences requiring no prior cultural knowledge.

Drawing on four practice programs implemented with approximately 256 participants—the Anparfait tasting experience, the Hon wo Nomu (Drinking Books) series, the Kemono Ato Michi (Beast Trail) program, and professional Dialogic Eating salon sessions—as well as neuroscientific research on olfactory‑triggered autobiographical memory, this paper proposes a three‑function model of Dialogic Eating: (1) sensory translation, (2) relational generation, and (3) connection to urban experience design.

Two practitioner‑derived findings extend existing theory: a four‑stage engagement sequence that emerges consistently when participants encounter an unnamed stimulus, activating an investigative rather than confirmatory mode of perception; and a sensibility‑switching effect in which the shift in perceptual register induced by Dialogic Eating persists beyond the session, with implications for perceptual education and organizational culture change. The paper situates these findings within the framework of Sensibility Urbanism (Kansei Toshi‑ron), arguing that Dialogic Eating constitutes a methodology for accessing and articulating the embodied knowledge of urban value that conventional metrics cannot capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对话式饮食"（Dialogic Eating）作为一种基于实践的感官方法论，通过饮食体验作为协议来开放、分享和转化前语言感官知识，以解决传统视觉思维策略（VTS）中因审美素养门槛导致的文化参与障碍问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过饮食体验这一普适性具身实践，为缺乏审美素养的群体开辟参与文化对话的路径，并系统化地开放和转化前语言感官知识？
AI.motivation: 日本文化厅调查显示58.2%的非文化参与者对文化参与缺乏兴趣或无法给出理由，根源在于现有艺术对话方法（如VTS）预设了审美素养；饮食作为无需先验知识的普适性具身体验，有望解决这一结构性准入问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉思维策略（VTS）、对话式艺术鉴赏、嗅觉触发自传体记忆神经科学、感性都市主义（Kansei Toshi-ron）
AI.method: 基于实践的方法论开发，在FabCafe大阪实施了四项实践项目（Anparfait品尝体验、Hon wo Nomu饮书系列、Kemono Ato Michi野兽足迹项目、专业对话式饮食沙龙），约256名参与者参与。
AI.findings: (1)提出了对话式饮食的三功能模型：感官翻译、关系生成、连接都市体验设计；(2)发现了四阶段参与序列：当参与者面对未命名刺激时，会激活探究性而非确认性的感知模式；(3)发现"感受性切换效应"：对话式饮食引发的感知调式转变会持续到会话之后，对感知教育和组织文化变革有启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 将对话式饮食定位为感性都市主义框架下的方法论，为获取和表达都市价值的具身知识提供了传统指标无法捕捉的途径；扩展了VTS等对话式方法，通过饮食这一普适性媒介降低了参与门槛。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化机构、城市体验设计、感知教育和组织文化变革提供了可操作的实践方法论，通过四阶段参与序列和感受性切换效应指导实际干预设计。

title: Recursive Coordination Capitalism: Programmable Demand Architectures and Innovation Governance in AI-Scale Economies

detail.title: Recursive Coordination Capitalism: Programmable Demand Architectures and Innovation Governance in AI-Scale Economies
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical framework for understanding purpose-bound money (PBM) as a programmable coordination architecture for AI-scale economies. Unlike conventional monetary systems, which primarily function as generalized exchange and stabilization mechanisms, PBM systems can structure future demand, influence technological diffusion, reduce investment uncertainty, and coordinate long-term innovation dynamics. Building on endogenous growth theory, Schumpeterian creative destruction, capability theory, and computational governance, the paper introduces the concept of Recursive Coordination Capitalism: an emerging economic regime in which technological progress, human capability formation, corporate investment, and institutional adaptation become recursively aligned through programmable demand architectures. The analysis argues that AI-scale economies intensify coordination problems involving innovation timing, labor transition, adoption velocity, and market concentration. In this context, programmable monetary systems may function as adaptive coordination infrastructures capable of accelerating frontier-technology diffusion, stabilizing long-horizon investment, and partially governing technological transition dynamics. At the same time, the paper emphasizes the institutional risks of programmable economic systems, including surveillance expansion, algorithmic governance failure, and excessive centralization. It therefore proposes constitutional computational governance principles centered on democratic oversight, privacy-preserving computation, transparency, decentralization, reversibility, and institutional contestability. The paper concludes that purpose-bound money is not merely a welfare tool, digital currency, or industrial policy instrument, but a programmable coordination infrastructure capable of recursively aligning technological innovation, corporate growth, and human flourishing in increasingly complex AI-scale economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“目的绑定货币”（PBM）作为AI规模经济的可编程协调架构，构建了“递归协调资本主义”理论框架，探讨其如何通过可编程需求架构协调技术创新、人力资本形成、企业投资与制度适应，并强调相应的制度风险与治理原则。
AI.research_question: 在AI规模经济中，目的绑定货币（PBM）如何作为一种可编程协调架构来影响和协调技术创新、需求结构、投资不确定性及长期经济动态？
AI.motivation: 传统货币体系主要作为一般性交换和稳定机制，难以应对AI规模经济中加剧的协调问题（如创新时机、劳动力转型、技术采纳速度、市场集中等），因此需要探索可编程货币作为适应性协调基础设施的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论、熊彼特创造性破坏理论、能力理论、计算治理理论，以及整合提出的“递归协调资本主义”概念。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与概念分析，综合多学科理论进行推演性论述。
AI.findings: （1）PBM可作为可编程协调基础设施，加速前沿技术扩散、稳定长周期投资、部分治理技术转型动态；（2）但也存在监控扩张、算法治理失败、过度集中等制度风险；（3）需要以民主监督、隐私保护计算、透明性、去中心化、可逆性和制度可争议性为原则的宪法性计算治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“递归协调资本主义”概念，将目的绑定货币定位为超越福利工具、数字货币或产业政策工具的新型可编程协调基础设施，扩展了货币理论与计算治理理论的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI规模经济中的货币体系设计、技术扩散政策、长期投资稳定机制及计算治理制度提供了理论指导与原则性建议。

title: International Trade Law and Gender Linkages: A Gender Perspective on Non‑Tariff Measures in Malawi

detail.title: International Trade Law and Gender Linkages: A Gender Perspective on Non‑Tariff Measures in Malawi
detail.abstract: The relationship between international trade and gender equality has become increasingly significant in international economic law and development policy. While trade liberalisation has traditionally been viewed as gender-neutral, contemporary scholarship demonstrates that trade policies and regulatory mechanisms affect women and men differently due to existing socioeconomic inequalities. This article examines the gendered impact of non-tariff measures (NTMs) in Malawi, focusing particularly on sanitary and phytosanitary measures, customs procedures, rules of origin, product standards, and digital trade facilitation. Using Malawi as a case study, the article argues that NTMs disproportionately burden women traders, especially those engaged in informal cross-border trade and small-scale agriculture. At the same time, the article demonstrates that gender-responsive trade interventions, digital trade facilitation tools, and voluntary sustainability standards can significantly improve women's economic participation. The article further analyses the evolving international legal framework on trade and gender within the World Trade Organization (WTO), the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), and regional trade arrangements in Southern Africa. It concludes by proposing policy recommendations for integrating gender perspectives into Malawi's trade governance framework.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了非关税措施（NTMs）对马拉维女性贸易者的差异性影响，发现这些措施对从事非正规跨境贸易和小规模农业的女性造成了不成比例的负担，同时提出性别响应型贸易干预、数字贸易便利化工具和自愿性可持续标准能够改善女性经济参与度，并分析了WTO、AfCFTA及南部非洲区域贸易安排中关于贸易与性别的国际法律框架。
AI.research_question: 非关税措施如何对马拉维女性贸易者产生差异性影响？哪些政策和工具可以改善女性在经济贸易中的参与度？
AI.motivation: 传统上贸易自由化被视为性别中立的，但现有研究表明贸易政策和监管机制因社会经济不平等而对女性和男性产生不同影响，因此需要关注非关税措施对女性贸易者的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易与性别不平等理论、非关税措施（NTMs）的差异化影响理论、性别响应型贸易治理框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，以马拉维为案例，聚焦卫生与植物检疫措施、海关程序、原产地规则、产品标准和数字贸易便利化等具体非关税措施。
AI.findings: 非关税措施对马拉维女性贸易者（尤其从事非正规跨境贸易和小规模农业的女性）造成不成比例的负担；性别响应型贸易干预、数字贸易便利化工具和自愿性可持续标准能够显著改善女性经济参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了非关税措施性别影响的理论分析，揭示了贸易政策并非性别中立，丰富了国际经济法中贸易与性别平等交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马拉维及类似发展中国家的贸易治理框架提出了将性别视角纳入政策制定的具体建议，分析了WTO、AfCFTA及南部非洲区域贸易安排中的相关法律框架。

title: The Anthropological Trap of Digital Utopia: From Cybernetic Socialism to the Crisis of Platform Democracy

detail.title: The Anthropological Trap of Digital Utopia: From Cybernetic Socialism to the Crisis of Platform Democracy
