detail.abstract: Digital utopias fail in structurally predictable ways. This paper argues that what makes them predictable is anthropological mis-specification: the systematic encoding of a false model of the human subject-rational, autonomous, informed, capable of sustained deliberation under growing complexity-into the architecture of governance systems. This assumption is not an accidental error or ideological distortion. It is a structural feature that persisted across five decades of digital utopianism, from Project Cybersyn to Web 2.0 to DAO governance, regardless of political context or intention. Drawing on cybernetics, cognitive science, and political theory, the paper traces this assumption historically and examines its consequences. Platforms became more effective than democratic digital projects not by betraying the utopian promise but by abandoning the rationalist subject model. Standard responses to the crisis-regulation, digital literacy, democratic design-tend to reproduce the same baseline assumption they are meant to overcome.

AI.tldr: 本文论证数字乌托邦的失败源于对"理性自主人"这一人类模型的错误假设，该假设作为结构性特征贯穿了从Cybersyn到DAO的五十年数字乌托邦实践。平台之所以比民主数字项目更有效，不是因为背叛了乌托邦承诺，而是因为放弃了理性主义主体模型。
AI.research_question: 数字乌托邦为何以结构上可预测的方式失败？其根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字乌托邦项目（从Cybersyn到Web 2.0再到DAO）反复失败，但现有解释多停留在技术、政治或意识形态层面，缺乏对人类主体模型这一深层假设的批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制论、认知科学、政治理论；核心概念是"人类学误设"（anthropological mis-specification）——将理性、自主、知情、能在复杂性下持续 deliberation 的主体模型系统性地编码进治理架构。
AI.method: 历史追踪与理论分析，跨越五十年（Cybersyn → Web 2.0 → DAO），比较不同政治语境下的数字乌托邦实践。
AI.findings: (1) 理性主义主体模型是数字乌托邦的结构性特征，而非偶然错误；(2) 平台更有效是因为放弃了这一模型，而非背叛了乌托邦承诺；(3) 标准回应（监管、数字素养、民主设计）往往复制了它们试图克服的同一假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"人类学误设"概念作为分析数字治理失败的新理论框架，将主体模型问题从意识形态批判提升到系统架构层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示当前应对数字危机的标准方案可能陷入同样的认知陷阱，为数字治理设计提供更根本的反思方向——需要重构数字系统中的人性假设，而非修补理性主体模型。

title: Tracking Shifts in U.S. Monetary Policy: Comparing Multiplicative Indicator Saturation with Three Alternatives
affiliations: Babson College - Economics Division

detail.title: Tracking Shifts in U.S. Monetary Policy: Comparing Multiplicative Indicator Saturation with Three Alternatives
detail.abstract: This paper applies Multiplicative Indicator Saturation (MIS), for automated coefficient break selection, to a Taylor rule estimated with real-time data and the shadow federal funds rate from 1972 to 2025. MIS is compared with three approaches: sample splitting by Fed Chair, Bai-Perron break tests, and Markov-switching. MIS offers advantages by controlling for outliers and allowing parameters to vary flexibly over time. Across statistical methods and specifications, several breaks emerge as robust, most notably Volcker's and Greenspan's appointments. Surprisingly, once interest rate smoothing is incorporated, none of the statistical tests can reject a constant policy "rule" after 2000, even though this period is often described as a "new discretionary era."

AI.tldr: 本文使用乘法因子饱和(MIS)方法自动检测泰勒规则中的系数断点，分析1972-2025年实时数据与影子联邦基金利率。研究发现沃尔克和格林斯潘上任时期存在显著断点，但令人惊讶的是，加入利率平滑后，2000年后的政策规则未被任何统计检验拒绝为恒定，尽管这一时期常被称为"新自由裁量时代"。
AI.research_question: 美联储的泰勒规则政策反应函数在不同历史时期是否存在结构性断点？尤其是2000年后的"新自由裁量时代"是否真的改变了政策规则？
AI.motivation: 传统方法（如按美联储主席分样本、Bai-Perron断点检验、马尔可夫转换模型）在识别政策规则断点上存在局限，MIS方法能自动选择断点并控制异常值，提供更灵活的时变参数估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒规则（货币政策反应函数）、乘法因子饱和(MIS)方法（自动断点选择）、Bai-Perron多重断点检验、马尔可夫转换模型、利率平滑机制。
AI.method: 使用乘法因子饱和(MIS)方法对泰勒规则进行系数断点自动选择，并与按美联储主席分样本、Bai-Perron断点检验、马尔可夫转换模型三种方法进行比较分析，采用1972-2025年的实时数据和影子联邦基金利率。
AI.findings: （1）多种统计方法和规格下，沃尔克和格林斯潘上任时期存在稳健的政策反应系数断点；（2）加入利率平滑项后，2000年后的政策规则未被任何统计检验拒绝为恒定，即"新自由裁量时代"实际上并未改变政策规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MIS方法引入货币政策规则的结构断点分析领域，为识别泰勒规则参数时变性提供了更稳健的统计工具；挑战了"新自由裁量时代"的学术叙事，发现2000年后政策规则实际上保持恒定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和货币政策研究者提供了更精确的政策规则断点识别方法；对美联储政策历史的重新解读有助于理解货币政策连续性与制度变革的关系。

title: A Multi-Input Approach to Markup Estimation: Evidence on Stability and Invariance
affiliations: Yanbian University

detail.title: A Multi-Input Approach to Markup Estimation: Evidence on Stability and Invariance
detail.abstract: This paper derives a multi-input integrated markup equation to address the input-selection problem inherent in conventional single-input markup estimation. The proposed framework incorporates capital, labor, domestic intermediates, and foreign intermediates, constructing markups from the full production cost structure. Using Korean manufacturing data from 1975-2023, we compare markup estimates across alternative classifications of intermediate inputs. The results show that the multi-input markup measure is highly stable and exhibits fragmentation invariance, whereas single-input measures are considerably more volatile and sensitive to specification. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly accounting for input heterogeneity in markup measurement, particularly in import-dependent small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了多投入综合加成率方程，解决了传统单一投入加成率估算中的投入选择问题。利用韩国1975-2023年制造业数据，发现多投入加成率指标高度稳定且具有碎片化不变性，而单一投入指标波动大且对规格敏感，强调了在进口依赖型小开放经济中考虑投入异质性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统单一投入加成率估算中的投入选择问题，构建更稳定的多投入加成率度量方法？
AI.motivation: 传统单一投入加成率估算存在"投入选择问题"（input-selection problem），即选择不同单一投入（如劳动或资本）会导致加成率估计结果差异较大，缺乏稳健性。这一问题在进口依赖型小开放经济体中尤为突出，因此需要更全面的测度框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多投入综合加成率方程（multi-input integrated markup equation），基于完整生产成本结构（涵盖资本、劳动、国内中间品和国外中间品）构建加成率。
AI.method: 推导多投入综合加成率方程；使用韩国1975-2023年制造业数据进行实证比较；对比不同中间投入分类下的加成率估计结果。
AI.findings: （1）多投入加成率指标高度稳定，具有"碎片化不变性"（fragmentation invariance）；（2）单一投入加成率波动较大，且对模型规格（specification）敏感；（3）明确考虑投入异质性对加成率测度至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多投入综合加成率方程，克服了传统单一投入方法的投入选择偏误；揭示了加成率测度中投入异质性的重要性；为小开放经济体的加成率研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为进口依赖型小开放经济体提供了更稳健的加成率测度工具；有助于更准确地评估企业市场势力和竞争程度；对贸易政策和产业政策的制定具有参考价值。

reference: Revue luxembourgeoise de droit immobilier, No. 18
title: Greenwashing Risks for the Luxembourg Real Estate Sector
affiliations: University of Glasgow - School of Law and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Greenwashing Risks for the Luxembourg Real Estate Sector

publicationDetails.detailsText: Revue luxembourgeoise de droit immobilier, No. 18

detail.abstract: Climate change is disrupting living conditions and economic activities with increasing frequency. This has led the public opinion to raise awareness of the issue and put pressure on governments and companies to take seriously risks stemming from the worsening of climate conditions due to the overexploitation of natural resources and excessive pollution of the planet. In this context, the real estate sector is perceived globally as the most polluting sector and the one characterised by the highest level of complexity for the achievement of an effective decarbonisation within EU and global targets. As a result, it can be inferred that this sector is largely exposed to greenwashing in the way that consumers’ preferences do not match the offers or declarations of operators regarding the environmental sustainability of their products and services. This study aims to identify greenwashing risks in the real estate sector by taking Luxembourg as a reference country within a broader European perspective as the EU has shown a proactive stance towards the challenge of the transition to the ‘Net Zero’ both from the financing and regulatory point of view. In fact, the legal analysis undertaken in this article will reveal that legislation at the EU level acts as a bond and an inspirer for national strategies and objectives aimed at countering the phenomenon of greenwashing.

AI.tldr: 本文以卢森堡为案例，从法律视角分析房地产行业面临的绿色洗白风险，探讨欧盟立法如何约束和引导国家层面应对绿色洗白的策略。
AI.research_question: 房地产行业如何面临绿色洗白风险？欧盟及国家层面的立法如何应对这一现象？
AI.motivation: 气候变化日益严峻，公众意识提升，房地产作为全球污染最严重且脱碳最复杂的行业，其绿色声明与消费者期望之间存在落差，亟需识别和防范绿色洗白风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色洗白理论；欧盟环境立法与监管框架；房地产行业可持续性转型理论。
AI.method: 法律分析（以卢森堡为案例，结合欧盟整体视角进行立法比较与分析）。
AI.findings: 欧盟层面的立法既是各国国家战略的约束力量，也是其灵感来源；房地产行业因其高污染性和复杂性，面临显著的绿色洗白风险；消费者偏好与企业绿色声明之间存在不匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绿色洗白研究聚焦于房地产这一高污染、高复杂性的特定行业，拓展了绿色洗白理论的行业应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国（尤其是卢森堡）识别和防范房地产行业绿色洗白提供法律分析依据；为政策制定者和行业参与者提供应对绿色洗白的监管思路。

title: SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.9: Why Wall Street's Algorithmic Finance Remains Structurally Nominal and How CVR73 Covers What JPMorgan, Goldman, BlackRock, and Aladdin Cannot

detail.title: SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.9: Why Wall Street's Algorithmic Finance Remains Structurally Nominal and How CVR73 Covers What JPMorgan, Goldman, BlackRock, and Aladdin Cannot

keywords: Why Wall Street's Algorithmic Finance Remains Structurally Nominal Derivatives
real assets 1. Introduction: The Nominal Gap in Algorithmic Finance

detail.abstract: Wall Street's dominant algorithmic finance platforms-JPMorgan's derivative pricing engine, Goldman Sachs's Monte Carlo risk tools, BlackRock's Aladdin, and D-Wave/IBM quantum optimisers-share a fundamental structural limitation: they operate at the micro-level of individual financial instruments, single portfolios, or isolated institutions within a purely nominal framework. A systematic review of their published capabilities reveals five critical gaps: none addresses derivative exposure at the systemic sovereign level; none detects rehypothecation chain risk; none models algorithmic herding as an endogenous systemic force; none optimises sovereign wealth fund portfolios in real-asset space; and none predicts financial crises more than days ahead. This paper demonstrates that SVWORLD Standard 73.5 v1.9 (CVR73) addresses all five gaps through a structural real-asset architecture. Specifically: (i) the Netting and Rehypothecation Factor (NREF) detected systemic derivative risk 13 months before the 2008 Global Financial Crisis while JPMorgan's pricing tools showed no signal; (ii) the BANKING-73.5 Asset Quality Index (AQI) provides a four-dimensional real-asset portfolio optimisation surface that identified Silicon Valley Bank's insolvency 9 months before failure while Basel III metrics showed green; (iii) the seven-block B1-B7 structure constitutes the first portfolio optimisation framework native to sovereign wealth fund asset classes; (iv) the AI Correlation Multiplier (ACM) models algorithmic herding as an endogenous penalty validated in the 2022 UK LDI crisis; and (v) the CRYPTO-73.5 module anchors digital asset valuation to physical security constraints absent from any existing platform. We further present a five-stage computational roadmap (2026-2031) for CVR73 advanced implementation-from collateral netting optimisation to sovereign wealth portfolio allocation-demonstrating that CVR73's real-asset architecture was pre-adapted for the next generation of advanced computational finance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示华尔街主流金融平台（摩根大通定价引擎、高盛蒙特卡洛风险工具、贝莱德Aladdin、D-Wave/IBM量子优化器）存在五大结构性缺陷，并提出SVWORLD Standard 73.5 v1.9（CVR73）作为解决方案。CVR73通过实物资产架构，在主权级衍生品风险检测、再抵押链条风险、算法羊群效应建模、主权财富基金优化、金融危机预测五个维度填补了空白，并提供了2026-2031年的计算路线图。
AI.research_question: 华尔街主流算法金融平台存在哪些结构性缺陷？CVR73如何通过实物资产架构解决这些缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有顶级金融平台（摩根大通、高盛、贝莱德、D-Wave/IBM）均局限于微观层面的名义金融工具定价与风险管理，无法应对系统性主权级风险、再抵押链条风险、算法羊群效应等宏观问题，存在根本性架构局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物资产架构理论（Real-Asset Architecture）、系统性风险建模、算法羊群效应内生模型、主权财富基金组合优化理论。
AI.method: 系统性文献回顾与能力对比分析；五个关键缺口识别；CVR73的七模块B1-B7架构设计；NREF、AQI、ACM等核心指标的实证验证（2008年金融危机、硅谷银行破产、2022年英国LDI危机回测）；2026-2031年五阶段计算路线图规划。
AI.findings: （1）NREF在2008年金融危机前13个月检测到系统性衍生品风险，而摩根大通工具无信号；（2）AQI在硅谷银行破产前9个月识别其资不抵债，而巴塞尔III指标显示正常；（3）B1-B7框架是首个原生适配主权财富基金资产类别的组合优化框架；（4）ACM在2022年英国LDI危机中验证了算法羊群效应的内生惩罚模型；（5）CRYPTO-73.5模块将数字资产估值锚定于物理安全约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出面向主权级系统性风险的实物资产架构理论；建立了算法羊群效应作为内生系统性力量的理论模型；构建了主权财富基金资产类别的原生组合优化理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统性金融风险监管提供了超越巴塞尔III的预警工具（NREF、AQI）；为数字资产估值提供了物理安全锚定框架；为主权财富基金提供了专属资产配置优化方案；提出了2026-2031年可落地的五阶段实施路线图。

title: How Price Limits Affect Skewness and Mispricing: Evidence from A Quasi-Natural Experiment in China
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China - School of Finance and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: How Price Limits Affect Skewness and Mispricing: Evidence from A Quasi-Natural Experiment in China
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine the impact of a price limit policy on skewness and the mispricing of high skewness stocks, leveraging a regulatory reform that relaxed daily price limits for stocks on China's the Growth Enterprises Board (hereafter ChiNext Board) from 10% to 20%. Following the reform, the skewness of ChiNext board stocks increased because of the short-sale constraint. Moreover, the skewness anomaly intensified on the ChiNext board but weakened on the Main Board, primarily driven by the rise in overpricing among high skewness stocks. The shift can be largely attributed to retail investors, whose optimism after upper limit hitting events is heighted by the reform. Moreover, by utilizing lottery data and IPO subscription data in China, we find that the relaxation of price limits enhances the attractiveness of ChiNext stocks as substitutes for lottery-seeking investments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国创业板涨跌幅限制从10%放宽至20%的政策改革，发现放宽限制后创业板股票偏度上升（因卖空约束），偏度异常加剧（高偏度股票被过度高估），而主板市场偏度异常减弱。这一变化主要由零售投资者驱动，其在上限触及事件后的乐观情绪被改革放大。此外，彩票数据和IPO认购数据显示，放宽涨跌幅增强了创业板股票作为彩票替代品的吸引力。
AI.research_question: 涨跌幅限制政策如何影响股票偏度以及高偏度股票的错误定价？
AI.motivation: 涨跌幅限制是全球许多市场广泛使用的政策工具，但其对资产定价和投资者行为的影响尚不明确。本文利用中国创业板独特的制度变革（从10%到20%），为理解价格限制政策的后果提供了准自然实验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏度定价理论、卖空约束理论、投资者关注与乐观情绪理论、彩票偏好理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID），利用创业板（处理组）与主板（对照组）在改革前后的差异进行比较分析。同时使用彩票数据和IPO认购数据进行辅助分析。
AI.findings: （1）放宽涨跌幅后，创业板股票偏度上升（因卖空约束）；（2）偏度异常在创业板加剧，而在主板减弱；（3）高偏度股票的错误定价主要是过度高估；（4）零售投资者的乐观情绪在上限触及事件后被改革放大；（5）放宽涨跌幅增强了创业板股票作为彩票替代品的吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了价格限制政策对市场微观结构和资产定价影响的理论理解；揭示了偏度异常的微观机制——零售投资者乐观情绪与卖空约束的交互作用；将彩票偏好理论与价格限制政策联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估涨跌幅限制政策提供了实证依据；提示政策制定者需关注价格限制放宽可能加剧投机和错误定价的负面效应；为理解新兴市场中散户投资者的行为特征提供了重要参考。

title: Renewable Energy Integration for High-Demand Digital Infrastructure in the United States: A Resource-Driven Cost Optimization Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Renewable Energy Integration for High-Demand Digital Infrastructure in the United States: A Resource-Driven Cost Optimization Model

keywords: Energy EconomicsRenewable Energy IntegrationElectricity Markets and Power Systems (PJM
CAISO)Data Center Infrastructure EconomicsArtificial Intelligence Infrastructure and Energy DemandBattery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)Corporate Ener

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI), hyperscale cloud computing, and high-performance digital workloads has fundamentally transformed electricity demand patterns in the United States. Data centers are no longer marginal industrial consumers; they are emerging as giga-scale, continuous-load energy infrastructures that significantly influence regional grid planning, wholesale pricing dynamics, and transmission investment cycles.This paper develops a resource-driven optimization framework for integrating solar photovoltaic (PV) generation and battery energy storage systems (BESS) into high-demand digital infrastructure. Unlike traditional energy economics models that rely on Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE), this study introduces the Levelized Cost of Uptime (LCOU), a reliability-adjusted financial metric designed specifically for Tier III–IV data center operations.Using a multi-region simulation across PJM, ERCOT, and CAISO markets, the study evaluates the financial, operational, and strategic implications of hybrid renewable deployment. Results demonstrate that integrated solar-plus-storage systems materially reduce exposure to capacity charges, scarcity pricing events, and congestion-driven cost volatility, while simultaneously enhancing internal rate of return (IRR) under Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) incentive structures.The findings suggest that renewable integration is no longer solely a decarbonization strategy, but a structural economic optimization mechanism for hyperscale digital infrastructure in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对AI和超大规模云计算等高能耗数字基础设施的资源驱动优化框架，引入“平准化运行成本（LCOU）”替代传统LCOE指标，通过PJM、ERCOT和CAISO多区域模拟，证明光储混合系统能显著降低容量费用和价格波动风险，并提升IRR。可再生能源整合已成为美国超大规模数字基础设施的结构性经济优化机制。
AI.research_question: 面向高需求数字基础设施（如AI数据中心），如何通过太阳能光伏和电池储能系统的整合实现资源驱动的经济优化？
AI.motivation: 人工智能、超大规模云计算和高性能数字工作负载的快速扩张，深刻改变了美国电力需求模式。数据中心从边际工业消费者转变为千兆级、连续负荷的能源基础设施，显著影响区域电网规划、批发电价动态和输电投资周期。传统LCOE指标无法反映数据中心对高可靠性的特殊需求，因此需要新的经济分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源驱动优化框架；平准化运行成本（LCOU）——一种专为Tier III–IV数据中心运行设计、考虑可靠性调整的财务指标；替代传统平准化能源成本（LCOE）。
AI.method: 多区域仿真模拟，覆盖PJM、ERCOT和CAISO三个美国电力市场；评估混合可再生能源部署的财务、运营和战略影响。
AI.findings: 集成太阳能光伏加储能系统能够显著降低容量费用、稀缺定价事件和拥堵驱动的成本波动；同时在通胀削减法案（IRA）激励结构下提升内部收益率（IRR）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出LCOU（平准化运行成本）作为替代传统LCOE的新财务指标，专门面向高可靠性要求的数据中心运营，拓展了能源经济学中关于可再生能源整合的评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为超大规模数据中心运营者和电网规划者提供了将可再生能源整合从单纯的脱碳战略转变为结构性经济优化机制的具体分析工具和实证证据；指导IRA激励下的投资决策。

title: Bretton Woods 2.0: A Real-Asset-Based Architecture For Financial Stability

detail.title: Bretton Woods 2.0: A Real-Asset-Based Architecture For Financial Stability
detail.abstract: Based on the synthesis of 11 verified empirical studies (SSRN 6724903-6824020) and the revised diagnosis of algorithmic platforms (Working Paper No. 10 Revised), this paper formulates the complete architecture of the 21st-century international financial system ("Bretton Woods 2.0"). It is proven that the nominal paradigm is structurally insolvent: 95.2% of BIS central banks are in the CVR73 Red Zone; the hidden obligation gap of the Aladdin platform and the "Big Six" funds amounts to $48 trillion; the global debt trap makes it impossible to service the sovereign debt of the U.S., China, Japan, and the EU without accelerating thermodynamic entropy. Debt tokenization in the absence of a real-asset standard constitutes a first-order systemic threat.

AI.tldr: 本文基于11项实证研究和修订后的算法平台诊断，提出了21世纪国际金融体系（布雷顿森林体系2.0）的完整架构，证明名义范式在结构上已不可持续：95.2%的BIS央行处于CVR73红色区域，Aladdin平台与"六大基金"隐藏义务缺口达48万亿美元，全球债务陷阱导致美中日欧的主权债务在无真实资产标准的情况下无法可持续偿还，债务代币化构成一阶系统性威胁。
AI.research_question: 如何构建21世纪国际金融体系（布雷顿森林体系2.0）的完整架构，并诊断当前名义范式的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有国际金融体系（名义范式）存在严重的结构性不可持续问题，包括央行风险集中、隐藏债务义务巨大、全球债务陷阱等，亟需提出新的系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 名义范式结构性破产理论；CVR73风险诊断框架；热力学熵加速理论；真实资产标准理论。
AI.method: 综合11项经过验证的实证研究（SSRN 6724903-6824020）的荟萃分析，结合对算法平台的修订诊断（工作论文第10号修订版）。
AI.findings: （1）95.2%的BIS央行处于CVR73红色区域；（2）Aladdin平台与"六大基金"隐藏义务缺口达48万亿美元；（3）全球债务陷阱使美中日欧主权债务不可持续；（4）无真实资产标准的债务代币化构成一阶系统性威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了布雷顿森林体系2.0的完整架构设计；将热力学熵概念引入金融体系稳定性分析；建立了CVR73央行风险评估新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际金融体系改革提供了系统性架构方案；警示了算法平台和债务代币化的系统性风险；为央行和监管机构提供了风险评估和预警工具。

title: Effects of mandatory climate-related information disclosure on mutual funds: a quasi-experiment
affiliations: University Jean Moulin Lyon 3 and University Paris-Saclay - RITM

detail.title: Effects of mandatory climate-related information disclosure on mutual funds: a quasi-experiment
detail.abstract: Article 173-VI of France’s Energy Transition for Green Growth Act requires large mutual funds to be transparent about the impacts of their investments on climate change. This article investigates whether this regulation helps discipline fund managers to reduce their carbon footprints. Using a difference-in-difference method, we show that French funds reduced their carbon footprints more after the introduction of the law. They rebalance their portfolios toward more climate-conscious firms. Mutual funds were incited to follow the regulation for reputation concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究法国《能源转型与绿色增长法》第173-VI条是否促使大型共同基金降低碳足迹。使用双重差分法发现，该法规实施后法国基金确实减少了碳足迹，并通过重新配置投资组合转向更注重气候的企业，声誉考量是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 法国《能源转型与绿色增长法》第173-VI条要求大型共同基金披露其投资对气候变化的影响，该法规是否能有效约束基金经理降低其碳足迹？
AI.motivation: 气候信息披露法规日益增多，但其实际效果尚不明确。本研究旨在评估强制性气候信息披露法规能否真正改变机构投资者的行为，推动资本向低碳经济转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露监管理论和声誉机制理论。信息披露法规通过增加透明度来减少信息不对称，进而通过声誉关切（而非直接惩罚）来约束基金管理者行为。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Difference），比较法国基金（处理组）与其他国家基金（对照组）在法规实施前后的碳足迹变化。
AI.findings: （1）法规实施后，法国基金的碳足迹显著降低；（2）基金通过重新配置投资组合，将资金转向更具气候意识的企业；（3）声誉考量是基金遵循法规的主要驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息披露监管理论提供了实证证据，证明强制性气候信息披露可以通过声誉机制影响机构投资者行为，拓展了对"软性监管"工具有效性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了气候信息披露法规有效性的实证支持；表明声誉机制可以作为推动绿色金融的可行路径；为其他国家设计类似法规提供了参考依据。

title: Green Finance,CBAM and Low-Carbon Economy: A DSGE Analysis
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and Zhongnan University of Economics and Law

detail.title: Green Finance,CBAM and Low-Carbon Economy: A DSGE Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper embeds green finance and the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) into a DSGE model featuring heterogeneous high‑/low‑carbon sectors, a green financial sector, and China‑EU bilateral openness. The model accounts for differentiated financing premiums, CBAM shocks, and China’s institutional features including local government growth preferences and nonlinear financing constraints. Based on 2000‑2024 Chinese macro data, we employ parameter calibration and Bayesian estimation to examine policy effects via impulse responses and scenario simulations. Results show that CBAM alone reduces emissions but causes short‑run contraction; green finance alone stabilizes growth but delivers limited abatement. Their coordination significantly improves low‑carbon output and emission efficiency, achieving carbon reduction and steady growth simultaneously. The synergy operates through dual cost pressures, cross‑sector factor reallocation, export structure upgrading, and factor misallocation correction. Heterogeneous effects are stronger in carbon‑intensive, low‑green‑technology, and high‑openness industries, as well as regions with pro‑green governments and developed financial markets. Green finance also hedges CBAM’s cross‑border contractionary shocks. This study provides quantitative implications for China to address CBAM and fulfill its Dual Carbon goals.

AI.tldr: 本文将绿色金融与欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）嵌入一个包含高低碳异质性部门、绿色金融部门和中欧双边开放的多部门DSGE模型，基于2000-2024年中国宏观数据，通过参数校准和贝叶斯估计，发现两者协同能同时实现减排与稳增长，且绿色金融可对冲CBAM的跨境紧缩冲击。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融与欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的协同作用能否在实现碳减排的同时稳定经济增长？其作用机制和异质性效应如何？
AI.motivation: 欧盟CBAM对高碳出口国构成外部碳壁垒压力，中国面临碳减排与经济增长的双重目标冲突。已有文献较少将绿色金融与CBAM纳入统一框架考察其协同效应，且缺乏针对中国制度特征（如地方政府增长偏好、非线性融资约束）的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性多部门DSGE模型（高低碳部门+绿色金融部门+中欧双边开放），嵌入差异化融资溢价、CBAM冲击、地方政府增长偏好、非线性融资约束等制度特征。
AI.method: 构建DSGE模型，基于2000-2024年中国宏观数据，采用参数校准与贝叶斯估计，通过脉冲响应和情景模拟分析政策效果。
AI.findings: （1）CBAM单独实施可减排但导致短期经济收缩；（2）绿色金融单独实施可稳定增长但减排效果有限；（3）两者协同显著提升低碳产出和排放效率，实现碳减排与稳增长的双重目标；（4）协同机制包括双重成本压力、跨部门要素再配置、出口结构升级和要素错配纠正；（5）异质性效应在高碳、低绿技、高开放度行业，以及绿色偏好强、金融市场发达的地区更显著；（6）绿色金融可对冲CBAM的跨境紧缩冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绿色金融与CBAM纳入统一DSGE框架，揭示两者协同的双重红利机制（减排+稳增长），首次在异质性开放经济模型中量化中国制度特征对碳政策效果的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国应对欧盟CBAM、实现"双碳"目标提供量化政策启示，包含绿色金融工具设计、产业政策协同、区域差异化实施路径等实务建议。

title: From End-of-Pipe to Supply Chain Greening: The Impact of Air Pollution Control Regulation on Corporate Green Supply Chain Construction
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

detail.title: From End-of-Pipe to Supply Chain Greening: The Impact of Air Pollution Control Regulation on Corporate Green Supply Chain Construction
detail.abstract: Whether environmental regulation can induce firms to move from end-of-pipe pollution control to green coordination across the entire supply chain is a crucial question for understanding corporate green transformation. Taking the "Air Ten Measures" (the Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan) and subsequent local regulatory policies as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper uses data on China's A-share listed companies from 2008 to 2024 and employs a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the impact of regulatory policies on firms' green supply chain construction level. The study finds that regulatory policies significantly improve firms' green supply chain construction level. In terms of mechanism, on the one hand, regulatory policies reshape firms' internal green governance capacity by strengthening management's green awareness, enhancing green innovation capability, and optimizing supply chain management efficiency; on the other hand, they improve firms' external green resource allocation by attracting green investors, thereby jointly promoting the upgrading of green supply chains. Further analysis reveals that the policy effects are robust across industries and regions with varying levels of pollution intensity. This paper extends the research on the microeconomic consequences of environmental regulation and green supply chain governance, and also provides empirical evidence for improving coordinated policies on green manufacturing, green distribution, and green consumption.

AI.tldr: 以"大气十条"为准自然实验，利用2008-2024年A股上市公司数据和交错双重差分模型，发现环境规制能显著提升企业绿色供应链建设水平，通过增强管理层绿色意识、绿色创新能力和供应链管理效率（内部机制）以及吸引绿色投资者（外部机制）发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 环境规制能否促使企业从末端污染控制转向全供应链的绿色协同？
AI.motivation: 理解企业绿色转型的关键在于探讨环境规制是否能推动企业超越末端治理，实现供应链层面的绿色协同，但目前对此问题的实证证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境规制理论、绿色供应链治理理论、企业绿色转型理论
AI.method: 以"大气十条"及后续地方政策为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分模型（staggered DiD），使用2008-2024年中国A股上市公司数据。
AI.findings: 环境规制显著提升了企业绿色供应链建设水平；内部机制为强化管理层绿色意识、提升绿色创新能力和优化供应链管理效率；外部机制为吸引绿色投资者改善外部绿色资源配置；政策效应在不同污染强度的行业和地区均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了环境规制微观经济后果的研究，丰富了绿色供应链治理的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为完善绿色制造、绿色流通和绿色消费的协同政策提供了实证依据。

title: Perception of Climate Policy Uncertainty and Corporate Total Factor Productivity: Evidence from China
affiliations: Shandong University, Shandong University, Shandong University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Perception of Climate Policy Uncertainty and Corporate Total Factor Productivity: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of firm-level perception of climate policy uncertainty (FCPU) on corporate total factor productivity (TFP). By constructing a granular index using word embedding to specifically capture the ambiguity and adverse shock dimensions of uncertainty, we isolate the downside risks of policy unpredictability. Our results show a significant negative effect of FCPU on TFP. The robustness of this finding is confirmed against potential endogeneity concerns using an instrumental variable, as well as through various alternative specifications, including different measures of uncertainty, additional fixed effects, altered sample periods, and lagged regressors. Our heterogeneity analysis reveals that this negative effect is more pronounced for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and for firms located in regions with poorer air quality. We further trace the productivity decline to deteriorating internal governance, diminished corporate disclosure, inhibited adoption of green technologies, and widening maturity gaps between capital investments and financing sources. This study contributes to the literature by providing a risk-centric perspective on micro-level climate uncertainty. We demonstrate that the fear of ambiguity, distinct from general policy awareness, acts as a significant impediment to corporate sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业层面的气候政策不确定性感知（FCPU）对全要素生产率（TFP）的负面影响，并通过多种渠道机制解释了这一效应，发现国有企业及空气质量较差地区的企业受影响更大。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的气候政策不确定性感知如何影响企业全要素生产率？
AI.motivation: 气候政策不确定性日益凸显，但微观层面企业对此的感知如何影响其生产效率尚不明确。作者希望从风险视角揭示气候政策模糊性对企业可持续增长的阻碍作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性理论、风险感知理论、企业治理理论
AI.method: 使用词嵌入（word embedding）构建企业层面气候政策不确定性指数，采用固定效应模型、工具变量法（IV）处理内生性，并进行多种稳健性检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings: FCPU显著负向影响企业TFP；国有企业、空气质量较差地区企业受影响更严重；机制渠道包括内部治理恶化、信息披露减少、绿色技术采纳受阻、资本投资与融资期限错配扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了微观层面气候不确定性的风险中心视角，区分了"政策模糊恐惧"与"一般政策意识"的不同影响，拓展了不确定性对企业生产效率影响的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者应降低气候政策的模糊性以减轻企业不确定性感知；为企业管理者在气候政策不稳定环境下优化治理和投资决策提供参考。

title: Topological Early-Warning Signals for SystemicFinancial Crises:An Adaptive Real-Time Surveillance System
affiliations: China Development Bank

detail.title: Topological Early-Warning Signals for SystemicFinancial Crises:An Adaptive Real-Time Surveillance System
detail.abstract: Financial crises remain a persistent threat to economic stability, and conventional early-warningtools often fail to provide timely, reliable alerts. We present an adaptive real-time surveillance system that transforms the topological indicators of the Bubble–Crash Phase Transition Theorem—the topological susceptibility χtop and the market spectral gap λ1—into anoperational monitoring framework for systemic risk. The pipeline ingests ten macro-financialseries, reconstructs the market attractor via multi-asset time-delay embedding, and computes both indicators over rolling windows. An adaptive alert logic, based on a rollingmedian baseline, flags anomalous deformations of the attractor without requiring crisis-datelabels. In a historical backtest spanning 2017–2023, the system detects two out of threemajor crises (COVID-2020 and the 2022 bond rout) with zero false positives, a hit rateof 67%, and an average lead time of 10.8 months. Statistical significance is confirmed byphase-randomised surrogate tests (p < 0.001). A real-time application on 13 May 2026issued an alert driven by an extreme oil price spike and falling economic policy uncertainty,illustrating a deformation without rupture. The system outperforms widely used composite stress indicators in terms of both false-positive rate and lead time, and can serve as acomplementary financial-stability pillar alongside traditional Taylor-type monetary rules.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于气泡-崩溃相变定理拓扑指标的实时金融风险监测系统，利用拓扑磁化率χtop和市场谱隙λ1两大指标，通过多资产时滞嵌入重构市场吸引子，实现无需危机标签的自适应预警。回测2017-2023年，系统以零误报率检测出三次重大危机中的两次（COVID-2020和2022债市动荡），平均提前10.8个月发出预警。
AI.research_question: 如何利用拓扑相变理论的指标构建一个无需危机标签、低误报率、高提前量的实时系统性金融风险预警系统？
AI.motivation: 传统金融危机预警工具常常无法提供及时可靠的警报，而现有方法多依赖历史危机标签且误报率高。作者希望借助拓扑相变理论中关于市场吸引子变形与崩溃之间关系的洞见，建立一个自适应的、无监督的实时监测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气泡-崩溃相变定理（Bubble–Crash Phase Transition Theorem），核心概念包括拓扑磁化率χtop（衡量吸引子拓扑结构的变形程度）和市场谱隙λ1（衡量市场系统的稳定性/刚性与崩溃临界点的接近程度）。
AI.method: 采集十组宏观金融时间序列，通过多资产时滞嵌入（multi-asset time-delay embedding）重构市场吸引子，在滚动窗口上计算χtop和λ1指标。基于滚动中位数基线设计自适应警报逻辑，无需危机日期标签。使用相位随机化替代检验验证统计显著性，并与传统综合压力指标进行对比。
AI.findings: 回测2017-2023年：系统检测出三次重大危机中的两次（COVID-2020和2022债券崩盘），零误报，命中率67%，平均提前10.8个月预警。统计显著性p<0.001。2026年5月13日的实时应用检测到由极端油价飙升和经济政策不确定性下降驱动的形变信号。系统在误报率和提前量方面均优于传统综合压力指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气泡-崩溃相变定理从理论概念转化为可操作的实时监测工具，验证了市场吸引子的拓扑变形可作为金融危机的早期信号，拓展了拓扑数据分析在宏观金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融监管机构提供了一个无需历史危机标签、低误报率、高提前量的系统性风险监测工具，可作为传统泰勒规则型货币政策之外的金融稳定支柱。

title: Investment in Power Generation Projects Under Multi-Market Uncertainty and Policy Impacts
affiliations: North China Electric Power University, North China Electric Power University, North China Electric Power University and North China Electric Power University

detail.title: Investment in Power Generation Projects Under Multi-Market Uncertainty and Policy Impacts
detail.abstract: This paper constructs a real options model incorporating three stochastic factors: electricity price, carbon price, and green certificate price, to investigate how investors make optimal investment decisions between renewable and thermal power technologies under the influence of multi-market uncertainty and policies. The model simultaneously accounts for the impacts of policy instruments such as subsidies, carbon taxes, and carbon allowances on the investment boundaries. The study shows that carbon taxes and carbon allowances significantly affect the relative competitiveness of the two technologies by altering the marginal costs and revenue composition of thermal power. Although price subsidies and investment subsidies can lower the investment threshold for renewable energy, their marginal utility decreases as the subsidy level increases. Furthermore, the technology substitution effect is particularly pronounced in non-portfolio investment scenarios, where thermal power, as a substitute technology, can crowd out renewable energy investment. In contrast, the portfolio investment strategy, which incorporates capacity compensation, can effectively diversify the price fluctuation risks across multiple markets, significantly compressing the waiting region and enhancing the robustness of investment decisions. This paper provides a new quantitative basis for understanding green energy investment decisions under the coupling of electricity-carbon-green certificate markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含电价、碳价和绿证价格三随机因子的实物期权模型，研究在多市场不确定性和政策影响下，投资者如何在可再生能源与火电技术之间做出最优投资决策，发现碳税与碳配额显著影响技术相对竞争力，而组合投资策略能有效分散风险、压缩等待区域。
AI.research_question: 在多市场不确定性（电价、碳价、绿证价格）及政策工具（补贴、碳税、碳配额）共同作用下，投资者如何在可再生能源与火电技术之间做出最优投资决策？
AI.motivation: 电力-碳-绿证多市场耦合背景下，传统单一市场模型无法准确刻画跨市场不确定性和政策交互效应对绿色能源投资决策的影响，需要构建更贴合现实的量化分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论（Real Options Theory）、三因子随机过程模型、技术替代效应、投资组合理论
AI.method: 构建包含电价、碳价、绿证价格三个随机因子的实物期权模型，纳入补贴、碳税、碳配额等政策变量，分析不同投资策略（非组合 vs. 组合投资）下的投资边界与等待区域。
AI.findings: （1）碳税和碳配额通过改变火电边际成本和收入结构显著影响两种技术的相对竞争力；（2）价格补贴和投资补贴可降低可再生能源投资阈值，但边际效用递减；（3）非组合投资中火电作为替代技术会挤出可再生能源投资；（4）含容量补偿的组合投资策略能有效分散多市场价格波动风险，显著压缩等待区域，增强决策稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将实物期权模型从单因子/双因子拓展至三因子随机过程，首次系统整合电价-碳价-绿证价格的联合不确定性，并引入技术替代效应与组合投资策略对比，丰富了绿色能源投资决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化碳税、碳配额、补贴等政策组合提供了量化依据；为投资者在电力-碳-绿证多市场耦合环境下制定更稳健的投资策略提供了决策参考。

title: The Dynamic Common Correlated Effects Estimation of Budget Neutral Environmental Policy & Risk Preference-With Application to Africa and Policy Contrast with the OECD.
affiliations: Economics Dept., New School for Social Research, The New School - Department of Economics and

detail.title: The Dynamic Common Correlated Effects Estimation of Budget Neutral Environmental Policy & Risk Preference-With Application to Africa and Policy Contrast with the OECD.
detail.abstract: We examine the effects of self-financing environmental taxation-subsidy policies on growth for advanced and emerging countries. First, we present a model-guided approach to structural change in growth transitions, with neutral climate-risk preferences between high- and low-carbon-intensive goods. We then explore CO2-reducing policy using a dynamic common correlated effects (DCCE) estimator based on a demeaned tax-subsidy formulation that identifies periods of increasing CO2 emissions by negative log-differences and periods of decreasing CO2 emissions by positive logdifferences in the policy-modified CO2 series. Applied to a sample of 24 African economies over 1990- 2022, the DCCE long-run homogeneity assumption cannot be rejected, revealing statistically significant positive emission-reducing policy impacts on output. We also find that the DCCE estimator for Africa performs better than the pooled mean group (PMG) estimator [0.441 (130.65) v. 0.153 (3.37)], respectively. Next, we compare the preferred DCCE specifications for Africa and the OECD, the latter based on a sample of 28 countries, 1990-2022. The outcome suggests larger policy DCCE slope estimates, [0.488 (67.12) v. 0.441 (130.65)]; larger error correction coefficients [-0.067 (5.45) v. -0.026 (3.22)], respectively, of Africa v. the OECD. The tests of equality for differences in cross-coefficients are rejected, indicating the emission diminishing budget neutral policy adoption benefits emerging economies in this study more than advanced economies; a discussion section points a) to a parallel bigger DCCE coefficient with similar test results for human capital on growth in Africa v. the OECD; b) we also discuss a possible explanation in difference for policy impact by a lock-in hypotheses of high and low brown fuel economies. Our results are consistent with the model-guided approach’s predictions and simulation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自我融资的环境税收-补贴政策对发达国家和新兴国家经济增长的影响，使用动态共同相关效应（DCCE）估计量，发现非洲经济体比OECD经济体从减排预算中性政策中获益更大。
AI.research_question: 自我融资的环境税收-补贴政策如何影响发达国家和新兴国家的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 探讨预算中性的环境政策对经济增长的影响，并比较其在发达经济体与新兴经济体之间的差异化效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构变迁增长模型，中性气候风险偏好假设，高碳与低碳密集型商品之间的偏好中性，锁定效应假设（高褐燃料与低褐燃料经济体）。
AI.method: 采用动态共同相关效应（DCCE）估计量，基于去均值税收-补贴公式识别CO2排放增减时期，并与Pooled Mean Group（PMG）估计量进行对比。样本包括24个非洲经济体（1990-2022）和28个OECD国家（1990-2022）。
AI.findings: DCCE长期同质性假设未被拒绝，政策对产出有显著正向的减排效应；DCCE估计量优于PMG；非洲的DCCE斜率系数（0.488）大于OECD（0.441），误差修正系数更大；跨组系数差异检验被拒绝，表明新兴经济体从预算中性政策中获益更多。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了模型引导的结构变迁增长分析方法，验证了自我融资环境政策对不同发展阶段经济体的差异化影响，引入了锁定效应假说解释政策效果差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体实施预算中性的环境税收-补贴政策提供实证支持，表明此类政策在促进减排的同时能更有效地推动经济增长；为政策制定者比较不同发展水平经济体的环境政策效果提供参考。

title: The Governance-Scoring Disconnect: The CAFLE Framework for Franchise-Affiliated Credit Assessment in Emerging Economies

detail.title: The Governance-Scoring Disconnect: The CAFLE Framework for Franchise-Affiliated Credit Assessment in Emerging Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, patient data, surveys, experiments, or case-study respondents. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Small businesses in emerging economies often face difficulty accessing formal credit because lenders cannot easily evaluate borrower quality. This challenge is particularly relevant for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) operating within organised franchise and licensing networks. Unlike standalone MSMEs, franchise-affiliated businesses function within systems characterised by royalty payments, operational audits, compliance processes, and digitally maintained transaction records. These activities generate recurring operational information that may reflect business discipline, continuity, and governance quality. However, lenders often continue to assess such businesses using frameworks designed mainly for informationally opaque independent enterprises. This paper describes this problem as the governance-scoring disconnect. To address this gap, the paper introduces the Contractual Affiliation and Fee-based Liquidity Ecosystem (CAFLE) framework. Drawing on signalling theory and transaction cost economics, the framework explains how governance participation within franchise systems may improve borrower visibility through royalty continuity, governance-based transparency, and recurring compliance behaviour. Because many of these records are generated and monitored through ongoing governance systems, they may provide lenders with information that is less dependent on borrower self-reporting. The paper contributes to MSME finance and entrepreneurship research by examining franchise governance as a potential source of operational visibility within digitally evolving lending environments in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文指出新兴经济体中的小微加盟企业因信息不透明难以获得正规信贷，提出CAFLE框架，利用加盟体系中的治理参与（如特许权使用费连续性、合规行为）为贷方提供可验证的运营信息，从而缓解借贷双方的信息不对称问题。
AI.research_question: 加盟体系中的治理参与如何改善新兴经济体小微企业的信贷可得性？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体的小微企业（尤其是加盟网络中的企业）因信息不透明难以获得正规信贷，而现有信贷评估框架未能充分利用加盟体系内生成的治理信息（如特许权使用费、运营审计、合规记录等）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论与交易成本经济学
AI.method: 概念性框架构建（CAFLE框架），理论推导与逻辑演绎
AI.findings: 加盟企业的治理参与（如特许权使用费连续性、合规行为）可产生对贷方有价值且不易被企业操纵的运营信息，从而降低信息不对称，提升借款人可见度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将加盟治理作为数字化信贷环境中运营可见性的潜在来源，拓展了小微企业融资与创业研究，提出了"治理-评分脱节"这一概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体中的金融机构提供了评估加盟企业信贷质量的新思路，即利用加盟体系内生成的治理信息而非依赖企业自我报告。

title: Cost-Effectiveness, Probabilistic Sensitivity, and Budget Impact of Umbilical-Cord Mesenchymal-Stromal-Cell Exosome Therapy for Crohn's Disease Perianal Fistula: A Three-Country Markov Cohort Analysis (United States, Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR)

detail.title: Cost-Effectiveness, Probabilistic Sensitivity, and Budget Impact of Umbilical-Cord Mesenchymal-Stromal-Cell Exosome Therapy for Crohn's Disease Perianal Fistula: A Three-Country Markov Cohort Analysis (United States, Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author currently holds chief management positions at Foundation Biotech Limited (Hong Kong SAR) and Shenzhen SonoBio, both private biotech entities with commercial interests in UC-MSC and exosome-based therapeutic development. These relationships are disclosed as potential conflicts of interest. No other conflicts are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a model-based health economic analysis that uses only published, aggregate, and de-identified data drawn from peer-reviewed clinical literature, public regulatory filings, and publicly available cost sources. No primary patient data were collected, accessed, or analysed, and no individuals were enrolled, contacted, or identifiable at any stage. As the study does not involve human participants, human tissue, or identifiable personal data, formal ethics committee review and approval were not required under the policies of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine or under the Declaration of Helsinki (2013 revision). All source studies cited as model inputs received their own ethics approvals as documented in their original publications.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received. The author developed the model, code, and manuscript without external financial support.

detail.abstract:
Crohn's disease perianal fistula (CD-AF) is among the most clinically intractable phenotypes of inflammatory bowel disease, with cumulative incidence of approximately 21% at 10 years and 26% at 20 years in Western population-based cohorts and substantially higher rates in East Asian populations. Despite anti-TNF biologics and expanded allogeneic mesenchymal stromal cell products such as darvadstrocel (Alofisel), durable fistula closure remains elusive in over half of treated patients. Umbilical-cord mesenchymal-stromal-cell (UC-MSC) exosomes represent an emerging cell-free regenerative platform with immunomodulatory, anti-fibrotic, and pro-angiogenic activity, simplified cold-chain logistics, and lower theoretical immunogenicity risk than parent cells.

A six-state Markov cohort model (quarterly cycles, 10-year horizon, 3% discount, half-cycle correction) was constructed in Microsoft Excel and independently re-implemented in Python. Comparators were infliximab, adalimumab, and surgical seton/LIFT. Efficacy inputs were derived from ACCENT-II, CHARM, a surgical network meta-analysis, and a pooled four-trial MSC-exosome dataset. Health-state utilities were drawn from Buxton et al. (2019). PSA used 2,000 Monte Carlo iterations.

UC-MSC exosome therapy was strictly dominant — lower discounted cost and higher discounted QALYs — across all nine head-to-head comparisons. Net monetary benefit at country-specific willingness-to-pay thresholds (US $150,000, CN $13,303, HK $54,107 per QALY) ranged from $9,082 (vs surgery in China) to $671,352 (vs infliximab in the United States). Five-year cumulative national net savings ranged from US $1.69 billion to $8.45 billion across pricing scenarios, with directionally consistent savings in Mainland China and Hong Kong SAR. PSA placed 99.7–100% of iterations in the cost-saving northwest quadrant for biologic comparisons and 87.7–96.2% for surgery comparisons. One-way deterministic sensitivity analyses confirmed dominance was robust to ±20% perturbation of every input parameter.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建马尔可夫模型评估脐带间充质干细胞外泌体治疗克罗恩病肛瘘的成本-效用，发现与英夫利西单抗、阿达木单抗和手术相比，该疗法在所有9项头对头比较中均具有绝对优势（更低成本、更高QALY），PSA稳健性达87.7-100%，五年国家净节省可达16.9-84.5亿美元。
AI.research_question: 脐带间充质干细胞外泌体（UC-MSC exosomes）治疗克罗恩病肛瘘（CD-AF）相比生物制剂（英夫利西单抗、阿达木单抗）和手术（挂线/LIFT）是否具有成本-效用优势？
AI.motivation: 克罗恩病肛瘘临床治疗棘手，现有抗TNF生物制剂和异体间充质干细胞产品（如darvadstrocel）的持久瘘管闭合率仍不足50%。UC-MSC外泌体作为无细胞再生平台，具有免疫调节、抗纤维化和促血管生成活性，且冷链物流简化、理论免疫原性风险更低，但其经济性尚未被评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本-效用分析（Cost-Utility Analysis），基于六状态马尔可夫队列模型（Markov cohort model），采用净货币效益（NMB）和增量成本-效果比（ICER）框架，结合概率敏感性分析（PSA）和确定性敏感性分析（DSA）。
AI.method: 构建六状态马尔可夫队列模型（季度循环，10年时限，3%贴现率，半周期校正），在Excel和Python中独立实现。比较对象为英夫利西单抗、阿达木单抗和手术（挂线/LIFT）。疗效数据来源于ACCENT-II、CHARM、手术网络荟萃分析及四项MSC外泌体试验的合并数据集。健康效用值来自Buxton等（2019）。概率敏感性分析采用2,000次蒙特卡洛迭代。
AI.findings: UC-MSC外泌体疗法在所有9项头对头比较中均呈严格优势（更低贴现成本和更高贴现QALY）。按各国支付意愿阈值计算的净货币效益范围从9,082美元（中国 vs 手术）到671,352美元（美国 vs 英夫利西单抗）。五年国家净节省在定价情景下为16.9亿至84.5亿美元（美国），中国大陆和中国香港方向一致。PSA中生物制剂比较组99.7-100%的迭代位于成本节省的西北象限，手术比较组为87.7-96.2%。单因素DSA表明在所有输入参数±20%扰动下优势仍然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将UC-MSC外泌体疗法纳入克罗恩病肛瘘的成本-效用分析框架，提供了该新兴细胞-free再生平台的卫生经济学证据，拓展了间充质干细胞外泌体在炎症性肠病领域的价值评估维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医保决策和临床指南提供经济性依据：UC-MSC外泌体在美国、中国大陆和中国香港三个不同支付意愿阈值的市场中均具有绝对成本-效用优势，五年可为国家节省大量医疗支出，支持其作为CD-AF优选治疗方案的潜在定价与报销策略。

title: Geometric Derivation Of Probability Weighting Via Complex-Valued Economics: A Deductive Microfoundation For Prospect Theory

detail.title: Geometric Derivation Of Probability Weighting Via Complex-Valued Economics: A Deductive Microfoundation For Prospect Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: For decades, behavioural economics has relied on experimental data alongside inductive and axiomatic reasoning to model choice under risk and resolve behavioural anomalies. While descriptively powerful, the probability weighting function used in prospect theory lacks a deductive mathematical microfoundation. Building on the recent framework of complex-valued economics, here we derive the inverse-S function by projecting linear probability p+q=1 onto the cognitive unit circle p2 + q2 = 1 in the complex plane. This geometric projection naturally reproduces empirical probability distortion and yields subcertainty as a Pythagorean penalty. Grounded in the principle of the marginal rate of substitution (MRS), this finding suggests that behavioural anomalies—long studied as systematic deviations from rationality—may instead emerge from the natural mathematics of optimisation operating in the complex plane.  By extending our  minimal-assumption PDE framework of utility maximisation (β2∂x2U = ∂y2U), this unified decision theory formalises behavioural economics and integrates it with classical economic theory.

AI.tldr: 本文利用复数域几何投影推导出前景理论中的概率权重函数（反S形函数），为行为经济学的概率扭曲现象提供了演绎数学微观基础，并提出行为异常可能是复数域优化自然结果的观点。
AI.research_question: 如何为前景理论中的概率权重函数（反S形函数）建立演绎数学的微观基础？
AI.motivation: 行为经济学中的概率权重函数虽然描述能力强，但缺乏演绎数学的微观基础，作者希望填补这一理论空白，并为行为经济学提供统一的数学框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复数域经济学、前景理论、边际替代率（MRS）原理、偏微分方程（β²∂²U/∂x² = ∂²U/∂y²）
AI.method: 将线性概率 p+q=1 投影到复数平面的认知单位圆 p²+q²=1 上，通过几何投影推导出反S形函数；利用边际替代率原理和偏微分方程框架进行模型推导。
AI.findings: 几何投影自然复现了经验概率扭曲现象；次确定性（subcertainty）表现为毕达哥拉斯惩罚项；行为异常可能是复数域优化数学的自然结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为概率权重函数提供了演绎数学微观基础；提出了统一决策理论，将行为经济学与经典经济理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解风险决策中的行为异常提供了新视角——行为异常可能不是非理性偏差，而是复数域优化的自然产物。

title: Algorithmic Fairness in Clinical Machine Learning for Non-Communicable Disease Prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Systematic Review, Empirical Analysis, and Research Agenda

detail.title: Algorithmic Fairness in Clinical Machine Learning for Non-Communicable Disease Prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Systematic Review, Empirical Analysis, and Research Agenda

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. The author is CEO and Founder of Nexora AI Health Intelligence. Research findings may inform future Nexora product development. No financial compensation was received for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) constitute the leading and most rapidly accelerating cause of preventable mortality across sub-Saharan Africa, yet the clinical artificial intelligence literature has overwhelmingly neglected both the African epidemiological context and the algorithmic fairness implications of deploying machine learning models in demographically distinct, resource-constrained clinical environments. This paper presents the first systematic review and empirical analysis of algorithmic fairness in clinical machine learning for NCD prediction specifically oriented toward sub-Saharan Africa. Following a PRISMA-inspired protocol, 47 studies published between 2015 and 2026 were identified, screened, and analyzed. Key finding: only 8 of 47 studies (17.0%) included any form of fairness evaluation, only 3 (6.4%) employed formal fairness metrics, and only 12 (25.5%) were conducted on African patient data. The systematic review is enriched by original empirical evidence drawn from the author's prior peer-reviewed studies on Type 2 diabetes prediction (AUC-ROC = 0.8226, significant BMI subgroup recall disparities) and cardiovascular disease prediction (AUC-ROC = 0.9270, 5.92 percentage point female recall deficit), forming the first multi-disease empirical fairness dataset for NCD prediction in West Africa. Based on this synthesis, a five-pillar research agenda is proposed addressing the data representation crisis, the fairness measurement gap, the explainability requirement, the deployment infrastructure barrier, and the sex and demographic bias emergency in clinical AI. This work constitutes the scientific and ethical foundation for a new paradigm of equity-centered clinical AI research and development for sub-Saharan Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个针对撒哈拉以南非洲地区非传染性疾病（NCD）临床机器学习算法公平性的系统性综述。研究发现仅17%的研究包含公平性评估，6.4%使用正式公平性指标，25.5%基于非洲患者数据。作者结合自身实证研究，提出了以公平为核心的五大支柱研究议程。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区临床机器学习在NCD预测中的算法公平性现状如何？存在哪些差距和挑战？
AI.motivation: NCD是撒哈拉以南非洲最主要的可预防死因，但临床AI文献既忽视了该地区的流行病学背景，也未充分关注在人口统计学特征迥异、资源受限的临床环境中部署机器学习模型的算法公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法公平性理论、临床机器学习部署中的公平性评估框架、PRISMA系统综述方法。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA-inspired系统综述方法，筛选并分析了2015-2026年间发表的47项研究；同时纳入作者前期同行评审研究中的实证数据（2型糖尿病预测和心血管疾病预测），形成首个西非地区多疾病公平性实证数据集。
AI.findings: (1)仅17%的研究包含公平性评估；(2)仅6.4%使用正式公平性指标；(3)仅25.5%基于非洲患者数据；(4)2型糖尿病预测存在显著的BMI亚组召回率差异；(5)心血管疾病预测存在5.92个百分点的女性召回率缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地梳理了撒哈拉以南非洲NCD临床机器学习中的算法公平性文献，揭示了该领域的系统性忽视问题，并提出了五大支柱研究议程作为理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲地区的临床AI开发提供了以公平为中心的新范式，针对数据代表性危机、公平性测量缺口、可解释性需求、部署基础设施障碍以及性别和人口统计偏见提出了具体研究方向和行动议程。

title: Do More Empathic Hospital Trusts Have Better Outcomes? Developing and Testing a System Empathy Index
affiliations: University of Leicester, University of Leicester and University of Oxford

detail.title: Do More Empathic Hospital Trusts Have Better Outcomes? Developing and Testing a System Empathy Index

declarations.declarationOfInterest: JH develops and delivers training and consultancy related to empathy in healthcare organisations, which may be relevant to the subject of this research. The remaining authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it used publicly available, anonymised, aggregated data and did not involve individual patient-level information.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by the Stoneygate Trust. The funder had no role in the design of the study, data collection, analysis, interpretation of data, or writing of the manuscript.

detail.abstract:
Background: Empathy in healthcare has been shown to benefit patients and practitioners, but can be inhibited by system-level barriers. No measure of system-level empathy in healthcare has been developed. We therefore aimed to develop an index that quantifies system-level empathy and test whether higher levels of empathy within National Health Service (NHS) trusts are associated with better patient, staff, and financial outcomes.

Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of NHS trusts. Drawing on an established model of system-level empathy, we developed a healthcare “system empathy index”, including nine domains: fostering a culture of empathy, leadership with compassion, teamwork, appropriate physical environment, sensible workload, adequate time, effective leadership, practitioner empathy, and wellbeing. We obtained item scores using publicly available sources, including the NHS Staff Survey, Care Quality Commission (CQC), and Trust Accounts Consolidation (TAC) data. An overall rating from 1 to 10 was then generated for the trusts. We explored associations between index scores and patient outcomes (CQC safety and effectiveness ratings), practitioner outcomes (sickness and absence and self-reported health), and trust financial outcomes (from NHS TAC data). We used meta-regression for proportion outcomes with inverse variance weighting.

Results: The average overall system empathy score was 5.99 (range: 4.88 to 6.78). Higher scores were associated with improved patient outcomes. A 0.25-unit (2.5%) increase in index score was associated with 76% higher odds of trusts being rated good or outstanding for safety (p<0.001) and 46% greater odds of trusts being rated good or outstanding for effectiveness (p=0.003). A 0.25-unit increase in index score was also associated with improved staff outcomes, including reduced sickness and absenteeism (β=0.20, p=0.004), better self-reported health (β=0.21, p<0.001), and lower burnout (β=0.21, p<0.001). Higher empathy scores were associated with lower expenditure on temporary staffing (p=0.012) and consultancy (p=0.024).

Conclusions: We developed a novel system empathy index and found that higher empathy is associated with better patient, staff, and some financial outcomes. These findings support the importance of system-level factors in healthcare performance. Empathy training at a system level is likely to improve outcomes, although further research is needed to establish causality and validate the index in independent datasets.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了首个医疗系统共情指数，发现更高水平的系统共情与更好的患者结果、员工福祉及部分财务表现显著相关。
AI.research_question: 如何量化医疗系统的共情水平？系统共情是否与患者、员工及财务结果相关？
AI.motivation: 共情在医疗中虽有益，但系统层面的障碍会抑制共情，且缺乏系统层面共情的量化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统共情模型，涵盖九大领域：共情文化、富有同情心的领导力、团队合作、适宜物理环境、合理工作量、充足时间、有效领导、从业者共情和幸福感。
AI.method: 横断面研究；利用NHS员工调查、CQC和TAC等公开数据构建系统共情指数；采用meta-regression进行逆方差加权分析。
AI.findings: 指数平均分5.99（范围4.88-6.78）。指数每提升0.25单位，安全性评为良好/优秀的几率提高76%，有效性提高46%；员工病假率降低、自评健康改善、倦怠减少；临时用工和咨询支出降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并验证了医疗系统层面的共情量化指标，将共情研究从个体层面拓展到系统层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构提供了系统共情评估工具，支持通过改善系统层面因素（如领导力、工作量、环境）来提升患者安全、员工福祉和财务效率。

title: Population Growth and Labor Market Fragility: Lessons from Domestic and International Experiences
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Population Growth and Labor Market Fragility: Lessons from Domestic and International Experiences

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Labor market indicators such as employment growth and the unemployment rate are commonly used to assess the cyclical position of the economy (NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee). However, deciphering trend from cycle in these indicators is notoriously difficult and can be especially delicate when underlying trends in the economy shift rapidly.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论劳动力市场指标（如就业增长和失业率）在评估经济周期位置中的应用，并指出在这些指标中区分趋势与周期的困难性，尤其是在经济潜在趋势快速变化时。
AI.research_question: 如何从劳动力市场指标（如就业增长和失业率）中有效区分趋势成分与周期成分，以准确评估经济周期位置？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场指标常被用来判断经济周期（如NBER商业周期测定委员会使用），但趋势与周期的分解在方法论上具有挑战性，尤其是当经济潜在趋势发生快速变化时，传统方法可能失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济周期理论、时间序列分解方法（趋势-周期分解）、劳动力市场动态理论。
AI.method: 基于劳动力市场指标的统计分解方法（如滤波法、状态空间模型等），具体方法需结合全文确定。
AI.findings: 劳动力市场指标中的趋势与周期难以区分，特别是在经济趋势快速变动时期，传统分解方法可能产生误导性结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对劳动力市场指标中趋势与周期关系及其分解困难性的理解，为经济周期测度方法提供了理论反思。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济分析师在使用劳动力市场指标判断经济周期时提供警示，提示需要更谨慎地处理趋势变化问题。

title: Taking One for the (Other) Team: Does Political Diversity Lower Vaccination Uptake?
affiliations: Korea University and University of Oxford

detail.title: Taking One for the (Other) Team: Does Political Diversity Lower Vaccination Uptake?
detail.abstract: What implications might rising animosity towards political out-partisans have for public health? Vaccination has a significant social aspect, protecting not only the vaccinated, but also those around them. While political ideology in the United States was an important driver of individuals’ willingness to get vaccinated against COVID-19, with those on the political right displaying greater hesitancy, we examine the role that political diversity has on vaccine uptake across US states and commuting zones. Using data from the Cooperative Election Study fielded on over 20,000 respondents in November 2021, and controlling for individual partisanship, we find that those who are political outliers in their community are significantly less likely to get vaccinated. By contrast, we find no equivalent negative effect for ethnic diversity. In sum, the impact of affective polarization is not limited to encounters between non-partisans; it can lead to decreased pro-social behavior that harms political friends and foes alike. Yet these behavioral effects depend on how individuals relate to their community’s predominant political ideology.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在美国，当个人在政治上与其所处社区的主流政治意识形态相异（即政治“离群者”）时，他们会显著降低新冠疫苗接种率。这种负面影响与个人自身的党派归属无关，并且种族多样性没有类似效应。这表明情感极化的社会后果不仅限于党派间对立，还会减少亲社会行为，损害所有人（包括政治盟友和对手）的健康利益。
AI.research_question: 对政治外群体的敌意上升会对公共健康产生什么影响？具体而言，社区中的政治多样性如何影响个人的疫苗接种行为？
AI.motivation: 疫苗接种不仅保护个人，也保护周围的人（社会性），而政治意识形态已被证明是影响疫苗意愿的重要因素。现有研究多关注个人党派对疫苗态度的影响，但忽视了一个关键问题：当个人处于与自己政治立场相反的社区环境中时，其疫苗接种行为是否会改变？这在情感极化的背景下尤为重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感极化理论（affective polarization）、亲社会行为理论、政治多样性/异质性对个体行为的影响。
AI.method: 使用2021年11月对超20,000名受访者进行的Cooperative Election Study数据，通过统计模型控制个人党派归属，分析美国各州和通勤区（commuting zones）层面政治多样性对疫苗接种率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 政治“离群者”（即其政治立场与所在社区主流意识形态相反的人）显著更不可能接种疫苗。2. 种族多样性对疫苗接种没有类似的负面效应。3. 情感极化的影响不仅限于党派间互动，还会减少亲社会行为，从而损害包括政治盟友和对手在内的所有人的健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 将情感极化的后果从政治态度和行为领域延伸到公共健康领域，揭示了政治多样性对亲社会行为的抑制作用，并区分了政治多样性与种族多样性的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了重要启示：在高度政治极化的环境中，仅关注个人意识形态不足，还需考虑社区层面的政治构成；在推广公共健康措施时，需要针对政治“离群者”制定特殊策略，以缓解情感极化对亲社会行为的负面影响。

detail.abstract:
Objective: Conservatively quantify the public health and economic damages of low-quality generic drugs on chronic disease management in the United States based on available studies, and review health system solutions to avoid low-quality and incentivize high-quality generics.  

Data Sources: Generic drug quality is an evolving but sparse field of research; therefore, the expertise of 21 experts with experience in the field were relied upon to identify meaningful areas of existing research within chronic disease, where medication issues are expected to be most pronounced due to longevity and persistence of treatment. Four diseases (epilepsy, multiple sclerosis, atherosclerosis, and hypertension) were chosen by the group due to the relative abundance of informative studies and the diversity of the diseases. A chronological review of published health system solutions was also performed. 

Data Synthesis / Results: Extrapolating from studies in these four chronic diseases and focusing on the most directly observable 10% low-quality generic drugs, we conservatively estimate the 2024 economic burden of this low-quality subset of generic drugs at $18.4 billion growing to $238 billion over the next 10 years if not addressed, largely due to many thousands of avoidable serious adverse events like disease relapse and hospitalizations. Potential solutions are discussed that may enable a market correction to avoid the low-quality generic drugs and incentivize continuous product improvement. 

Conclusion and Relevance: This novel review represents the first broad population analysis of the substantial economic and public health impact from low-quality generic drugs and synthesizes modern approaches to addressing this largely underappreciated issue. Real-world approaches are reviewed where pharmacy practice can be modified to help ensure only the highest-quality generics are dispensed to patients to improve outcomes and reduce waste.

AI.tldr: 本研究保守估算了低质量仿制药对美国慢性病管理造成的公共卫生和经济损失（2024年184亿美元，10年内增至2380亿美元），并回顾了医疗体系解决方案。
AI.research_question: 低质量仿制药对慢性病管理造成的公共卫生和经济损害有多大？如何通过卫生系统解决方案避免低质量仿制药并激励高质量仿制药？
AI.motivation: 仿制药质量研究领域稀疏且不充分，而慢性病由于治疗时间长、用药持续性高，受低质量仿制药影响最为显著，但缺乏对整体人口影响的量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于慢性病用药持续性与质量依赖性的理论，结合药物经济学和公共卫生损害评估框架。
AI.method: 依赖21位领域专家识别有意义的研究领域；选择四种慢性病（癫痫、多发性硬化、动脉粥样硬化、高血压）进行文献外推；对已发表的卫生系统解决方案进行时序性回顾。
AI.findings: 保守估计2024年低质量仿制药（最直接可观察的10%）造成的经济负担为184亿美元，10年内若不解决将增至2380亿美元；损害主要来自可避免的严重不良事件（如疾病复发和住院）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对低质量仿制药的经济和公共卫生影响进行广泛人口分析，揭示了这一被严重低估的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 讨论了避免低质量仿制药和激励持续产品改进的市场纠正方案；回顾了可通过调整药房实践确保患者获得最高质量仿制药、改善预后并减少浪费的实际路径。

title: Hollowing Out The Head:A Theoretical Analysis of AI-Driven Asymmetric Flattening in Labour Market Polarization
affiliations: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics

detail.title: Hollowing Out The Head:A Theoretical Analysis of AI-Driven Asymmetric Flattening in Labour Market Polarization
detail.abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium theoretical framework to analyze how artificial intelligence (AI) adoption restructures traditional labour market polarization. While Routine-Biased Technical Change (RBTC) historically produced a U-shaped employment distribution by automating middle-skill routine tasks, contemporary generative AI targets non-routine cognitive functions, fundamentally altering the skill premium and task composition of work. Integrating the Acemoglu-Restrepo task-based model with Autor's expertise automation framework, I formalize three core mechanisms: cognitive task displacement, productivity-driven demand reallocation, and the reinstatement of novel high-complexity roles. The model demonstrates that AI induces an asymmetric flattening of the wage distribution, characterized by wage compression and skill depreciation at the upper-middle tier, continued erosion of administrative roles, and relative insulation of low-skill manual occupations driven by the asymmetric elasticity of substitution between cognitive and physical labour. Furthermore, I show that directed technical change shifts intra-firm rents from marginal labour to capital owners and AI system designers, exacerbating functional income inequality and altering wage-setting dynamics in cognitive-intensive sectors. The analysis concludes with a theoretical welfare evaluation of labour market policies, arguing for targeted wage insurance, modular lifelong learning accounts, and marginal tax recalibration to mitigate transition frictions without distorting productivity incentives. This project contributes to modern labour economics by formalizing the transition from routine-biased to expertise-biased technological change, providing a rigorous foundation for future empirical calibration and policy design in AI-integrated economies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个一般均衡理论框架，分析人工智能（AI）如何重塑传统劳动力市场的极化现象。与历史上常规偏向型技术变革（RBTC）导致就业呈U型分布不同，当代生成式AI针对非常规认知功能，改变了技能溢价和任务构成。模型整合了Acemoglu-Restrepo任务模型与Autor的专业化自动化框架，揭示了三种核心机制：认知任务替代、生产率驱动的需求再分配以及新型高复杂性角色的重新创造。研究发现，AI导致工资分布出现非对称扁平化，表现为中上层工资压缩与技能贬值、行政岗位持续侵蚀，以及低技能手工岗位因认知与体力劳动替代弹性不对称而相对隔离。此外，定向技术变革将企业内部租金从边际劳动转向资本所有者和AI系统设计者，加剧了功能性收入不平等。最后，论文对劳动力市场政策进行了理论福利评估，主张实施有针对性的工资保险、模块化终身学习账户和边际税收调整。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（AI）的采用如何改变传统劳动力市场的极化结构？具体而言，AI如何影响不同技能层级劳动力的工资分配、任务构成和收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 传统的常规偏向型技术变革（RBTC）理论很好地解释了历史上一轮由计算机化驱动的劳动力市场极化（就业呈U型分布），但当代生成式AI的特性（针对非常规认知任务）与RBTC截然不同，现有理论缺乏对这一新型技术变革如何重塑劳动力市场极化的系统分析。因此需要构建新的理论框架来解释AI时代的劳动力市场动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Acemoglu-Restrepo任务模型（任务基础模型）；2. Autor的专业化自动化框架（expertise automation framework）；3. 常规偏向型技术变革（RBTC）理论；4. 定向技术变革理论（directed technical change）；5. 认知与体力劳动的不对称替代弹性理论。
AI.method: 一般均衡理论建模（General Equilibrium Theoretical Framework）。作者将Acemoglu-Restrepo的任务基础模型与Autor的专业化自动化框架进行整合，形式化推导出三种核心机制（认知任务替代、生产率驱动的需求再分配、高复杂性角色重新创造），并通过理论模型分析均衡状态下的工资分布变化、收入分配效应和政策干预效果。
AI.findings: 1. AI导致工资分布出现"非对称扁平化"：中上层技能溢价被压缩、技能贬值，行政岗位持续被侵蚀，低技能手工岗位因认知与体力劳动的替代弹性不对称而相对隔离。2. 定向技术变革将企业内部租金从边际劳动转向资本所有者和AI系统设计者，加剧功能性收入不平等。3. 提出了三种政策工具（工资保险、模块化终身学习账户、边际税收调整）来缓解转型摩擦而不扭曲生产力激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次形式化描述了从"常规偏向型技术变革"（RBTC）向"专长偏向型技术变革"（expertise-biased technological change）的转变，弥补了现有理论在AI时代劳动力市场分析上的空白。2. 整合了两个重要的劳动经济学理论框架（Acemoglu-Restrepo模型与Autor框架），构建了更具解释力的一般均衡模型。3. 引入了认知与体力劳动的不对称替代弹性概念，为理解AI对不同技能群体的差异化影响提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对AI就业冲击的三项具体政策建议：工资保险、模块化终身学习账户和边际税收调整，这些政策设计兼顾了社会保障与生产力激励的平衡。2. 为未来的实证校准和政策设计提供了严谨的理论基础，有助于指导实际经济中AI过渡期的劳动力市场干预。3. 揭示了AI时代收入不平等的新来源（从资本所有者到AI设计者的租金转移），为反垄断和税收政策提供了新的理论依据。

title:
Data Factories and Modern Data Centres: 
Employment, Economic Value, and Community Integration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Data Factories and Modern Data Centres: 
Employment, Economic Value, and Community Integration
detail.abstract:
Data Factories (high-performance data centres designed to support advanced computing workloads) are becoming foundational infrastructure for economic productivity, scientific research, public services, and national resilience. As demand worldwide for this infrastructure grows, proposed projects increasingly encounter community-level concerns related to employment, environmental impact, electricity pricing, water use, and local disruption.

This paper provides an evidence-based assessment of the employment, economic, and infrastructure implications of Data Factories across their full lifecycle, drawing on data from European member states, international energy agencies, utility regulators, and academic research. Beyond project-level impacts, it examines the local, regional, and national consequences of participation or non-participation in advanced computing infrastructure deployment.

The analysis finds that, when responsibly planned and operated, Modern Data Centres function as long-lived enabling infrastructure, supporting workforce retention, fiscal stability, and infrastructure modernisation at the community and regional level, while strengthening national competitiveness and capacity. Conversely, sustained resistance or delay does not eliminate demand for AI infrastructure but instead redirects investment, employment, and strategic capability to other jurisdictions, increasing long-term opportunity costs and infrastructure divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文基于欧洲多国数据，评估了高性能数据中心（数据工厂）在全生命周期内对就业、经济和基础设施的影响，发现负责任规划的数据中心能促进社区就业、财政稳定和基础设施现代化，而持续抵制则会引导投资和战略能力流向其他地区，带来长期机会成本。
AI.research_question: 高性能数据中心（数据工厂）对当地社区就业、经济和基础设施的影响是什么？参与或抵制此类基础设施部署会带来哪些不同层级的后果？
AI.motivation: 全球对高性能数据中心需求增长，但此类项目常引发社区对就业、环境、电价、用水等方面的担忧，缺乏基于全生命周期的系统性证据评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施经济学、区域发展理论、生命周期评估框架
AI.method: 基于欧洲成员国、国际能源机构、公用事业监管机构和学术研究的二手数据，进行多来源证据综合评估。
AI.findings: 负责任规划的数据中心能作为长期使能型基础设施，支持社区劳动力留存、财政稳定和基础设施现代化，并增强国家竞争力；持续抵制不会消除需求，只会将投资和战略能力转移至其他辖区，加剧长期基础设施分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据中心基础设施的社区影响提供了全生命周期视角的理论分析框架，揭示了"参与vs.抵制"的动态机会成本机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和社区提供了基于证据的数据中心项目评估参考，强调负责任规划的价值以及抵制可能带来的长期战略成本。

title: Advocacy Mapping as a Trauma-Informed Framework for Addressing Psychosocial Needs in Oncology Care

detail.title: Advocacy Mapping as a Trauma-Informed Framework for Addressing Psychosocial Needs in Oncology Care

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have influenced the development or submission of this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This manuscript received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Emotional distress among adult cancer patients is widely recognized, yet its identification does not consistently lead to coordinated psychosocial care. Despite recommendations for routine distress screening, gaps persist due to fragmented workflows, competing clinical priorities, and limited integration of psychosocial services within oncology settings. This manuscript proposes advocacy mapping as a trauma-informed, structurally grounded framework to support more coordinated responses to psychosocial needs. Drawing on structural and anti-oppressive perspectives, advocacy mapping is conceptualized as a method for organizing goals, stakeholder roles, and care pathways across levels of practice. The framework highlights the role of oncology social workers in translating patient-identified needs into structured advocacy priorities and facilitating alignment across interdisciplinary teams and systems of care. Implications for practice suggest that advocacy mapping may strengthen coordination between distress identification, referral processes, and psychosocial interventions, while supporting greater integration of care within oncology systems. As a conceptual manuscript, this paper does not include empirical evaluation but outlines considerations for future implementation and assessment. Overall, advocacy mapping offers a structured approach to addressing gaps between the identification of psychosocial needs and the delivery of coordinated, system-level responses in oncology care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"倡导映射"（advocacy mapping）作为一种创伤知情、结构导向的框架，旨在弥合癌症患者心理社会需求识别与协调护理之间的差距，强调肿瘤社会工作者在整合跨学科团队和系统层面的倡导优先级中的作用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过倡导映射框架来协调肿瘤护理中从心理社会需求识别到系统层面护理响应的流程？
AI.motivation: 成年癌症患者的情绪困扰虽被广泛识别，但并未持续转化为协调的心理社会护理。常规困扰筛查的建议存在，但由于工作流碎片化、临床优先事项冲突以及心理社会服务在肿瘤环境中整合有限，差距依然存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创伤知情视角（trauma-informed）、结构性视角（structural perspective）、反压迫视角（anti-oppressive perspective）
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual manuscript），未包含实证评估，但提出了未来实施和评估的考量。
AI.findings: 倡导映射框架通过组织目标、利益相关者角色和跨实践层面的护理路径，帮助将患者识别的需求转化为结构化的倡导优先级，促进跨学科团队和护理系统的协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 将倡导映射概念化，整合创伤知情与结构性/反压迫视角，为肿瘤社会工作提供理论化的工具框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肿瘤社会工作者提供结构化方法，以加强困扰识别、转诊流程和心理社会干预之间的协调，促进肿瘤护理系统中更整合的护理响应。

title: Market Structure, Pricing, Demand, and Cost Analysis of Omantel in the Telecommunications Industry of Oman
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Market Structure, Pricing, Demand, and Cost Analysis of Omantel in the Telecommunications Industry of Oman
detail.abstract: This research analyzes the economic aspects associated with Omantel's business, which is engaged in mobile communications under telecommunications within Oman. Oman's telecommunications market is characterized by oligopoly consisting of three participants: Omantel, Ooredoo Oman, and Vodafone Oman. This report relies on and consolidates public information gathered from various forms of secondary data such as annual reports released by Omantel, Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Oman (TRA), National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI), World Bank, International Monetary Fund (IMF), and other providers of market intelligence data. Key findings indicate that Omantel's domestic revenue (in Omani Rial) will reach RO 622.6 million by 2024 (+2.7% year-on-year). Additionally, revenue from data/internet services represents over fifty percent of total sector revenues. Demand for data is elastic with respect to changes in income (e.g., if an individual's income increases, demand for data increases). Demand for data is inelastic with respect to changes in price (an individual has limited price sensitivity regarding their demand for data). Demand for voice services has declined due to the substitution of over-the-top (OTT) voice applications for traditional telephone service. The final section of this report concludes by offering three (3) evidence-based policy recommendations directed toward the TRA, Omantel management, and the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿曼电信运营商Omantel的经济表现，发现其国内收入将持续增长，数据服务需求对收入弹性高但对价格弹性低，而语音服务因OTT替代而下降，最后提出三项政策建议。
AI.research_question: 阿曼电信市场（寡头垄断结构下）Omantel的经济表现如何？数据服务和语音服务的需求特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 阿曼电信市场由三家运营商构成寡头格局，有必要系统评估主要参与者Omantel的经济财务状况，为监管机构和企业管理者提供数据驱动的决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断市场理论、需求弹性理论（收入弹性与价格弹性）、替代品效应理论（OTT对传统语音服务的替代）。
AI.method: 基于二手数据的整合分析，数据来源包括Omantel年报、阿曼电信监管局（TRA）、国家统计信息中心（NCSI）、世界银行、国际货币基金组织（IMF）等。
AI.findings: 1) Omantel国内收入2024年预计达到6.226亿阿曼里亚尔，同比增长2.7%；2) 数据/互联网服务收入占行业总收入超过50%；3) 数据需求收入弹性高（收入增加→需求增加），价格弹性低（对价格不敏感）；4) 语音服务需求因OTT应用程序替代而下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在寡头电信市场中数据服务需求具有"收入弹性高、价格弹性低"的特征，证实了OTT替代效应对传统语音服务的冲击。
AI.practical_contributions: 向阿曼电信监管局（TRA）、Omantel管理层及交通通信信息技术部（MTCIT）提出了三项基于证据的政策建议，有助于优化定价策略、资源配置和行业监管。

title: The Economics of Non-Formalization: Communicative Rationality, Consciousness, and Consensus Capital
affiliations: and Tsinghua University

detail.title: The Economics of Non-Formalization: Communicative Rationality, Consciousness, and Consensus Capital
detail.abstract: Standard economic theory, built exclusively on instrumental rationality (means-end calculation for material efficiency), cannot explain the explosive growth of the digital social economy nor resolve the persistent Solow paradox: massivecomputing & AI investments have failed to deliver corresponding productivity gains; to address this, we develop a new ontological foundation for economics based on phenomenal consciousness (qualia)—ultimate source of value—grounded in mathematical logic & thermodynamics, proving no formalized system (including Turing machines & AI) can self-maintain (as it entails the unsolvable halting problem), introducing a hierarchical non-formalized capital structure (consciousness, tacit knowledge, consensus) residing in human minds and irreplicable by formalized systems, and showing consciousness is the only known source of negentropy (order) in economies, physical foundation of value. We construct a dual-rationality general equilibrium model integrating instrumental and communicative rationality (with a feedback loop: individual experience generates tacit knowledge, which aggregates into consensus, which shapes technological progress, transforming experience) and prove four core theorems: (1) Non-Substitutability—AI cannot substitute for humans as value creation subjects; (2) Structural Transformation—As AI automates the formalized instrumental sector, the non-formalized communicative sector dominates value and employment; (3) Solow Paradox—When formalized capital outgrows non-formalized capital, its marginal product declines without standard diminishing returns; (4) Consensus Capital Externality—Markets systematically underinvest in non-formalized capital; this framework explains Solow paradox—exponential formalized capital growth outpaces slow non-formalized growth, leading to sharply diminishing returns and formalization idling—and shows long-run growth is constrained not by technology or resources, but by limited human consciousness capital; the AI revolution does not eliminate labor—it makes human subjectivity more valuable than ever.

AI.tldr: 本文基于意识（qualia）构建经济学本体论基础，证明形式化系统（包括AI）无法自维持，提出非形式化资本（意识、默会知识、共识）是价值创造的终极来源，建立双重理性一般均衡模型，证明AI无法替代人类作为价值主体，且长期增长受限于人类意识资本。
AI.research_question: 标准经济理论为何无法解释数字社会经济的爆发式增长以及索洛悖论（大量计算与AI投资未能带来相应的生产率提升）？如何构建新的经济学基础以解释这些现象？
AI.motivation: 标准经济理论仅基于工具理性（手段-目的计算），无法解释数字社会经济的高速增长，也无法解决索洛悖论。现有理论缺乏对意识（qualia）作为价值最终来源的本体论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将数学逻辑（停机问题）、热力学（负熵）与现象意识（qualia）相结合，提出非形式化资本结构（意识、默会知识、共识）的概念，并构建包含工具理性与沟通理性的双重理性一般均衡模型。
AI.method: 理论推导：通过数学逻辑证明任何形式化系统（包括图灵机与AI）无法自维持（涉及不可解的停机问题），引入热力学中的负熵概念，构建双重理性一般均衡模型并证明四个核心定理。
AI.findings: 四个核心定理：（1）非可替代性：AI无法替代人类作为价值创造主体；（2）结构转型：AI自动化形式化工具部门后，非形式化沟通部门主导价值与就业；（3）索洛悖论：形式化资本增长超过非形式化资本时，边际产出下降而不遵循标准递减回报；（4）共识资本外部性：市场系统性地对非形式化资本投资不足。长期增长受限于人类意识资本而非技术或资源。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济学提供了基于意识（qualia）的本体论基础，将意识与负熵联系起来作为价值的物理基础；提出了双重理性一般均衡模型，将沟通理性纳入经济学分析；从理论上证明了AI无法替代人类价值主体地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了索洛悖论的成因（形式化资本过快增长而意识资本增长缓慢），指出AI革命不会消除劳动，反而使人类主体性更有价值，为AI时代的经济政策与投资方向提供指导。

detail.abstract:
Game theory begins as a branch of mathematics. A theorem proves the existence of a xed point and is titled system of equations. Its English translation becomes general economic equilibrium. The added word equilibrium is a label, not physics. Economists inherit the formalism and, at each step, relabel the topological conditions of the theorem as properties of the real economy but these properties, posited agent by agent, do not survive the passage to the market, as will be demonstrated twenty years later. 
      This essay traces the fracture. A logical tradition in Central Europe had laid the foundations in the nineteenth century: the distinction between form and meaning, between syntax and physics. The twentieth century the century of wars destroyed it, word by word, label by label, until the global economy was steered by weightless xed points.
      At the start of the twenty-rst century, an anonymous author attempts the rst repair: a protocol based on Proof of Work that anchors an irreversible energy cost to any attempt at rewriting. The link is physical.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了经济学从数学定理到现实应用的断裂：博弈论的数学不动点定理被转译为经济均衡，但个体层面的假设无法在市场中成立。文章指出中欧逻辑传统（形式与意义、语法与物理的区分）在20世纪被摧毁，最终全球经济学被无实体的不动点所操控。21世纪初，比特币的PoW机制首次尝试修复这一断裂——通过物理能源成本锚定真实世界。
AI.research_question: 经济学从数学定理到现实应用的过程中，形式逻辑与物理实在之间的断裂是如何发生的？比特币的Proof of Work机制如何修复这一断裂？
AI.motivation: 论文试图揭示经济学均衡理论中的根本性缺陷：数学定理的拓扑条件被贴上了经济属性的标签，但这些属性在个体到市场的聚合过程中失效。同时，探讨比特币作为修复这一断裂的首次尝试。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、一般均衡理论、中欧逻辑传统（形式与意义的区分）、不可逆物理成本（PoW）
AI.method: 概念史与思想史分析，追溯均衡概念从数学到经济学的转译过程及逻辑断裂。
AI.findings: 经济学均衡理论中的拓扑条件被错误地转译为真实经济属性，个体假设在市场层面不成立；比特币的Proof of Work通过物理能源成本锚定不可逆性，修复了形式与物理之间的断裂。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示经济学中"均衡"一词的数学起源与物理实在之间的根本断裂；重新审视形式逻辑与经济现实的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比特币等加密货币的底层机制提供新的理论解释——PoW不仅仅是共识机制，更是将数字世界锚定物理现实的修复工具。

title:
Impact on Gold's Rate After PM Modi's Appeal to Not Buy Gold for a Year 
A Comprehensive Economic Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Impact on Gold's Rate After PM Modi's Appeal to Not Buy Gold for a Year 
A Comprehensive Economic Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic rationale and multi-dimensional consequences of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's May 2026 appeal to Indian citizens to abstain from purchasing gold for one year, accompanied by the government's simultaneous decision to double gold import duties from 6% to 15%. Drawing on 100 years of Indian monetary history-from the Gold Control Act of 1962 through the 2013 duty cycle-this analysis evaluates the short-term and long-term impact on gold prices, the retail jewellery sector, employment, GDP, per capita income, and broader macroeconomic indicators. The paper argues that while the appeal and duty hike may provide short-term relief to India's foreign exchange reserves, historical precedent strongly suggests that structural demand suppression is not achievable through price mechanisms alone, and that the unintended consequences-smuggling, grey markets, and sectoral job losses-may outweigh the intended benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了莫迪2026年呼吁印度公民一年内不购买黄金并提高黄金进口关税的经济逻辑与多维后果，认为此举虽可能短期缓解外汇储备压力，但历史经验表明难以通过价格机制结构性抑制需求，且可能引发走私、灰色市场和行业失业等负面后果。
AI.research_question: 莫迪政府呼吁公民一年内不购买黄金并提高黄金进口关税（从6%翻倍至15%）的经济合理性及其短期与长期多维影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度黄金进口长期对外汇储备构成压力，政府试图通过道德劝诫与价格机制（关税）双重手段抑制黄金需求，但该政策的实际效果与副作用尚待系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度百年货币史（从1962年《黄金控制法》到2013年关税周期）的历史制度分析；需求抑制的价格机制理论；结构性需求与非正规经济行为。
AI.method: 历史比较分析，结合100年印度货币政策经验，评估短期与长期对金价、零售珠宝业、就业、GDP、人均收入及宏观指标的冲击。
AI.findings: 1. 短期可能缓解外汇储备压力；2. 历史表明单纯依靠价格机制无法实现结构性需求抑制；3. 政策可能引发走私加剧、灰色市场膨胀、珠宝行业失业等负面后果，其成本可能超过预期收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了"道德劝诫+价格管制"政策组合在新兴市场黄金消费领域的有效性边界分析；验证了结构性需求对价格干预的韧性，拓展了制度经济学在非正规经济领域的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴经济体制定黄金进口管制政策提供历史证据与风险警示；提示政策制定者需权衡外汇储备安全与行业就业、市场秩序间的取舍。
