title: The Expert Assessment within Banca d’Italia’s in-House Credit Assessment System
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Expert Assessment within Banca d’Italia’s in-House Credit Assessment System

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy: Markets, Infrastructures, Payment Systems No. 79
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of the expert assessment – conducted by two analysts following the production of a rating based solely on the statistical model – within Banca d’Italia’s in-house credit assessment system of Italian non-financial firms (ICAS). We have two aims: to document recent methodological enhancements, including the integration of climate-related risks and of sector analysis, and to provide an estimate of the contribution of the expert assessment to the rating process. The study leverages over 25,000 assessments produced by analysts between 2016 and 2022, including corporate default events. The recent methodological innovations have enhanced the transparency and consistency of the expert assessment, facilitating the integration of new risk sources. Our empirical results show that the expert assessment significantly improves both the predictive power and the discriminatory power of the full ratings obtained through ICAS, compared with the ratings based solely on the statistical model, with an increase of the AUROC of around 2 percentage points. Furthermore, the expert assessment protects the performance of ICAS, particularly during periods of macroeconomic stress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了意大利央行内部信用评估系统（ICAS）中专家评估的作用。专家评估是在统计模型评级之后由两名分析师进行的。研究发现，专家评估显著提升了评级的预测力和区分力（AUROC提升约2个百分点），并在宏观经济压力时期保护了系统性能。文章还介绍了方法论改进，包括整合气候相关风险和行业分析。
AI.research_question: 在意大利央行内部企业信用评估系统（ICAS）中，专家评估（statistical model评级后的分析师人工判断）对评级过程有何贡献？
AI.motivation: 量化专家评估在信用评级中的增量价值，尤其是在统计模型已提供初步评级的情况下，并评估近期方法论改进（气候风险、行业分析）的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险评估理论、统计模型与专家判断的互补性、预测能力与区分能力评估（AUROC）。
AI.method: 基于2016-2022年超过25,000份分析师评估数据（含企业违约事件），比较仅依赖统计模型的评级与加入专家评估后的完整评级在预测力和区分力上的差异，使用AUROC等指标。
AI.findings: （1）专家评估使完整评级的AUROC提升约2个百分点，显著改善预测力和区分力；（2）专家评估在宏观经济压力时期能保护ICAS系统的性能；（3）近期方法论创新（气候风险、行业分析）增强了评估的透明度和一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"统计模型+专家判断"的混合信用评估模式提供了量化证据，证实专家判断具有超越统计模型的增量价值，且在经济压力时期尤为重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和监管机构优化内部信用评级系统提供了实证依据：在统计模型基础上引入结构化专家评估可显著提升评级质量，且应持续进行方法论创新以涵盖新型风险（如气候风险）。

title: Taxation and Economic Growth: A Comparative Analysis of Asian and OECD Economies
affiliations: University of Glasgow

detail.title: Taxation and Economic Growth: A Comparative Analysis of Asian and OECD Economies
detail.abstract:
This study analyses the impact of taxation on economic growth in ten Asian developing and ten OECD countries from 1991 to 2020 using Fixed Effects panel estimation. It tests whether fiscal policy models from advanced economies apply across different development contexts.

 The findings reveal key divergences. Corporate income taxes promote growth in OECD countries but have no effect in Asian economies. Trade taxes are positively associated with growth in both regions, challenging trade liberalization orthodoxy. Higher tax-to-GDP ratios boost growth in Asian countries but constrain it in OECD nations.

 These results challenge universal tax policy prescriptions and highlight the importance of institutional context. These results underscore the need for development-specific fiscal strategies that account for institutional capacity and structural differences between economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用固定效应面板估计方法，分析了1991-2020年十个亚洲发展中国家和十个OECD国家的税收对经济增长的影响，发现税收政策效应因经济发展水平而异，挑战了普适性税收政策主张。
AI.research_question: 税收如何影响不同发展阶段国家（亚洲发展中国家与OECD发达国家）的经济增长？发达经济体的财政政策模型是否适用于不同的发展背景？
AI.motivation: 检验来自发达经济体的财政政策模型是否能够推广到不同发展背景的国家，挑战普适性税收政策处方的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策与经济增长理论、制度经济学（强调制度背景和结构性差异对政策效果的影响）
AI.method: 固定效应面板估计（Fixed Effects panel estimation），覆盖1991-2020年十个亚洲发展中国家和十个OECD国家的面板数据。
AI.findings: 1) 企业所得税促进OECD国家增长，但对亚洲经济体无显著影响；2) 贸易税在两类地区均与增长正相关，挑战贸易自由化正统观点；3) 税收占GDP比率促进亚洲国家增长，但制约OECD国家增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了普适性税收政策处方的假设，强调了制度背景和结构性差异在税收-增长关系中的关键作用，为发展特定财政策略提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和发达国家制定差异化的税收政策提供实证依据，建议政策制定者根据本国制度能力和经济结构特点采用发展特异性的财政策略，而非盲目套用发达国家的税收政策模式。

title: Media Coverage and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
affiliations: Carleton University and

detail.title: Media Coverage and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada (grant number 430-2025-00669 for Ba Chu, and 430-2024-00258 for Ilias Tsiakas).

detail.abstract: We assess the cross-sectional relation between media coverage and cryptocurrency returns using 7.6 million news articles from a large-scale web corpus. We find that cryptocurrencies with no coverage earn higher risk-adjusted returns than those with high coverage. By decomposing coverage intensity into coverage breadth and novelty, we separate the dissemination of existing information from the arrival of new information. We show that media coverage combines two offsetting channels: breadth captures an attention-driven channel that predicts lower future returns, while novelty captures an information channel that predicts higher future returns. Our findings highlight the role of information diffusion in cryptocurrency returns.

AI.tldr: 使用760万篇新闻文章，研究发现加密货币的媒体报道覆盖率与未来收益呈负相关，但将覆盖率分解为覆盖广度（注意力驱动，预测低收益）和新颖性（信息驱动，预测高收益）后，两者具有相反的预测作用。
AI.research_question: 媒体报道覆盖率与加密货币横截面收益之间存在怎样的关系？覆盖广度与新颖性如何分别影响收益？
AI.motivation: 以往研究对媒体报道与资产收益的关系结论不一，且加密货币市场的信息传播机制尚不明确。本文旨在利用大规模新闻语料库，解析媒体报道中"注意力效应"与"信息效应"的分离作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息扩散理论、注意力驱动定价理论。媒体覆盖广度代表已有信息的扩散（吸引注意力，推高价格后预期收益降低），新颖性代表新信息的到达（提供增量信息，推高收益）。
AI.method: 使用760万篇新闻文章构建大规模网络语料库；将媒体报道强度分解为覆盖广度（媒体数量/报道分布）和新颖性（内容独特性）；横截面回归分析加密货币的风险调整后收益。
AI.findings: （1）无媒体报道的加密货币风险调整后收益高于高覆盖率的加密货币；（2）覆盖广度预测更低的未来收益；（3）新颖性预测更高的未来收益；（4）媒体报道通过注意力和信息两个相反的渠道影响加密货币收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在加密货币市场同时识别并分离了媒体报道的"注意力效应"和"信息效应"，丰富了信息扩散理论与资产定价的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者提供了基于媒体报道结构的交易信号（广度低/新颖性高时买入）；提示监管者和市场参与者关注信息传播机制对市场效率的影响。

reference: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 585; __ ABA J. Lab. & Emp. L. __ (forthcoming 2026)
title: The Federal Ban on Forced Arbitration of Sexual Harassment or Assault Cases - Four Years of Caselaw
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: The Federal Ban on Forced Arbitration of Sexual Harassment or Assault Cases - Four Years of Caselaw

keywords: Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act of 2022

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 585
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act of 2022 (EFAA) prohibits enforcement of pre-dispute arbitration agreements in cases involving sexual harassment or sexual assault. Spurred by the #MeToo movement, and enacted with broad bipartisan support, EFAA was intended to ensure that victims of harassment or assault may choose to pursue relief in court, rather than being forced in private arbitral proceedings.
 
This Article provides a detailed assessment of the first four years of litigation under the statute. It focuses on three inter-related interpretive questions that have arisen frequently. First, most courts are properly concluding that EFAA includes actions based on non-sexualized harassment, such as insults or sabotaging of work because of sex, as well as unwelcome sexualized conduct; it also includes harassment based on pregnancy or related medical conditions and based on sexual orientation or gender identity. Second, courts are properly holding that if any claim is within the ambit of EFAA, the entire case can be litigated in court. And third, while there is a lack of consensus as to whether the sufficiency of allegations in the complaint should be judged under a plausibility standard or a non-frivolous standard, courts are clear that under either standard what matters is the facts alleged, not the label affixed to the claims. 

The Article concludes that EFAA is living up to its billing. The law gives victims of harassment or assault the opportunity to seek relief in court, and it offers a workable model for broader reform limiting the use of forced arbitration more generally.

AI.tldr: 本文详细评估了《2022年终结性侵犯和性骚扰强制仲裁法案》(EFAA)实施前四年的诉讼情况，分析三个关键解释性问题，并得出结论认为该法案正实现其预期目标——为性骚扰或性侵犯受害者提供在法院寻求救济的机会，并为更广泛的强制仲裁改革提供了可行模式。
AI.research_question: EFAA法案实施前四年的诉讼实践中，法院如何解释和适用该法案？具体围绕三个核心问题：EFAA是否涵盖非性化骚扰行为；若某一索赔属于EFAA管辖范围，整个案件是否可在法院审理；以及起诉状主张充分性应采用何种标准。
AI.motivation: 在#MeToo运动推动下，EFAA于2022年获得两党广泛支持而通过，旨在确保性骚扰或性侵犯受害者可以选择在法院而非强制仲裁程序中寻求救济。本文旨在评估该法案的实际执行效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强制仲裁制度与司法救济权利之间的张力；反性骚扰法律框架下的权利保障理论。
AI.method: 对EFAA实施前四年（2022-2026年）的诉讼案例进行系统分析，聚焦三个常见解释性争议问题的司法裁判趋势。
AI.findings: 第一，大多数法院正确认定EFAA涵盖基于性别的非性化骚扰（如因性别进行的侮辱或破坏工作）以及基于怀孕、性取向或性别认同的骚扰；第二，法院正确认定若任一索赔属于EFAA范围，整个案件可在法院诉讼；第三，虽对起诉状充分性标准（合理性标准vs.非轻率标准）存在分歧，但法院一致认为应依据所声称的事实而非索赔标签进行判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 为强制仲裁例外条款的司法解释提供了系统性分析，阐明了EFAA在反性骚扰法律体系中的适用边界和理论逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师、法官和立法者提供了EFAA适用中的关键解释问题指引；证实了该法案的实际有效性，为更广泛地限制强制仲裁的改革提供了实证依据和可行模式参考。

title: Judicial Review of the Ombuds Office : Good for Administrative Justice?
affiliations: University of Auckland - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Judicial Review of the Ombuds Office : Good for Administrative Justice?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mark Aronson and Greg Weeks (eds) Controlling the Administrative State: Essays in Honour of Matthew Groves (Hart 2025)
The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Public sector Ombuds offices are an important part of the administrative justice system across common law jurisdictions today. They provide accessible and oft en effective recourse to persons who are aggrieved at public administrative decisions, and also broader systemic oversight of the conduct of public administration. But what happens when things go wrong  We can think of many examples. The Australian Ombudsman missed serious illegality in the infamous Robodebt scheme. A complainant may be aggrieved at their complaint being rejected at the initial triaging stage. An official may consider that they were wrongly criticised in an Ombuds office report. Should judicial review be available to address such issues? In some jurisdictions, the Ombuds office's work is protected by a privative clause. Should courts give any effect to such clauses? My frame of reference for addressing these questions is administrative justice. The question is what approach will promote good administrative decisionmaking, accessible and effective recourse for aggrieved individuals and effective implementation of the social objectives of administrative regimes. I propose a proportionality enquiry based on case law in other similar contexts. Applying that enquiry, I argue that, in terms of administrative justice, the disadvantages of judicial review of Ombuds office determinations outweigh the benefits in many contexts. Judicial review should be restricted or excluded in those contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨公共部门监察专员办公室的决定是否应受司法审查，基于行政正义框架，运用比例原则分析后认为，在许多情境下司法审查的弊端大于益处，应予以限制或排除。
AI.research_question: 公共部门监察专员办公室的决定是否应受司法审查？法院应如何处理排除司法审查的私隐条款？
AI.motivation: 监察专员办公室是行政正义体系的重要组成部分，但其自身也可能出错（如澳大利亚监察专员在Robodebt计划中遗漏严重违法），需要探讨如何在保障问责与维护监察制度效能之间取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政正义（administrative justice）框架，强调促进良好行政决策、为受侵害者提供可及有效的救济、以及实现行政制度的社会目标。
AI.method: 规范性论证，借鉴类似情境中的判例法，运用比例原则进行分析。
AI.findings: 在行政正义框架下，对监察专员办公室决定进行司法审查的弊端在许多情境中超过其益处，司法审查应在这些情境中受到限制或排除。
AI.theory_contributions: 将比例原则引入监察专员司法审查问题的分析，为平衡监察问责与制度效能提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和法院在处理监察专员办公室决定的司法审查范围和私隐条款效力时提供政策建议，有助于完善行政正义体系。

title: Reining in Big Tech Corporations: Why Platform Governance Requires Structural Regulation ECGI Working Paper Series in Law
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Reining in Big Tech Corporations: Why Platform Governance Requires Structural Regulation ECGI Working Paper Series in Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute Law Working Paper No 928/2026
The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper argues that modern corporations, particularly Big Tech Platform Corporations (BTPCs), should be understood not as private contractual arrangements but as artificial legal entities created and empowered by States. Through incorporation, corporations receive State-like attributes including perpetual existence, legal personhood, capital lock-in, and entity shielding, enabling them to accumulate and organise capital across time and space. The paper introduces the concepts of “Recursive Capital” and “Capital-Constituting Corporations” to explain how BTPCs extend beyond market participation to shape the very conditions under which economic activity becomes capitalisable. Drawing historical parallels with the English East India Company and Gilded Age monopolies, the paper contends that BTPCs now exercise infrastructural and governance power comparable to semi-sovereign actors. Existing antitrust and contractual theories are therefore inadequate. The paper concludes that platform governance requires structural regulation and a reassertion of democratic oversight to recalibrate the delegated powers States have granted corporations.

AI.tldr: 本文论证现代公司（尤其是大型科技平台公司）应被理解为国家创设和授权的法律实体，而非私人契约安排。公司通过注册获得国家属性，如永续存在、法律人格、资本锁定和实体屏蔽，从而积累和组织资本。文章提出“递归资本”和“资本构成公司”概念，解释平台公司如何超越市场参与，塑造经济活动可资本化的条件。通过与英国东印度公司及镀金时代垄断企业的历史类比，作者认为平台公司如今行使着相当于半主权行为体的基础设施和治理权力，现有反垄断和契约理论不足，平台治理需要结构性监管和民主监督的重新主张。
AI.research_question: 现代大型科技平台公司的本质是什么？它们应被视为私人契约实体还是国家授权的准主权行为体？现有法律和经济学理论是否足以解释和规制其权力？
AI.motivation: 传统公司契约理论无法解释大型科技平台公司日益增长的准主权权力（如制定规则、基础设施控制、影响市场条件），需要新的理论框架来理解其本质并指导有效的治理改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司作为国家创设的法律实体理论（对比私人契约理论）；递归资本（Recursive Capital）——平台不仅参与市场，还塑造经济活动可资本化的条件；资本构成公司（Capital-Constituting Corporations）——公司作为资本形成和组织的核心制度安排。
AI.method: 理论论证与历史比较分析：将现代大型科技平台公司与英国东印度公司、镀金时代垄断企业进行制度和权力结构的历史类比。
AI.findings: 大型科技平台公司通过国家授予的公司特权获得准主权权力，能够递归地塑造经济活动的资本化条件；历史先例（东印度公司、镀金时代垄断）表明公司权力膨胀后需要国家重新规制；现有反垄断和契约理论不足以应对平台公司的结构性权力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“递归资本”和“资本构成公司”概念，拓展了公司理论，将公司从市场参与者重新定位为市场条件塑造者；挑战了主流的公司契约论和新古典经济学框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台经济治理提供理论依据，主张结构性监管和民主监督而非仅依赖反垄断执法；为重新平衡国家-公司权力关系提供政策方向。

title: Sign Stealing in Team Contests: Coordination, Unpredictability, and Competition Intensity
affiliations: Tulane University - Department of Economics, Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance and Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance

detail.title: Sign Stealing in Team Contests: Coordination, Unpredictability, and Competition Intensity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2026-05
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Communication can facilitate coordination within teams in many competitive settings, from team sports to military operations. However, it may leak and reveal intentions to the opponent. We study how this tension shapes behaviour in a team contest, both theoretically and experimentally. Our theory predicts that secure communication plays a dual role: it improves internal coordination while concealing intentions from the opponent, thereby raising competition intensity-operationalized as effort investment-for all parties. Our experiment provides causal evidence for these effects. When communication leaks, its concealment role disappears, and teammates trade off coordination against predictability. When coordination concerns dominate, teammates should always communicate, but sometimes they choose not to, leading to costly coordination failures. Nevertheless, investment levels remain close to those under secure communication, well above the levels observed without communication. These results suggest that blocking an opponent's communication may be more effective than spying on it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究团队竞争中沟通的双重角色——内部协调与信息泄露。通过理论与实验发现，安全沟通能提升协调并隐藏意图，从而加剧竞争强度；而沟通泄露时，团队会在协调与可预测性之间权衡，且有时会主动放弃沟通导致协调失败。
AI.research_question: 在团队竞争中，沟通的协调效应与信息泄露效应如何影响团队行为与竞争强度？
AI.motivation: 团队竞争（如体育、军事）中沟通不可或缺，但它既有助于内部协调，也可能向对手泄露意图。这种紧张关系如何塑造行为尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于团队竞争博弈理论，分析安全沟通与泄露沟通两种情境下的均衡行为，区分沟通的协调功能与隐蔽功能。
AI.method: 理论建模 + 实验室实验（因果识别）
AI.findings: 安全沟通提升协调并隐藏意图，加剧竞争强度；沟通泄露时团队在协调与可预测性之间权衡，有时主动放弃沟通导致协调失败，但投资水平仍高于无沟通情境。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了沟通在团队竞争中的双重角色（协调 vs 隐蔽），并理论化其在不同信息泄露条件下的均衡结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争环境下沟通策略（如是否加密、是否监听）提供决策依据，指出"阻断对手沟通"可能比"监听"更有效。

title:
The Inference Residual: 
Token-to-Watt Basis, Demand Rebound, and the Migration of AI Scarcity

detail.title:
The Inference Residual: 
Token-to-Watt Basis, Demand Rebound, and the Migration of AI Scarcity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of AhaSignals, an independent research project referenced in this paper. The paper defines AhaSignals research terminology and public measurement protocols that may support future research products or data layers. No external sponsor, data vendor, platform, or cited organization had editorial control over the manuscript. Third-party names and sources are used only for factual source identification; no affiliation, endorsement, or official relationship is implied. AI tools were used for drafting and editorial assistance; the author reviewed, edited, and is responsible for the final text.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper uses public, non-human-subject information and methodological definitions. It does not involve human participants, patients, private personal data, experiments, or interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received. The research was self-funded.

detail.abstract:
The first phase of the artificial-intelligence infrastructure trade was framed as a training-capacity problem: acquire accelerators, secure high-bandwidth memory, build clusters, and amortize capital expenditure over future model demand. The second phase is different. As model usage shifts toward persistent inference, lower unit prices can release enough latent demand that scarcity does not disappear; it migrates into memory, power delivery, interconnection queues, cooling, deployment timing, and monetization lag.

This working paper introduces the Inference Residual, a protocol-stage framework for testing whether cheaper inference reduces AI scarcity or relocates it into physical delivery constraints. We define the Token-to-Watt Basis (TWB) as a standardized growth-rate residual between token-velocity proxy momentum and effective power-delivery proxy momentum. TWB is not a raw ratio of tokens to watts and should not be cited as a live factor before both proxy legs are admitted under stable source boundaries. To handle lumpy infrastructure supply, we define usable inference capacity with a smooth-minimum bottleneck operator rather than a simple additive average. The contribution is conceptual and methodological: it turns the question “where did AI scarcity move?” into a falsifiable measurement protocol for weekly research use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“推理残差”（Inference Residual）框架，将AI稀缺性从训练算力问题重新定义为推理阶段的基础设施瓶颈迁移问题，并引入Token-to-Watt Basis（TWB）指标与平滑最小值瓶颈算子来量化这一迁移。
AI.research_question: AI从训练阶段转向持续推理阶段后，算力稀缺性是否会消失？还是会被迁移到电力、散热、互联等物理基础设施约束中？
AI.motivation: 第一波AI基础设施投资聚焦于训练算力（加速器、显存、集群），但随着模型使用转向持久化推理，更低的单价是否会释放潜伏需求，导致稀缺性并未消失，而是转移到新的瓶颈环节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 推理残差（Inference Residual）框架；Token-to-Watt Basis（TWB）标准化增长率残差；平滑最小值瓶颈算子（smooth-minimum bottleneck operator）。
AI.method: 提出一个协议级的测量框架，通过TWB（代币速度代理动量与电力交付代理动量之间的增长率残差）来检验推理成本降低是否真的消除了稀缺性，并采用平滑最小值而非简单加总来处理基础设施的块状供给特征。
AI.findings: 更低的推理单价并不消除稀缺性，而是将其重新分配到物理交付约束（内存、电力、散热、互联队列、部署时序、货币化滞后）中。稀缺性发生了迁移而非消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将“AI稀缺性去了哪里”这一无法直接回答的问题转化为一个可证伪的测量协议；引入了TWB作为标准化的增长率残差指标；提出用平滑最小值瓶颈算子替代传统加总平均来处理基础设施供给的块状特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为每周研究使用提供了一个可操作的测量协议，帮助识别AI基础设施中真正的瓶颈环节，指导算力投资从“抢卡”转向更精细化的物理约束管理。

title: Stability in Competitive Competition
affiliations: Laissez-Faire Economist

detail.title: Stability in Competitive Competition
detail.abstract: Hotelling's "Stability in Competition" is contradictory and incomplete: he uses monopoly theory to explain competition, and fails to include production cost. This paper corrects these two errors, to come to the same stability conclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文修正了Hotelling经典论文中的两个关键错误（用垄断理论解释竞争、忽略生产成本），却得出了与Hotelling相同的稳定性结论。
AI.research_question: 在修正Hotelling模型中用垄断理论解释竞争以及忽略生产成本这两个错误后，竞争稳定性结论是否仍然成立？
AI.motivation: Hotelling（1929）的"竞争中的稳定性"论文存在内部矛盾和不完整性：它错误地使用了垄断理论框架来分析竞争行为，并且完全忽略了生产成本的影响。作者试图纠正这两个理论缺陷，重新检验竞争稳定性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hotelling空间竞争模型、垄断理论、生产成本理论、博弈论（隐含）
AI.method: 理论修正与演绎推理：作者通过修正Hotelling原始模型的两个假设错误（用垄断定价逻辑替代竞争逻辑、引入生产成本变量），重新推导竞争稳定性条件。
AI.findings: 即使在修正了Hotelling的两个关键错误后（即正确使用竞争理论而非垄断理论，并纳入生产成本），仍然得出了与Hotelling相同的稳定性结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了Hotelling原始模型的理论缺陷（方法论的错误借用和变量遗漏）；2. 证明了即使在这些缺陷被修正后，核心结论（竞争稳定性）仍然稳健成立，增强了该理论的可信度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为空间竞争市场的企业定位决策提供了更严谨的理论基础，提醒管理者在分析竞争时需同时考虑定价逻辑的正确性和生产成本的影响。

title: Modeling the Sustainability of Informal Employment through a Three-actor Model: Equilibrium and Institutional Trap

detail.title: Modeling the Sustainability of Informal Employment through a Three-actor Model: Equilibrium and Institutional Trap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The article "Modeling the Stability of Informal Employment Using a Three-Actor Model: Equilibrium and Institutional Trap" by A. L. Safonov and D. V. Nekipelova is original; it has not been previously published and has not been submitted to other journals (publishers). The authors have checked the materials for plagiarism. The authors consent to publication of the article in both the print and publicly available online versions of the journal.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The work did not require the participation of patients and subjects. was carried out in compliance with all academic and ethical requirements
