I have no financial relationships with any organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study. The Somagraphic Learning™ Framework is my independently developed intellectual property. No external funding was received.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This preprint is a conceptual framework paper. It does not report experimental findings or involve human subjects research requiring IRB approval. Preliminary prototype observations referenced in the manuscript were conducted informally with two STEM graduate student volunteers and one faculty informant. No sensitive data was collected. A formal IRB-ready pilot protocol exists as a companion document on OSF for future empirical testing.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded. No institutional, corporate, or grant funding was received in connection with this work.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly generate explanations, summaries, and analytical outputs at speeds that exceed the natural pace of human cognition. While these technologies expand informational access, they may compress the orientation processes through which conceptual understanding normally develops. Third, the framework's analog-first design carries an accessibility argument for neurodivergent learners, multilingual populations, and low-connectivity contexts that has not been previously articulated in human-AI sequencing frameworks. These extensions do not change the framework's core claim. They establish that the claim matters across a wider set of contexts than originally stated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以类比优先为核心的人类-AI交互框架，主张在AI生成快速输出之前，先通过类比推理帮助人类建立概念理解的定向过程。该框架对神经多样性学习者、多语言人群和低连接环境具有重要的可及性意义。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统输出速度超越人类认知自然节奏的背景下，如何设计人类-AI交互序列以保护和发展人类的概念理解定向过程？
AI.motivation: AI系统生成解释、摘要和分析输出的速度日益加快，虽然扩展了信息获取，但可能压缩了概念理解正常发展所需的定向过程。现有的人类-AI序列框架尚未充分关注这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 类比推理理论；认知定向过程理论；人类-AI交互序列框架
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论论证
AI.findings: 类比优先设计能够保护概念理解的定向过程；该框架对神经多样性学习者、多语言人群和低连接环境具有重要的可及性价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个以类比优先设计的人类-AI交互新框架，将认知定向过程纳入人类-AI交互的时序考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计提供了具体指导：应在输出前优先引导用户进行类比推理；为神经多样性学习者、多语言人群和低连接环境等特殊群体提供了更具包容性的交互方案。

title: Estimating the Demand for a Digital Euro: A Survey Approach for France, Germany and Italy
affiliations: University of Marburg - School of Business & Economics, University of Trier - Faculty of Economics and University of Trier - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Estimating the Demand for a Digital Euro: A Survey Approach for France, Germany and Italy

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the extensive and intensive margins of demand for a retail digital euro. We conducted a representative survey in France, Germany and Italy in November–December 2023. We find that 52–62% of respondents are willing to hold a digital euro, depending on the interest rate spread, with a higher share in Italy than in France or Germany. Design features (cash-like vs deposit-like) appear to play only a very limited role. Average demand depends on the hypothetical interest rate spread relative to current accounts and ranges from EUR 700 to EUR 1,100, implying an aggregate demand of 1.5–2.5% of GDP. Willingness to hold a digital euro is associated with socio-demographic factors, trust in the ECB and the EU, digitalisation and payment behaviour. Negative interest rate spreads relative to current accounts reduce willingness to hold the digital euro more strongly than positive spreads increase it. Behavioural characteristics tend to be correlated with the likelihood of adoption, whereas economic factors, particularly income and interest rates, are mainly related to the level of demand. This distinction becomes more pronounced when conditioning on positive demand, suggesting that socio-demographic factors primarily influence participation decisions rather than quantities demanded.

AI.tldr: 本文基于法国、德国和意大利的代表性调查，分析了零售数字欧元的广泛和集约需求边际。研究发现52-62%的受访者愿意持有数字欧元，平均需求为700-1100欧元（约GDP的1.5-2.5%），设计特征作用有限，负利率利差比正利差影响更大，行为特征关联采用概率而经济因素关联需求水平。
AI.research_question: 零售数字欧元的广泛边际（是否愿意持有）和集约边际（持有多少）需求如何？不同设计特征、利率利差和社会经济因素如何影响这两种需求边际？
AI.motivation: 欧洲央行正在探索推出数字欧元，但对其潜在需求规模、驱动因素以及设计特征的影响缺乏实证证据。了解零售数字欧元的需求分布对政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广泛边际（采纳决策）与集约边际（需求量）的双重需求框架；行为经济学视角下的信任、数字化、支付习惯等非经济因素与经济因素的区分。
AI.method: 在法国、德国和意大利进行代表性调查（2023年11-12月），通过假设情景实验评估数字欧元需求，分析不同利率利差和设计特征下的差异。
AI.findings: 52-62%受访者愿意持有数字欧元（意大利高于法德）；平均需求700-1100欧元（GDP的1.5-2.5%）；设计特征作用有限；负利差影响大于正利差；行为特征关联采纳概率，经济因素（收入、利率）关联需求水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了广泛边际和集约边际对数字欧元需求的差异化驱动因素，揭示了行为特征与经济因素在不同需求边际上的不对称作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲央行设计数字欧元提供了需求侧实证依据，包括利率定价策略、设计特征取舍以及国别差异的政策启示。

title: Experience-First AI Transformation: A Practitioner-Scholar Framework for the AI-Native Digital Workplace
affiliations: Lenovo Research Hong Kong

detail.title: Experience-First AI Transformation: A Practitioner-Scholar Framework for the AI-Native Digital Workplace

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. The author holds the registered trademark AIconomics™ (USPTO Serial No. 99835719). No other conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on practitioner case evidence from enterprise programs in which the author held direct executive responsibility. All organizational references have been anonymized where appropriate to protect confidentiality. No human subjects research, patient data, or formal experimental methodology was employed. Formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was self-funded by the author as an independent practitioner-scholar contribution.

detail.abstract: Enterprise AI attracts massive capital, yet economic returns remain stubbornly inconsistent across global organizations. The root cause is rarely the technology itself; rather, it is a structural mismatch between how AI is deployed and the actual organizational experience architecture it operates within. This paper introduces the Experience-First AI Transformation (EFIT) framework. Forged across twenty-eight years of executive technology leadership and large-scale deployments, EFIT provides a practitioner-tested blueprint for the AI-native enterprise. The EFIT framework rejects the legacy "tool stack" approach, treating the digital workplace as a unified ecosystem. It forces a critical pivot in governance: moving from system-level service availability (SLA) to knowledge worker experience quality (XLA). The model relies on four core pillars: (1) an Experience-First Architecture that embeds AI as an intelligence layer; (2) a Knowledge Worker Archetype Model that segments users by actual behavior to drive precision enablement; (3) a Six-Layer AI-Native Architecture that sequences the exact infrastructure needed for durable value creation ; and (4) the 5:1 Change Management Principle, which quantifies the human investment required to turn a software rollout into sustained adoption. This framework is not theoretical; it is pressure-tested across global financial technology, managed services, and digital workplace transformations. Documented outcomes include a 28% surge in knowledge worker productivity, a 74% active AI adoption rate (shattering the 40–50% industry average), a 40% reduction in new-joiner ramp time, and a gross profit margin expansion from 17% to 35% in a single fiscal year. The paper concludes with five testable propositions and a clear, actionable mandate for CIOs, CFOs, and C-suite leaders navigating the AI transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"体验优先的AI转型（EFIT）框架"，主张企业AI失败的根本原因不是技术本身，而是AI部署与组织实际体验架构的结构性错配。该框架基于28年高管实践经验，包含四大支柱：体验优先架构、知识工作者原型模型、六层AI原生架构和5:1变革管理原则，并报告了生产率提升28%、AI采用率74%等显著成果。
AI.research_question: 企业AI投资回报不一致的根本原因是什么？如何通过以体验为中心的框架实现可持续的AI转型？
AI.motivation: 尽管大量资本涌入企业AI，但全球组织的经济回报始终参差不齐。作者认为根源不在于技术本身，而在于AI部署方式与组织实际体验架构之间的结构性错配。现有"工具栈"方法忽视数字化工作场所的整体生态系统，导致AI采用率低（行业平均仅40-50%）和价值创造不可持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: EFIT框架；体验优先架构（AI作为智能层）；知识工作者原型模型（基于实际行为的用户细分）；六层AI原生架构；5:1变革管理原则；从SLA（服务可用性）到XLA（体验质量）的治理范式转变。
AI.method: 基于28年高管技术领导力和大规模部署经验的实践检验框架。在金融科技、托管服务和数字工作场所转型等多个全球场景中进行压力测试。报告了定量成果数据（生产率、采用率、入职时间、利润率）。提出五个可检验的命题。
AI.findings: EFIT框架实施后：知识工作者生产率提升28%；AI主动采用率达74%（远超行业平均40-50%）；新员工上手时间减少40%；毛利率在一个财年内从17%扩张至35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI转型从技术导向（工具栈）重新概念化为体验导向（统一生态系统）；引入XLA（体验质量协议）替代传统SLA作为治理核心指标；提出知识工作者原型模型以行为而非角色细分用户；建立5:1变革管理量化工具体现人力投资与可持续采用的量化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CIO、CFO和C-suite高管提供可操作的AI转型蓝图；提供压力测试过的实践框架和具体成果数据；提出从工具部署思维向体验生态思维的转变路径；给出可直接实施的四大支柱行动指南和五个可检验命题。

title: Slice to Protect
affiliations: , City University of New York (CUNY), University of Bologna - Department of Economics and Bocconi University - Department of Economics and Paolo Baffi Centre on Central Banking and Financial Regulation

detail.title: Slice to Protect

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how firms strategically slice up global production processes to protect proprietary know-how. By sourcing fewer inputs from each supplier, firms avoid the concentration of information in the hands of individual suppliers and thereby reduce the risk of imitation. Using rich micro data on firm-to-firm trade in automotive components, we uncover a robust U-shaped relationship between the number of components sourced per supplier (concentration) and the strength of intellectual property rights (IPR) protection. This U-shape can be rationalized by a combination of a protective effect and a compositional effect of IPR institutions. In countries with weak IPR protection, firms source only low-tech components, for which imitation is irrelevant, so concentration is optimal. At intermediate IPR levels, they buy more high-tech, imitation-prone components and therefore 'slice to protect'. Under strong IPR regimes, imitation risk is minimal and concentration is highest. Empirically, weak IPR institutions strongly predict slicing of high-tech components.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业如何通过分散化采购（从每个供应商处采购更少的零部件）来保护专有技术诀窍，降低被模仿的风险。利用汽车零部件企业间贸易的微观数据，发现零部件采购集中度与知识产权保护强度之间存在稳健的U型关系。
AI.research_question: 企业如何通过战略性拆分全球生产流程来保护专有技术知识？知识产权保护强度如何影响企业分散采购决策？
AI.motivation: 企业面对知识产权保护不完善时，如何通过供应链设计（而非法律手段）来防止核心技术外泄，这是一个尚未被充分研究的战略问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保护效应（protective effect）与构成效应（compositional effect）的联合作用。保护效应指弱知识产权下企业分散采购以降低单个供应商掌握完整技术；构成效应指弱知识产权下企业只采购低技术零部件（模仿风险无关），因此集中度高。
AI.method: 利用汽车零部件企业间贸易的微观数据，实证分析零部件采购集中度与知识产权保护强度之间的关系，并识别U型关系。
AI.findings: 零部件采购集中度与知识产权保护强度呈稳健的U型关系。弱知识产权制度下，企业只采购低技术零部件，集中度最优；中等知识产权水平下，企业采购更多高技术（易被模仿）零部件，采取"拆分以保护"策略；强知识产权制度下，模仿风险最小，集中度最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了知识产权制度通过保护效应和构成效应的相互作用产生U型影响的理论机制，丰富了全球价值链治理与知识产权策略的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理知识产权风险提供了供应链设计的新思路——通过分散采购保护核心技术；为政策制定者理解知识产权制度对企业实际行为的影响提供了微观证据。

title: The Survival of the Energy-Fittest: Evidence from French Manufacturing Firms
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Survival of the Energy-Fittest: Evidence from French Manufacturing Firms

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper disentangles the roles of within-firm improvement and between-firm selection and market reallocation in determining aggregate energy intensity. Our analysis shows that selection and market reallocation play a stronger role than within-firm improvement in driving aggregate declines in energy intensity, despite the strong focus on within-firm response to climate policy measures in the existing empirical literature. We also find that these mechanisms, in particular the selection channel, can be leveraged by environmental policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业内改进与企业间选择和市场重新分配在决定总能源强度中的作用，发现选择和市场重新分配比企业内改进更能推动总能源强度的下降，并且环境政策可以利用这些机制，特别是选择渠道。
AI.research_question: 企业内改进与企业间选择和市场重新分配在决定总能源强度中各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有实证文献主要关注气候政策对企业内改进的影响，但忽略了企业间选择和市场重新分配的作用，本文旨在弥补这一缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业内改进、企业间选择与市场重新分配机制对能源强度的影响理论。
AI.method: 对微观企业数据的分解分析，区分企业内改进与企业间选择及市场重新分配的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 选择和市场重新分配在推动总能源强度下降中的作用强于企业内改进；2. 环境政策可以利用这些机制，特别是选择渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了企业内改进与企业间选择及市场重新分配在总能源强度变化中的相对重要性，拓展了能源经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境政策制定提供了新视角：政策应关注通过促进低效企业退出（选择机制）和市场资源再配置来降低总能源强度，而不仅仅依赖企业内部的改进。

title: Optimal Default in a Small Open Economy: Senegal’s Hidden Debt Crisis
affiliations: and

detail.title: Optimal Default in a Small Open Economy: Senegal’s Hidden Debt Crisis

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Hidden public liabilities can reprice sovereign risk abruptly upon revelation. We study optimal default following such a revelation in a quantitative sovereign default model and apply the framework to Senegal’s 2024 debt audit, which revised government debt upward by 50 percentage points of GDP. The revelation enters as an exogenous upward shift in the inherited debt stock within a small open economy with long-duration debt and default costs disciplined by Senegal’s monetary-union constraints. Under our baseline calibration, the corrected debt stock exceeds the model’s repayment region, implying that default would have been optimal from 2023 onward—before the audit was conducted. Since Senegal has continued to repay, we also consider a no-default calibration that matches post-revelation spread dynamics. Rationalizing repayment requires income dynamics more volatile and less persistent than historical estimates, consistent with optimism about mean reversion or gambling for redemption. This calibration places Senegal near the default boundary, where a 3 percent adverse income shock would make restructuring optimal within a year. Both calibrations yield the same conclusion: the hidden-debt revelation moved Senegal from moderate fiscal risk to acute vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了隐性公共债务暴露后主权债务违约的最优决策，以塞内加尔2024年债务审计（将政府债务上调50%的GDP）为案例。研究发现，债务修正后违约在2023年之前已是最优选择；塞内加尔继续偿债需依赖更波动、更低持久性的收入动态；两种校准均表明隐性债务暴露将塞内加尔从中等财政风险推至严重脆弱状态。
AI.research_question: 隐性公共债务暴露后，主权违约的最优时机是什么？塞内加尔2024年债务审计案例如何验证这一理论？
AI.motivation: 隐性债务（如未披露的财政赤字、表外负债）在突然暴露时可能引发主权风险的急剧重定价。塞内加尔2024年债务审计将政府债务上调50个百分点的GDP，提供了一个天然的准自然实验来研究这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量主权违约模型（Eaton-Gersovitz传统），融入长期债务、违约成本（由货币联盟约束纪律化），以及隐性债务暴露作为外生存量冲击。
AI.method: 校准定量主权违约模型至塞内加尔数据，比较基线校准（假设违约最优）与无违约校准（匹配暴露后的利差动态），并进行反事实收入冲击分析。
AI.findings: （1）基线校准显示，修正后债务存量超过模型偿还区域，2023年之前违约已是最优；（2）塞内加尔继续偿债需要收入波动更大、持续性更低（符合均值回复乐观或赌博式偿债）；（3）无违约校准下，塞内加尔处于违约边界，3%的负面收入冲击即可在一年内引发重组；（4）两种校准一致表明隐性债务暴露将风险从“中等”推至“严重脆弱”。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将隐性债务暴露作为外生债务存量冲击嵌入定量主权违约模型，揭示了信息揭示与违约决策的动态关系；区分了“违约最优”与“继续偿债但脆弱”两种均衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 对塞内加尔及类似新兴市场国家的债务管理、财政透明度政策、以及IMF等国际机构的债务可持续性评估具有直接政策启示；指出隐性债务暴露后即便不违约，国家也处于高度脆弱状态。

title: Trade, Skills and Productivity
affiliations: and World Bank

detail.title: Trade, Skills and Productivity

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how firms adjust production and technology in response to exogenous trade shocks. We develop a model that distinguishes revenue TFP from quantity TFP and embeds skill upgrading in technology choices. Firms respond to trade shocks by adjusting their quantity-quality trade-off and skill composition. These decisions impact firms’ quantity and revenue TFP, marginal costs, prices, and markups. Using detailed worker-firm-product data from Brazil, we show how trade shocks, instrumented by exogenous changes in exchange rates, GDP, and tariffs, affect margins. Results suggest fundamentally different firm responses to export and import changes: exports primarily induce upgrading in skills and product quality, whereas imports drive stronger efficiency and quantity-productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业如何应对外生贸易冲击调整生产与技术。通过区分收入TFP与数量TFP，并嵌入技能升级的技术选择模型，利用巴西工人-企业-产品数据，发现出口主要促使技能与产品质量升级，进口则推动效率与数量生产率提升。
AI.research_question: 企业如何应对外生贸易冲击调整其生产与技术决策？不同贸易方向（出口vs进口）对企业调整的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 贸易冲击对企业的影响机制尚不清晰，特别是企业如何在数量-质量权衡与技能构成之间做出调整，以及这些调整如何影响生产率、边际成本、价格和加成率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分收入TFP与数量TFP；嵌入技能升级的技术选择模型；企业数量-质量权衡决策框架。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，利用巴西详细的工人-企业-产品微观数据，以汇率、GDP和关税作为外生工具变量进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 出口冲击主要促使企业进行技能升级和产品质量提升；进口冲击则带来更强的效率改进和数量生产率提升。不同贸易方向对企业边际成本、价格和加成率的影响存在根本性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一框架下区分出口与进口冲击对企业数量-质量权衡的异质性影响；将技能升级内生化为技术选择的一部分，丰富了贸易与生产率关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解贸易自由化的企业层面异质性效应提供依据；帮助企业管理者识别不同贸易方向下的最优调整策略。
